m200582.王子、次は王都へ。\nどうやら向こうも、ただでは済まなさそうです。:
Prince, next stop is the capital.
It seems they won't let this go without a fight.
m200582.王子、魔神の対処は我々にとっても急務です。\nランスさんの呪いを解くためにも、\:
Prince, dealing with the Demon God is urgent for us as well.
To lift Rance's curse as well,
would you be willing to cooperate in the subjugation of Demon God Seere?
m200582.王子。……まあ、なんだ。\n男に世話になるのは二度とごめんだが。:
Prince. …Well, I guess.
I'm not about to let a man take care of me again, though.
m200582.王子。この世界で見たもの、忘れないわ。\n……種族を越えて共に戦う、その形を。:
Prince. I won't forget what I saw in this world.
…The shape of us fighting side by side, regardless of race.
m200582.王子様、皆さん、お世話になりました！\n今度こそ、へんでろぱを……あっ、時間が！:
Your Highness, everyone, thank you so much for your hospitality!
This time for sure, I'll definitely… Ah, look at the time!
m200582.王都に、異界の門がふたつ……。\n眷属が溢れ出しているようです！:
Two gates to another world in the capital……
It seems their minions are pouring out!
m200582.異世界の戦士ランス、そして王国の王子。\n三度目の正直だ。今度こそ、貴様らを殺す:
Warrior Rance of another world, and Prince of the Kingdom.
This is the third time. This time, I will kill you for real.
m200582.異世界の戦士ランス、そして王国の王子。\n今度こそ、貴様らに引導を渡してくれる。:
Rance, the warrior from another world, and the Prince of the Kingdom.
This time, I will guide you to your doom.
m200582.異界からさらわれた人たちだよ！\n魔力を吸われてるみたい！:
They were abducted from another world!
It looks like their mana is being drained!
m200582.異界の門、閉じましたー。\nでも、こういう門が王国中にあるんですよねぇ。:
The gate to the other world is closed.
But there are gates like this all over the kingdom.
m200582.相変わらず、賑やかな人たちでしたねー。: As always, quite the lively bunch, weren't they?
m200582.相変わらず品のない男よ。\nさぁ眷属ども！ この者らを魔力炉の餌にせよ！:
As rude as ever.
Now then, my minions! Feed these people to the mana furnace!
m200582.確かに。互いを見る目に殺気があるわ。\n仲間じゃないのかしら。: Indeed. There's a killing intent in the way they look at each other. Are they even on the same side?
m200582.私がそばに寄っただけで、\nさっきも本当に爆発しちゃって……。:
I only came close to him,
and he actually exploded just now…
m200582.私が先に人質に取ったのだ！ ハニホー！: I took them hostage first! Haniho!
m200582.私が厳しいのは相手を見込んでる時だけよ。\n……あ、今のは聞かなかったことにして:
I'm only strict when I see potential in someone.
……Ah, pretend you didn't hear that.
m200582.私が敵役をやるわ。\n教えてあげるから、練習代わりに撃ってみなさい。:
I'll play the enemy.
I'm going to teach you, so shoot at me to practice.
m200582.私が構築した呪いだ！ 貴様は下がっていろ！: It is *my* curse! You stay out of this!
m200582.私こそが真の魔神セーレ！\n異世界の戦士ランス、王子、覚悟せよ！:
I am the true Demon God Seire!
Warrior of another world, Rance, Prince, prepare yourself!
m200582.私こそ本物だと何度言えば！: How many times do I have to say I'm the real one!
m200582.私の予備よ。汚したくないでしょ、その白い服。\nそれに、魔法使いを教わるなら形か:
It's my spare. You don't want to get that white dress dirty, do you?
Besides, if you're going to learn from a mage, you should start with the look.
m200582.私の偽ハニーもだ！\n貴様、手を抜いたな！:
And my fake Honeys too!
You're holding back, aren't you!
m200582.私の全力、見せてあげる。: Let me show you my full power.
m200582.私は治癒士です。\n攻撃魔法を使う必要はありません。:
I am a healer.
I have no need to use attack magic.
m200582.素直じゃないわね。……ま、いいけど。: You're not very obedient, are you? ……Well, fine.
m200582.肩書も長いですし、アウローラと呼んでください。: That title is quite long. Please, just call me Aurora.
m200582.良い連携が組めそうで何よりです。\nそれでは皆さん。決戦の準備を！:
I'm glad you two seem to be getting along well.
Now then, everyone. Let's prepare for the decisive battle!
m200582.見てください、あそこ……人が捕まってます！: Look, over there…… people are trapped!
m200582.見よ。砕かれた魂の欠片から、\nついにこの魔神セーレが蘇ったぞ。:
Behold. From the shards of a shattered soul,
the Demon God Seire has finally been reborn.
m200582.見ろ。この者たちの魔力を炉に注ぎ、\n紛い物を吸収し、私は真の魔神として蘇るのだ:
Behold. I will pour these people's mana into the furnace,
absorb the imposter, and resurrect as a true Demon God.
m200582.見分けなど知るか！ 全部ぶっ飛ばす！: Who cares about telling them apart! I'll blow them all away!
m200582.視線が鬱陶しいな……。眼鏡が原因なのか？:
Their gaze is really irritating……
Is it because of my glasses?
m200582.言ってないわよ？\nでも、思ってはいるでしょ。あの顔。:
I didn't say a thing.
But they're thinking it, aren't they? Look at their faces.
m200582.貴族の方は転移術が厄介。\n丸い方は魔法が効かない。……面倒な組み合わせね。:
The Noble one's teleportation is a pain.
The round one is immune to magic. ……A troublesome combination.
m200582.貴様、俺様に迷惑ばかりかけおって。: You've only ever been a nuisance to me.
m200582.貴様、魔人……ホーネット派の魔人か……！: You…… a demon…… One of the Hornet faction, are you……!
m200582.貴様が入れ！ 偽物め！: You're the one who should be in there! You fake!
m200582.貴殿の安全のためだ。\n我々が壁になるゆえ、女性は近寄れん。:
It is for your safety. 
We shall serve as a wall, so no woman can approach.
m200582.転移でぶっ飛ばされても、戻れば戦えますー。\n魔法が効かない方は、物理でどうぞー:
Even if we get teleported away, we can fight once we're back.
As for the one immune to magic, just use physical attacks.
m200582.逃げ足の速い魔神ですね……。: What a quick escape for a Demon God……
m200582.開け、異界の門！ ハニホー！: Open, gate to another world! Haniho!
m200582.隠していたのではなく、\n使う機会がなかっただけです。:
I wasn't hiding it.
I simply never had the opportunity to use it.
m200582.難しいことは分からんが、要するに\nあの二匹はまとめてぶっ飛ばせばいいんだな！:
I don't get the complicated stuff, but basically,
we just need to blow both of those bastards away, right?
m200582.面倒ね。魔法使い泣かせだわ。: What a pain. She's a mage's nightmare.
m200582.鬱憤晴らしだー！！\n野郎ども、ついてこい！:
Time to blow off some steam!!
You guys, follow me!
m200582.魂を砕かれてなお立ち上がった\nこの私こそ、真の魔神セーレ！ ハニホー！:
I, who rose again despite my soul being shattered,
am the true Demon God Seire! Haniho!
m200582.魔人なんとかが二匹に増えとる。: The demon thing has multiplied into two.
m200582.魔力の使い方に慣れすぎなのよ。\n今まで隠してたわね？:
You're just too used to how you've been using your mana.
You've been hiding it, haven't you?
m200582.魔力の流れは、あちらだ。\n……丸い方――えぇと、ハニーの方と言うべきか。:
The flow of mana is heading that way.
……The round one——I mean, the Honey one.
m200582.魔力炉で決着をつけようではないか。\nランス、王子、貴様らもだ！ ハニホー！:
Let's settle it in the Magic Furnace, then.
Rance, Prince, you're included too! Hani-ho!
m200582.魔神たちの反応は……この王都の中です！: The Demon Gods' reaction is…… inside this capital!
m200582.黙れ紛い物！\nランスを殺すのは私だ！:
Shut up, fake!
I'm the one who'll kill Rance!
m200582.黙れ！ まぁよい！\n今回は前回までの教訓を活かし、\n確実に貴様を殺す術を用意: Silence! Very well! This time, I have learned from my past defeats and prepared a surefire method to kill you.
m200582.（ここまでの密度、修行というより刑罰に近いな……）: (At this density, it's less like training and more like a punishment……)

m300277.――「等身大アダマス様人形」だ。\nこれで王子もアダマス様に礼拝ができるな。:
――It's the "Life-Size Statue of Lord Adamas."
With this, the Prince will be able to pay his respects to Lord Adamas.
m300277.――いいえ、そうはさせません。\nこんな古い門を知っているとは驚きましたが、\n:
――No, I will not allow that.
I am surprised you know of such an old gate,
but it was worth keeping watch.
m300277.――いつ来ても、嫌な場所ですわね。:
――It's a place I dislike
no matter when I come.
m300277.――いや、ちょっと待て。\n何だこの風切り音……天使とは違うような……。\n王子:
――No, wait a moment.
What is that whooshing sound…… it doesn't sound like angels…….
Prince, something is flying toward us!
m300277.――おぉいテメェら！\nいつまで喋ってるんだ？\nこんなクセェところ早くずらかろ:
—Hey, you guys!
How long are you going to stand there chatting?
Let's get out of this stinky place!
m300277.――た、大変です！\nベラート派についた兵が、\nこちらへ向かってきていると報告:
――I-It's bad!
We've received a report that
Beradt's loyal soldiers are heading this way!
m300277.――だが、今の私には新たなる鎧がある。\nあの珍妙なデーモンの、工場長……？\n:
――But I have a new armor now.
That peculiar demon's…… factory manager……?
The armor he claims to have made in the toy factory……!!
m300277.――とはいえ、今日は一度地上に戻りましょう。\n迷宮の探索には時間がかかりますか:
――That said, let's head back to the surface for today.
Exploring the labyrinth takes time.
Well done on the investigation, Prince!
m300277.――はい、満員御礼、拍手喝采、にゃんにゃかにゃん♪\nさぁ帝国がほこる水着美女た:
――Alright, we're packed in, give it up, meow meow meow meow♪
Here they are, the Empire's swimsuit beauties!
Today's stars are the Imperial Army!
m300277.――まさか、悪霊の迷宮に\nさらなる深層が存在しているとは……。: ――I never would have imagined the Labyrinth of Evil Spirits had even deeper layers to it……
m300277.――ニコルさん、レーレンさん、\n世界樹の調査お疲れさまです。\n何か進展はあり:
—Nicole, Lehren,
thanks for your work investigating the World Tree.
Did you make any progress...?
m300277.――パーフェクトベラートの姿だッ！！: ――This is the form of Perfect Beradt!!
m300277.――否、この場にはもはや、何も残されておらぬ。\nだが、かつての寝所を荒らされ、:
――No, nothing remains here now.
But the First One is greatly displeased
that her former resting place has been desecrated.
m300277.――否、もはや手遅れだ。\n事実は常に更新され、情報はその後を行くしかない。:
――No, it is already too late.
Facts are constantly updated,
and information can only follow behind them.
m300277.――海底に、国……？\n待てよ……それってまさか、クラールフのことか？:
――A nation in the ocean depths……?
Wait a moment…… could that possibly be Klaarf?
m300277.――神のみが生み出せる、奇跡を起こす楔。\nそれを天界の者は『神の楔』と呼ぶので:
—It is a wedge that only the divine can create, capable of producing miracles.
Those of the heavens call it the "God's Wedge."
m300277.――穢れし魔王の配下を、この鉄槌にて清めん。:
――I shall purify you,
servant of the defiled Demon King,
with this hammer of iron.
m300277.――魔術で浮遊している遺跡の噂は聞いていたが、\nまさかそれが天界の門だったとは:
I had heard rumors of a ruin floating by magic,
but I never imagined it was the gate to the heavens.
m300277.…………無駄話はそこまでだ。\nさぁ、調査を始めるぞ。:
…………Enough of this.
Let's begin the investigation.
m300277.…………行ったか。\n――貴殿が、ガリウスを倒したという\n物質界の英雄に相違な:
…………They're gone.
――You must be the heroes of the material world
who defeated Galios, yes?
m300277.……あの、何故私たちに、こんな助言を？\n先程は襲撃してきたというのに……。:
……Um, why are you giving us this advice?
You were just trying to attack us a moment ago…….
m300277.……あの、王子はアイギス教徒なのですが。: ……Um, the Prince is a follower of Aigis, actually.
m300277.……あの御方からすれば、娘のようなものですから。\nそれを責めるのは酷というもの:
……To that First One, she was like a daughter.
It would be cruel to blame her for it,
but that is how it was.
m300277.……いえ、弱気になっていてはいけませんね。\n王子、飛行船から遺跡に移る準備をし:
……No, I must not let doubt get the better of me.
Prince, let us prepare to transfer from the airship to the ruins!
m300277.……いや、轟く遠雷は、先程からこちらを\nずっと見張っているようだ。\n僕らが悪:
……No, the distant thunder has been watching us
from a while ago.
It seems to be judging whether we are evil or not.
m300277.……この門を知っているとは、\nあなたに命を下している者は、\n随分と古い知識を:
……To know of this gate,
the one who commands you
must possess quite ancient knowledge.
m300277.……しんがりは我らにお任せを。\n障壁よりこちらへ来ることは無いでしょうが、\n:
……Leave the rearguard to us.
They likely won't come this far from the barrier, but
we'll wear down their forces as much as we can.
m300277.……そうだな。\n英雄殿、手を貸せなくてすまないが、\n少しでもこの情報が助けに:
……I suppose so.
Hero, I apologize for not being able to lend you a hand, but
I would be glad if this information proves helpful in any way.
m300277.……ですが、アイギス様も、\nアダマス様も、ケラウノス様も、\n今は力を失ってい:
……But Aigis,
Adamas, and Keraunos
have all lost their power. What are we supposed to do……?
m300277.……どういうこと？\nあのアンデッドたちが、公爵と一心同体ってこと？:
……What does that mean?
Are those undead one with the Duke?
m300277.……なるほど、想定以上の戦力です。\nこれは報告を上げておいた方が良さそうですね:
……I see. Their strength exceeds our expectations.
I think it would be wise to send a report.
m300277.……ふっ、そのまま伝えておこう。\nおそらくは愉悦に満ちた\n笑みを浮かべてくだ:
……Heh, I shall convey it as is.
She will likely be smiling,
filled with delight.
m300277.……まさか、物質界から\n天界の門を超えて来る者がいるとは。:
……To think someone from the material world
would actually cross the gate to the heavens.
m300277.……やれやれ、やはりこれでは倒せぬか。\nだが良い実験となった。今宵は感謝してお:
……I see, so I cannot be defeated this way.
But it was a fine experiment. I shall be grateful for it tonight.
m300277.……ヴァンパイア公爵、撤退しました。\n周囲のアンデッドの気配も消えましたね……:
……The Vampire Duke has retreated.
The presence of the surrounding undead is gone too…….
m300277.……久しぶりだから上手くできるか分からないけど、\nうん、ちょっと頑張ってみよう:
……It's been a while, so I'm not sure if I can do it well,
but yeah, let's give it a try.
m300277.……他に手がない以上、仕方ありませんね。\nそれでは古い天界の門にご案内します。:
...If there are no other options, then so be it.
Allow me to guide you to the old gate of heaven.
m300277.……公爵、若きヴァンパイアよ、\nあの女に伝えておきなさい。\n次は封印程度では:
……Duke, you young vampire,
convey this to that woman.
Next time, sealing will not suffice.
m300277.……厄介だな。\n公爵がいくつも生命を持っているようなものか。:
……That's troublesome.
It's as if the Duke possesses multiple lives.
m300277.……天界、いったいどんな所なのでしょう。\n私たち人間が、踏み入って良い場所なの:
……What is the realm of the heavens, truly?
Is it a place where we mere mortals are permitted to tread?
m300277.……王子、分かっていますわね？\n私のハルパーにもアダマス様の加護がありますわよ:
…… Prince, you know, don't you?
My harp also bears the blessing of Adamas-sama.
m300277.……王子、後で観客席の裏にいらっしゃい。\n神器の継承者として教育してあげますわ:
……Prince, come to the back of the audience seats later.
I'll give you some proper education as the inheritor of the Sacred Artifact.
m300277.……王子ちゃん、もうちょっと勉強が必要ねぇ。\n諦めずに再挑戦するのよ？:
……Prince, you need a bit more studying.
Don't give up, and try again?
m300277.……珍妙な出で立ちだが、何と怖ろしい鎧だ。:
……An odd appearance,
but what a terrifying piece of armor.
m300277.……臭い？ 言われてみれば、\n何だか甘ったるい匂いが濃くなってきたような……？:
...Stinky? Now that you mention it,
that sweet, cloying smell seems to be getting stronger...
m300277.あ、それから制限時間にも注意してね？\n解答ボタンの看板を支えてる、\n兵士さん:
Oh, and watch out for the time limit, too?
Make sure to answer before the HP of the soldier supporting the answer button signboard runs out!
m300277.あぁっ、癒やし手の力が封じられているという話、\nちゃんと聞いていましたの！？\:
Aaah, did you actually hear the part about
the healing power being sealed away?!
Honestly, you're such a reckless brute…….
m300277.ああ、あの子たちのことですね。\n千年戦争以来、音信不通ですからね……。:
Ah, you mean those children.
We've had no word from them since the Millennium War…….
m300277.ああ。王子ともあろう者が、\nまさか不正行為をはたらくとはな。\n後で覚えておけ:
I did. For someone like the Prince to resort to such foul play.
Remember this, you scoundrel.
m300277.あの者は血族にして血族にあらず、\n我ら最初のヴァンパイアと共に生み出され、\n:
That one is of the blood, yet not truly of it.
She was born alongside our first vampires,
but she came into being twisted and flawed.
m300277.あら、さっきから聞いていれば、\nあなたたちも王子にこっそり答えを教えていたでし:
Oh my, if I had been listening, you two have been secretly giving the Prince the answers all along, haven't you?
Now then, Prince. Go ace every question with ease.
m300277.あらあらぁ、王子ちゃんに限って\nズルなんてしないと思うけれどぉ、\nもし反則し:
Oh my, oh my~ I'd never expect the Prince to cheat, but~
if anyone breaks the rules, there will be a p-u-n-i-s-h-m-e-n-t, you know♪
m300277.あれだけの巨石だ、剣で斬るってわけにもいかないな。\n石の落ちてこない所に陣取る:
With boulders that big, we can't exactly just cut them down with swords.
We'll have to set up camp somewhere the rocks aren't falling.
m300277.いえ、先にお客さんみたいよ。\nよっぽどこの墓所を調査されたくないみたいね。:
No, it seems we have visitors.
They really don't want this burial ground investigated.
m300277.いわば生命の鎧みたいなものよ。\n公爵はあのアンデッドたちの魂を、\n自分の生命:
Think of them as a suit of living armor.
The Duke is connecting the souls of those undead
to his own life force.
m300277.う、うんっ！\n――あっ、天使……様たちが来たよ！:
Y-Yes!
――Ah, the angels…… my lords are here!
m300277.うぅぅ、制約だらけで大変ですのに、\nまだ続きがありますの……？:
Uuu, we're dealing with so many restrictions and it's already tough,
and there's still more to come……?
m300277.うぇぇぇ……服から\nまだ甘ったるい匂いがするよぉ……。:
Ugh... I can still smell that cloying sweetness
lingering on my clothes...
m300277.え、えーっと！ そうだ、クイズ開始の前に！\nレオラちゃん、\nズルして両方選ん:
E-eh? Wait! Before we start the quiz!
Leora-chan,
could you tell us what happens if someone cheats and picks both?
m300277.えぇ、私たちが堕天するより以前に使っていた、\n今の天界の民には知られていない門:
Yes. There is a gate that we used
before our fall from heaven.
The current inhabitants of the heavens are unaware of its existence.
m300277.えぇ。何しろ私たちの知る古い門は、\nはるか上空に存在しているのですから。:
Yes. After all, the old gate we know of
is located far up in the sky.
m300277.えぇと、サンダーバードが近くにいるってこと？\nまぁでも、伝承によれば警戒心は強:
Um, so a Thunderbird is nearby?
Well, I've heard that while they are wary,
they are harmless as long as we don't attack first.
m300277.えぇと、私の時にはケラウノス様が、\n神の楔の奇跡で、私に神性を付与してくれたん:
Well, when it was my turn, Lord Keraunos
used the miracle of the God's Wedge to grant me divinity.
That allowed me to pass through the barrier freely…….
m300277.お、王子！ よく分かりませんが危険です！！\n慎重な采配をお願いします……！！:
P-Prince! I don't fully understand what's happening,
but this is dangerous!!
Please exercise caution……!!
m300277.おぉぉ～！ やったよ！ もう知り合いみたいだよ！\nこれなら、すぐこっちに来てく:
Ooh~! We did it! It's like we already know them!
Maybe they'll come over right away!
m300277.おかげで、ちょっとだけ時間が稼げましたけどね……。:
Well, it did buy me
a little bit of time...

m400387.──とはいえ、カラザもまた、\nアルミラージの前に敗北した者の一人。\nラタトス: —That said, I too once fell to Almirage. Blaming only Ratatoskr is a bit harsh.

They're not just cute, mischievous, hungry rabbits.

m400387.まあ、そこで冷静な判断ができていたら、\nカワイイの権化アルミラージという危険因: Well, if we'd kept a cool head, we might not have let the dangerous ‘embodiment of cuteness' Almirage go completely berserk.

m500472.叡智の園からも人を出そうかな。\nもう穴熊を決め込む余裕もなさそうだ。\n暇そう:
I suppose we should send people from the Garden of Wisdom too.
It doesn't look like we have the luxury of staying in our burrows anymore.
I'll drag out some of the idle ones.
m500472.各々方、ご協力に感謝いたします。: I am grateful for everyone's cooperation.
m500472.周囲へでたらめに毒液を放つほど追い込まれて……\nいえ、毒が漏れ出ていると言った:
It's being pushed to the point of spraying poison indiscriminately…
No, it would be more accurate to say the poison is leaking out.
m500472.地形を利用して押し留めていますが、それも限界です。\n兵士たちの疲労も激しく、間:
We're using the terrain to hold them back, but it's reaching its limit.

The soldiers are exhausted, and a new assault is likely to begin soon.
m500472.宴会であれば……我がパヤモ領が誇る伝統の……\nタケノコフェスティバルをご覧に入:
If it's a banquet… let me show you the traditional pride of my Payamo territory…
The Bamboo Shoot Festival…
m500472.射手と癒し手の配置、連携には細心の注意が必要ですね。: We need to be extremely careful with the placement and coordination of our archers and healers.
m500472.我らと兵の命を全て使い潰したところで、\n一週間も保たないだろうと推測されます…:
Even if we expend every last soldier and every drop of our strength,

I estimate we won't last a week…
m500472.手遅れになる前に前線の連中を退かせろ。\nここから先は、我々で彼奴らを受け持つぞ:
Pull the front line back before it's too late.

From here on, we'll deal with them ourselves.
m500472.毒への対策がないとすぐに動けなくなっちゃいます！: Without a countermeasure for the poison, we'll be immobilized in no time!
m500472.汚染された魔界の土壌も早速浄化が進んでいる。\nそう時間をかけずとも元の状態に戻:
Purification is already underway for the contaminated soil of the Demon Realm.
It should return to its original state without taking much time.
m500472.深い霧と、濁り切った空気……この先に、魔神が。: Thick fog, and air so heavy it's suffocating… The Demon Gods lie ahead.
m500472.王子、力を貸してください。これは魔界を守る戦いです。: Prince, lend us your strength. This is a battle to protect the Demon Realm.
m500472.王子、至急魔界へ援軍を送りましょう。: Prince, we must send reinforcements to the Demon Realm immediately.
m500472.王子様、アスタロトは迂闊に倒したら駄目です！\nあれ、でもここで絶対に倒さなきゃ:
Prince, we can't just carelessly defeat Astaloth!
But we absolutely have to take it down here, and—
m500472.現在、魔神とその眷属が魔界を進行中だ。\n棲み家を追われた魔物たちの暴走も相まっ:
The Demon Gods and their subordinates are currently advancing through the Demon Realm.

Combined with the rampaging of the demons who have been driven from their homes,

the entire region has descended into chaos overnight.
m500472.瘴霧が、バルバトスに集まって──！？: The miasma is gathering around Barbatos—!?
m500472.私はアスタロトの毒の方が怖いかなー。\n麻痺とかさせられちゃったら最悪かも。:
I'm more afraid of Astaloth's poison, though.
If it paralyzes us, that would be the worst.
m500472.突如あの二体が手を組んだ原因の究明は進んでいない。\n偶然か、我々の調査能力不足:
We haven't been able to determine why those two suddenly joined forces.
Was it a coincidence, a lack of investigative capability on our part, or perhaps—
m500472.美しい戦いではなかったが、勝利は勝利だ。\n見ろ、あの無口な領主が珍しく騒いでお:
It wasn't a beautiful battle, but victory is victory.
Look, that taciturn lord is making a rare scene.
m500472.考えるまでもなく、最悪のシナリオですね……。: It goes without saying, but that would be the worst-case scenario…
m500472.聞いたことある……これ、狩人の瘴霧だ。\n魔神バルバトスが本気の本気になった証、:
I've heard of this before… This is the Hunter's Miasma.
It's proof that the Demon God Barbatos is getting serious for real.
A declaration that he will never let his prey escape.
m500472.自分でも体内の毒素が制御できていないみたい。\n今のアスタロトはほとんど爆弾みた:
It looks like it can't even control the toxins inside its own body.
Right now, Astaloth is basically a walking bomb.
m500472.証拠を残さない何者かの仕業、ですか。: The doing of someone who leaves no evidence.
m500472.逃げる、避ける、防ぐ。どれにせよ命を大事に、だな！: Run, dodge, or defend. Whatever you do, keep your life safe, all right!
m500472.部隊の編制、輸送の時間を考えると、\nもはや一刻の猶予すらもありません。:
Considering the time needed for unit formation and transport,

we don't even have a moment to spare.
m500472.際限なく溜め込んだ魔力が内部で臨界に達した場合、\n溢れた毒素と瘴気が物質界にま:
If the magic power they have hoarded without limit reaches a critical point,

the overflowing toxins and miasma could leak into the Material World.
m500472.魔神バルバトスと魔神アスタロトが手を組んだ。\nこう言えば、嫌でも現在の状況が分:
The Demon Gods Barbatos and Astaloth have joined forces.

That should make the gravity of the situation clear enough.
m500472.魔神バルバトスの操る瘴霧による、\n呼吸不全と視界不良、厄介ですね……。:
The miasma controlled by the Demon God Barbatos is causing

respiratory failure and obstructed vision. It's a nuisance…
m500472.（魔神……もう出てこないと……いいなぁ……）: (I hope the Demon Gods don't show up again…)
m500472.～～～～ッ！ とにかく安全重視で頑張ってください！: ~~~~! Anyway, please do your best while prioritizing safety!

m900198.(これ以上消耗しては天使共に\n付け入る隙を与えかねん……やむをえん！): (If we keep wasting energy, we'll give the angels an opening… No choice!)
m900198.(グッ……ぐぬぬぅッ！！ \n天使共との戦いの前に、せめてアレは、\nアレだけは: (Grr… gnuh…! Before the battle with the angels, I thought I had to at least recover that… that one…)
m900198.――ふはは！ どうしたどうした！\n貴様等人間共の寄る辺である鳥籠も、\n随分と:
——Fuhaha! What's the matter, what's the matter!
Your pathetic little birdcage, the refuge of you humans, has become quite a pitiful sight!
m900198.……これ以上の深追いは危険かと。\nそれに強靭な肉体を持つ巨人族とは言えあの手傷: …Pursuing them further would be too risky. And even those sturdy giants, with those wounds, won't be able to move much for a while.
m900198.……ごめん、皆の言う通り。\nまずは傷の手当が先決。: …Sorry, you're right. First things first—tending to our wounds.
m900198.……っ！？ 待って皆……。\nヘカトンケイルの力が更に強く……！:
…!? Wait, everyone…
Hekatonkheir's power is getting stronger…!
m900198.……ところが、ヘカトンケイル達は与えられた\n神の力にさえも抗い、その力を己がも: …But the Hekatonkheir brothers even resisted the divine power granted to them, claiming it as their own.
m900198.……ふん。その忌々しき剣さえなければ、\nヘカトンケイル様の真の力にて、\n今頃: …Hmph. If it weren't for that cursed sword, we would have already crushed everything with Hekatonkheir's true power.
m900198.……ッ！ 逃がさない！\n巨人は、私が一人残らず……！: …! I won't let them escape! I'll take down every giant myself…!
m900198.……ヘカトンケイル様は長き眠りから\n目覚めたばかり。その真の力を呼び覚ますには:
…Hekatonkheir has only just awakened from a long slumber.
To summon his true power would normally take many more years.
m900198.……実は今、ボク達の国が\n大量の巨人達に襲われているんです。: …Actually, right now our country is being attacked by a massive horde of giants.
m900198.……我ら巨人族に歯向かいし事。\n後悔して滅びゆくがいいわ！:
…Those who defy us giants.
May you regret it and perish!
m900198.あの装具に秘められた巨人の闘争本能は、\n巨人に敵対していた者達……すなわち天使: The giant's combat instinct sealed within it is directed especially toward those who opposed the giants—namely angels and humans.
m900198.えぇ、この好機を逃しません！: Yes, we won't miss this chance!
m900198.おそらくは、エレーヌさんの持つ剣と同様、\nかつてあの地の人々が巨人に対抗する為: I suspect, like Elene's sword, it was forged long ago by the people of that land to oppose the giants…
m900198.お待ちくださいエレーヌさん！\n戦いに勝利したとは言え、\n兵の皆さんの被害も甚: Please wait, Elene! Even though we've won, the troops have suffered heavy losses!
m900198.お願いします王子様。どうか、\nどうか僕達の国を救うのに力を貸してください！: Please, Prince. I beg you, lend us your strength to save our nation!
m900198.ぐ、ぐおおおおお！\n馬鹿な……人間如きの何処に\nこれ程の力が……ごふぉぁッ！: Ggh— GOOOOOAA! Foolish… how could a mere human possess such power… Gah!
m900198.ぐぬ……人間の分際でここまで粘るとはな……。: Grr… For a mere human to cling on this long…
m900198.これ程ボロボロになるまでよく堪えました。\n……後は我々にお任せ下さい！:
You held out this long despite being so battered.
…Leave the rest to us!
m900198.す、すみません、いきなり大声で。\nでも、一刻も早く王子様に\n報せなきゃいけな:
S-sorry for shouting out of nowhere.
But there's something I must report to you as soon as possible...
m900198.そ、そんな……っ！ まさか、\nボク達の国に攻めて来たのは……！: N-no…! Could it be that they've come to attack our land…!
m900198.そうして生まれたのが、神獣であり、巨人でもある\n『神獣ヘカトンケイル』だと文献: Thus, according to the texts, the being that was born is the “Divine Beast Hekatonkheir”—both a divine beast and a giant.
m900198.そして黒い体皮の長男は彼ら兄弟の中で最も優れ、\n弟二人の能力を兼ね備えていたと: And the eldest, black-skinned, is said to be the most superior of the three, possessing both of his younger brothers' abilities.
m900198.それでもありがとう。皆が来てくれなかったら、\n今頃この国は……ん？ なんだろう: Still, thank you. If none of you had shown up, this kingdom…huh? What's that?
m900198.それと……助けに来てくれてありがとう。\n私、いつも助けてもらってばっかりだね。: And…thanks for coming to help. I'm always the one getting rescued.
m900198.それと、エレーヌさん達が見つけた、\n城壁の中にあった装具についてなのですが。\: Also, about the armor Elene and the others found inside the walls— that armor radiates an incredibly strong giant's power.
m900198.そんな強力な巨人の力に目を付けた天界は、\n三兄弟を罠にはめ捕え、神獣の力を与え: Seeing such powerful giant power, the heavens set a trap, captured the three brothers, bestowed divine power upon them, and tried to turn them into the gods' elite troops…
m900198.そんな気になさらないでください。\n私達も普段は助けて頂いていますから。: Please don't worry about it. We're the ones who're usually being saved.
m900198.だが、それもここまでのようだな。\nそろそろトドメと……。:
But that seems to be as far as it goes.
Time to finish this…
m900198.だが貴様達との戦いにより、ヘカトンケイル様の\n眠りし闘争心が奮い起こされた……: But through our battle, his dormant fighting spirit has been stirred… Soon, his true power will awaken!
m900198.ですがあれ程強力な力を秘めた装具、\n着用者の心身にも大きな影響を与えかねません: But such a potent piece would inevitably affect the wearer's mind and body as well.
m900198.どうかしたのエレーヌ？ ……あれ？\nなんだろう、壁の中に何かが……。: What's wrong, Elene? …Huh? Something's moving inside the wall.
m900198.ひとまずの危機は去ったと\n言えるのではないでしょうか。: I think we can say the immediate crisis has passed.
m900198.ふん、人間如きがどれほど増えようとも同じ事だ。\nヘカトンケイル様の力の前に、\:
Hmph, no matter how many humans multiply, it's the same.
Before Hekatonkheir's power,
the feeble humans' strength is nothing.
m900198.まるで巨人の強い闘争本能を\nそのまま宿したかのような、恐るべき力です。: It's a terrifying strength, as if it's taken on the very fighting instinct of a giant.
m900198.や、やった……ボクたち、勝ったんだ！: We… we did it… we won!
m900198.エレーヌ、遅くなってゴメン！\n皆を連れて来たよ！！:
Elene, sorry I'm late!
I brought everyone!!
m900198.ヘカトンケイルが復活したあの後、\n来る巨人達の脅威に備え、国の調査団で\nヘカ: Since Hekatonkheir's revival, we've been preparing for the threat of the incoming giants, and our nation's research team has been investigating Hekatonkheir.
m900198.ヘカトンケイル様が力を取り戻した今、\n最早貴様達に用はない。巨人族の本気の力に:
Now that Hekatonkheir has regained his strength,
we have no use for you. We'll crush you with the true might of the giants! Prepare yourselves!
m900198.ルミアン……それに王子達も……来てくれたんだ。: Lumian… and the princes too… they came.
m900198.並の人ではとても扱いきれない危険な力です。\nですが、王子であればきっとその力を: It's a dangerous force no ordinary person could handle. Still, I believe you, Prince, can master it… I have faith.
m900198.人間如きがうぬぼれよって。\nまさか今までがヘカトンケイル様の\n全力だと思った:
Humans getting cocky.
You don't really think all this was Hekatonkheir's full power, do you?
m900198.今はなんとかエレーヌが巨人の力を\n抑えてくれています。\nでも、それもいつまで:
For now, Elene is somehow suppressing the giants' power.
But that can't last forever…
m900198.今更気づいたところでもう遅い。此度の侵攻は\nヘカトンケイル様の力を取り戻し、\: Realizing it now is too late. This invasion is merely a foothold to reclaim Hekatonkheir's power and march into the heavens.
m900198.圧してる……勝てる、勝てるよ皆！: We're pressing them… we can win, we can win, everyone!
m900198.堕天した身ではありますが、天界に無益な\n血が流れずに済んだことを嬉しく思います:
Though I've fallen, I'm glad no needless blood was shed in the heavens.
…Thank you, Prince.
m900198.大丈夫ですか、エレーヌさん！\n……ッ！？ 酷い怪我を……！:
Are you alright, Elene-san!
…!? Such terrible injuries…!
m900198.巨人達の中には、初めて見る\n炎を纏った巨人の姿もありました。: Among the giants, we even saw a giant cloaked in flames for the first time.
m900198.巨人達を率いているのはギガース、\nそれに……復活した神獣ヘカトンケイル。: The giants are led by Gigars, and also… the resurrected divine beast Hekatonkheir.
m900198.彼らがあの地を制したとあれば、\n次は天界へと進軍を開始していた事でしょう。: Had they seized that land, they'd have moved on to the heavens next.
m900198.本来であれば、使わずにいる事が一番なのでしょう。\n……ですが、激化する戦いの中: Ideally it should stay unused. …But in the heat of battle, we may find a moment when we need that power.
m900198.本能の赴くままに力を振るってしまえば、\nその力は人々自身にも牙をむきかねない。: If one were to wield that power heedlessly, it could turn on its own users. That's probably why it was sealed away, never used.
m900198.王子、もしも巨人の装具を\n着用して戦われるのであれば\n称号を『百の巨腕を超え: Prince, should you choose to don the giant's armor, please change your title to “The Mighty Fist that Surpasses a Hundred Giant Arms.”
m900198.王子、巨人族との激戦お疲れ様でした。\nこれでひとまずは、彼らの野望を\n阻止で:
Prince, thank you for the hard fight against the giants.
With this, we've at least halted their ambitions, I think.
m900198.見つかった古い文献によれば、\nヘカトンケイルは元々、天界に敵対する\n巨人の三: According to ancient texts we found, Hekatonkheir was originally three giant brothers who opposed the heavens.
m900198.赤い体皮の次男は猪突猛進。投石は苦手なれど、\nその剛力は巨人族の中でも随一を誇: The middle brother, red-skinned, charges head-first. He's not good at stone-throwing, but his sheer strength is unrivaled among giants, and he excels at crushing enemies with massive boulders.
m900198.青き体皮の三男は常に冷静沈着、\n一度の投石で数多の敵を仕留める程の投石の名手。: The youngest, with blue skin, is always calm and composed, a master stone-thrower who can fell countless foes with a single toss.

m900456.――それでは、\nエキーオーン討伐の作戦会議を始めましょうか。: ――Then, let's begin the strategy meeting for the Equeon subjugation.
m900456.――ッ！？\n王子、エキーオーンから強大な魔力の歪みが！:
——! ?
Prince, a massive distortion in magical power from Equeon!
m900456.――強き者よ、俺を殺してくれ、って。: ——“Strong one, please kill me,” he's saying.
m900456.――男の友情ってやつぅ？: ――So, that's what brotherhood between men is like, huh?
m900456.――神獣エキーオーン。\nこの世界は、俺たちが守っていく。:
――Equion.
This world is one we will protect.
m900456.……それにしても、\nエキーオーンの最後の表情、見た？:
……By the way,
did anyone else see Equeon's expression at the end?
m900456.……っ！！\n殿下の姿を見た瞬間に、魔力が増大しました！:
……!!
His magical power is surging the moment he sees Your Highness!
m900456.……俺も同意見だ。\nそれほどの誇りを持つ戦士なら、\n暴走し、守るべき世界に仇:
……I agree.
A warrior with that much pride wouldn't want to go berserk
and become a threat to the very world he swore to protect.
m900456.……彼が、そう伝えることを望んだの。\n自分は神獣としては失敗作だからって。:
……He wanted it to be conveyed that way.
Saying he was a failed product as a Divine Beast.
m900456.……神獣エキーオーンの魔力、霧散していきます。\n周囲の墓標の魔力も……。:
……Equion's magical power is dissipating.
The magic in the surrounding monuments is fading, too……
m900456.ああ。\nだからこその、あの表情なんだろうね。:
Ah.
That's exactly why it wore that expression.
m900456.あれは、人生――いや、神獣生か？\nその最後を戦士として終えられた誇りもあるだろ:
It was also pride, I think.
Pride in having ended its life—no, its divine life—
as a warrior, to the very last.
m900456.あれはただの伝説の類で、\n死を怖れる人の感情が生み出した\n創作神話だと思って: I had assumed it was merely a legend, a fictional myth born from the fears of those who feared death……
m900456.いや、それもあるだろうが……。: Well, that's probably part of it, but…….
m900456.えぇっ、そんなに食べられないよ！？: Ehh? I can't eat that much!
m900456.おっ、やっと来たか。\n武具のサイズ直し、終わったか？:
Oh, you're finally here.
Did you finish resizing the armor?
m900456.おや……？\nエキーオーンの魔力は消えたのに、\n剣と鎧だけ、なぜか残っています:
Oh, my……?
Equion's magic is gone, yet
his sword and armor remain for some reason?
m900456.けれど、女神アイギス様がそんな彼らを救ったの。\nスパルトイたちを束ねて、ひとつ:
But Goddess Aigis saved them.
She bound the Spartoi together, made them into a single Divine Beast,
and suppressed their rampaging power.
m900456.ここで、ずっと、自身を打ち倒す戦士が来ることを\n待ち続けていたのですね。:
He has been waiting here, all this time,
for a warrior to come and end his life.
m900456.これからも、彼らの意志を忘れずに、\n歩み続けなければいけませんね……。:
We must keep their will in mind
and continue to move forward…….
m900456.これは……王子、兵に指示を！\nエキーオーンの正面から退避させて！！:
This is… Prince, give the orders!
Pull your troops back from Equeon's front!!
m900456.しばらくは、あの辺りも静かになるだろう。: It should stay quiet around there for a while.
m900456.じゃあ、使わないわけにはいかないわね。: Well then, we'd better put them to use.
m900456.じゃあ、倒しにいかないとか……。\nエキーオーン、どんな力を持った神獣なの？:
So we're just going to leave him alone and…?
What kind of power does Equeon even have?
m900456.じゃなくて……はい、これがエキーオーンの武具だよ。\n身にまとう時は、称号を\n:
I mean…… yes, this is Equeon's armor.
When you equip it, please set the title to
"Bearer of the Undying Will."
m900456.そして女神アイギスに救われ、騎士として\n世界の守護者となった、偉大なるエキーオ:
And then the goddess Aigis saved them, and they became
the world's guardians as knights. The great Equion.
Since the Prince has taken up their cause, their battle lives on.
m900456.そして戦後は、己の力を暴走させないために、\n犠牲となったスパルトイたちと共に、:
And after the war, to prevent his power from going berserk again,
he was sealed on this earth along with the sacrificed Spartoi, if I recall correctly.
m900456.それが、神獣エキーオーン……。: So that is the Divine Beast Equeon……
m900456.ただ、正確にこの時代に伝わっていない事実があって――: However, there is one fact that has not been accurately passed down to this era――
m900456.だからこそ、神獣としてではなく、\n共に戦った者としてだけ、\n名を残すことを望:
I see. That's why he wished to be remembered not as a Divine Beast,
but only as one who fought alongside us.
m900456.だが、そのエキーオーンが復活したんだろう？: But that Equeon has awakened, hasn't he?
m900456.では、この武具はおふたりにお任せしますね。: In that case, I'll leave these weapons to the two of you.
m900456.ところが、半分は作り話じゃないのよ。: But it turns out half of it isn't fiction.
m900456.とても、安心した様子が伝わってきました。\n王子と出会ったことで、\n任せられる:

m920089.――う、うおおおおおぉぉっ！？\n滑る、地面が滑るぞっ！ だが、これなら\nあの:
——Ugh, uooo-oooooo!? The ground's slick!
But if I keep sliding I might dodge that mech!
m920089.――ええい邪魔な人間め。\nそのミスリルドラゴンの卵を、\n大人しくこちらに渡さ: Damn you meddling humans. Hand over that mithril dragon egg, and do it quietly!!
m920089.――く、くそっ！ このままでは\n書片を全て奪われてしまう！: —Damn it! If this continues, we'll lose all the fragments!
m920089.――ふふ、この術式を使えば、\n力で魔神を抑えつつ\n使役することが可能な筈……: —Heh, with this formula I should be able to suppress the demon god with force and command it...
m920089.――書片の運び屋が逃げたのはこちらの方角でしたね。\n王子、氷の上は滑るので\n:
——The smuggler who ran off was heading this way.
Prince, the ice is slippery—watch your step.
m920089.――王子、ここがグリモワールが取引されている\n魔界のマーケットです。\n早く取: —Prince, this is the demon-world market where the Grimoire is being traded. Let's get it back quickly.
m920089.――王子、こっちだ！\n急がないと、聖銀竜の卵が\n竜人の手に……む、あれは！: Prince, over here! If we don't hurry, the Holy Silver Dragon's egg will fall into the drake-men's hands… what's that!
m920089.――王子、悪魔研究者の棲家はここよ。\nあれはっ！！:
—Prince, the demon researcher's lair is right here.
There!
m920089.――王子！\n術式の中に魔神の姿が……！: —Prince! The demon god's shape appears within the formula...!
m920089.――皆、急いで。このままじゃ\nヴェルティに魔神を召喚されちゃう。: —Everyone, hurry. If we keep this up, Velty will summon the demon god.
m920089.――追いつきましたよ、ヴェルティさん！\n大人しく書片を……あぁっ！:
――We've caught up, Velty-san!
Hand over the fragments… ahh!
m920089.……。\nこうなったら強引に奪うまでだわ！: …If it comes to this, I'll just take it by force!
m920089.……うるさいわね。今いい所なのよ、\n邪魔しないでくれない？: …You're noisy. I'm in the middle of something, so could you not get in my way?
m920089.……くっ。\n信仰の欠片もない奴らめ……。: …Ugh. You lot have no shred of faith…
m920089.……こうなっては仕方がない。\n上手くいくかは判らぬが、キメリエス様の\n完全な: …It can't be helped now. I don't know if it'll work, but we have no choice but to summon Lord Kimeries in his full form…!
m920089.……ここで彼女を捕らえておけば、\n奴らの研究を止めることもできていたかも\nし: …If we'd captured her here, we might have stopped their research… I'm sorry.
m920089.……そう、その根性だけは認めてあげる。\nそれじゃあね、バイバイ。:
...Right, I'll give you credit for that determination.
Well then, goodbye.
m920089.……それほどまでに研究に拘るとは。\nもしかして、何か深刻な\n理由でもあるんで: …You're that obsessed with your research. Could there be some serious reason behind it?
m920089.……だから何？ 別に、\n貴方達には関係ない事でしょう。: …So what? It's none of your business.
m920089.……っ！ 凄い数……とても私一人じゃ……\nううん、そんな事言ってられない……\: …! Such a huge number… I can't do this alone… No, I can't just say that… Even if my life ends, I have to protect those eggs…!
m920089.……なんてこと。\n早く全て奪い返さないと、\n悪魔が召喚されちゃうわ！:
…This is terrible.
We have to reclaim everything quickly, or the demon will be summoned!
m920089.……ひとまず竜人の方々は去ったようですね。\nあの、大丈夫ですか？: …It seems the drake-men have withdrawn for now. Um, are you alright?
m920089.……ふぅ、ようやく体が動くようになったわ。\nさて、研究の続きに取り掛からなきゃ: …Phew, my body finally feels like it can move again. Now I have to get back to my research.
m920089.……ま、待てっ！ \n悪魔研究者ヴェルティに渡す様に言われた。\nそれ以外は俺も:
...W-wait!
I was told to hand it over to the demon researcher Velty.
I don't know anything else!
m920089.……人の話を聞いていなかったの？\n実体の召喚はリスクが今の何倍も……: …Didn't you hear what I said? Summoning the actual form carries risks many times greater than now…
m920089.……人の顔に銃をつきつけるなんて物騒ね。\n私の邪魔をしないでちょうだい。: …Pointing a gun at someone's face is dangerous. Don't get in my way.
m920089.……何よ、引き止めないでくれる。\n早く研究の続きがしたいんだけど。: …What? You're not stopping me? I just want to get back to my research.
m920089.……凄い勢いで滑り去っていきましたね。\n一体何が…………。\n――！ 皆さん、:
…He slid away at incredible speed.
What on earth…
—! Everyone, enemy units ahead!
m920089.……別に報酬なんてどうでもいいわよ。\n私はグリモワールの研究ができれば\nそれ:
…The reward doesn't matter to me.
If I can study the Grimoire, that's enough.
If you're going to be a nuisance, just go away.
m920089.……召喚に捧げた供物に加えて、\n私の寿命の半分を貴方にあげる。\nそれで充分で:
……In addition to the offering for the summoning, I'll give you half my lifespan.
That should be enough, right?
m920089.……我は深淵を統べし魔が一柱、\n魔神キメリエス。\n人間よ、我を呼び出したのは:
……I am Kimeries, a pillar of the abyss, the demon god.
Human, you summoned me, didn't you?
m920089.……本当にどうなっても\n知らないんだからね。: ……No matter what happens, I'm not responsible.
m920089.……気の早い人達ね。\nこの魔神はまだ実体じゃないわよ。: …You're all too eager. This demon god isn't material yet.
m920089.……良いだろう、その願い叶えてやる。\nだが悪魔の力を求めるのであれば、\n相応:
……Fine, I'll grant that wish.
But if you seek demonic power, you must pay the proper price.
m920089.……面倒ねぇ……まぁでも、\n研究の邪魔をされるのも、うっとうしいわ。\n邪魔者:
…What a hassle… Well, having my research interrupted is annoying.
I guess I'll have the meddler disappear quickly.
m920089.……？ と、此度の件本当に感謝致します。\nしばらくはまだここを離れられないです: …? Thank you sincerely for everything. I can't leave here just yet, but I'll return someday to thank you all properly.
m920089.あ、いえ、別に悪い訳では。\n……えっと、どうしましょう？: Ah, no, it's not bad at all. …Um, what should we do?
m920089.あの召喚された魔神を倒して\n魔界に追い返すしかないわ。\n……そう、簡単な話よ: We have no choice but to defeat that summoned demon god and drive it back to the demon realm… That's all there is to it.
m920089.あの研究者、これ程の速度でグリモワールの\n解読を進めておるとはのう。流石、\n: That researcher is advancing the Grimoire's deciphering at this speed—impressive. No wonder they're called the foremost authority on demon studies.
m920089.ありがとうございます、ドルチェさん。\n王子、一旦戻りドルチェさんからの\n報告: Thank you, Dolce. Prince, let's return for now and wait for your report.
m920089.えぇそう……よ……っ！\n（魔力がどんどん……もっていかれる。\nやっぱり準備な:
Yeah… right…!
(My magical power's being drained fast.
Without preparation, this is seriously tough…)
m920089.お、おい！ なにを言っているのだ！！\n願いを横取りするんじゃない！:
Hey! What are you saying!!
Don't steal the wish!
m920089.お、おのれェ。何度も我々の邪魔をしよっテ！\n覚えておれヨ、次こそハ必ず……\n:
You… you damned…! You keep getting in our way!
Remember this—next time I'll…
…Everyone, retreat!!
m920089.おぉ……神よ……。\nあの者達は、神を冒涜する不浄な輩なのです。\n奴らを滅ぼす:
Oh… great deity…
Those people are impure blasphemers of the divine.
Please lend us your power to crush them!
m920089.おぉ……神よ、どうか\nこの世界に終末をもたらし、\n新たな世界を――:
Oh… God, please bring about the end of this world
and forge a new one—
m920089.おぉ、いいところで会ったな王子！！\n我輩は探し物で忙しい、奴らの相手は\n頼ん:
Hey, what a coincidence, Prince!!
I'm busy looking for something, so handle those guys for me—
Farewell!!
m920089.おや、ゴブリン博士の姿が見えますね……。\n手に持っているのは書片ではないですか: Oh, I see the Goblin Doctor over there… Isn't that fragment he's holding?
m920089.お前みたいな、付きまとってくる不届き者どもに\n全て奪われてしまわない様に、念に: To keep you clingy imps from stealing everything, we split it up and smuggled the pieces separately.
m920089.か、風で書片がッ……！ \nお前達！ 急いで書片を追いかけるのダ！: The fragment… blown away by the wind! You! Chase after the fragment quickly!
m920089.き、貴様。\n多額の報酬を支払っているというのに。\n依頼主に向かってその態度は:
Y-you!
We're paying you a huge fee, and you act like that toward the client!
m920089.く……なるべく早くしてくれ。\nこの世界には、魔神様による御救いが\n早く必要な: …Do it as quickly as you can. This world needs the demon god's salvation soon.
m920089.くっくっく……。\nその通り。\n他の頁は既に仲間が持ち出しているだろう。:
Heh heh heh…
Exactly.
The other pages have already been taken by my comrades.
m920089.こ、このお姿は……キメリエス様……！！\nああぁぁぁ……神よ……\nこれでこの世: Th-this… Lord Kimeries…!! Ahhh… God… With this, the world will be saved…!
m920089.こうなれば、突破する他ない。\nいざという時は、このグリモワールの書片の術式を使: If it comes to this, we have no choice but to break through. When the time comes, we'll use the fragment's spell to summon… a demon… a god…!
m920089.こっちへ来い、悪魔召喚士！\nすぐにキメリエス様を呼び出せ！: Come this way, demon summoner! Summon Lord Kimeries at once!
m920089.この子が私以外の人に懐くなんて珍しい……\nあ、ちょっと！ こ、こらっ！\n頭の: It's rare for this one to warm up to anyone but me… Hey, stop that! Don't sit on my head! Get off!
m920089.この子達は下僕なんかじゃありません！\n大切な家族です……その言葉、\n撤回して: ???: They're not servants! They're precious family… Please, take back those words!!
m920089.この神々しき御姿……\n紛れもなく本物の\n魔神キメリエス様！:
That divine presence…
There's no doubt— the true demon god Kimeries!
m920089.この近辺では未起動の機甲兵も、\n見つかっています。\n恐らく、まだ多くの機甲兵:
We've also found some dormant mechs nearby.
Looks like many more are still sleeping.
m920089.これがグリモワールの書片だ。\n約束通り、あの研究者の元へきっちり運んでくれ。\: This is a Grimoire fragment. As promised, deliver it straight to that researcher. The reward's already waiting.
m920089.これは……そんなはずないわ。\nグリモワールは多数の術式が書かれた書物。\nこれ:
This… can't be.
A Grimoire is a book full of spells.
This looks like just a single page…
m920089.ご無事で何よりです。\n家族とは……この卵でしょうか？: I'm just glad you're safe. By family… do you mean this egg?
m920089.さぁ、グリモワールを渡しなさい。\nもちろん、渡さなかったらどういう事になるかは:
Hand over the Grimoire.
You know what'll happen if you don't, right?
m920089.しつこい奴らめ、\n神の復活を邪魔せんとする不届き者共が！\nキメリエス様、どう: You persistent fools, trying to thwart the god's resurrection! Lord Kimeries, please grant divine judgment upon them!!
m920089.せいぜい探し回るがいい。\n書片の量は膨大だ。\n全てを回収できるはずもない！:
Go ahead and hunt them down.
The amount of pages is massive.
You'll never recover them all!
m920089.そ、そんな……。\n魂を献上せねばならないのですか……！？\n神は我々を無償でお:
N-no…
We have to surrender our souls…!?
A god is supposed to save us freely!?
m920089.そうですね……。ずっと見張っているのですが、\n「吹雪」が吹いちゃうと、\n遠く: Indeed… I've been keeping watch, but when the blizzard blows in, you can't see anything far away…
m920089.そうですね……ひとまずは共に来て頂き、\n彼女の今後を考えましょう。\n王子、此: Right… For now, let's have her stay with us and think about her future. Prince, thank you for your efforts this time.
m920089.そこのゴブリン。\nこの銃で撃たれたくなければ、その書片を渡しなさい。: Hey goblin. Hand over that fragment or I'll shoot you with this gun.
m920089.そこまでよ！ そのグリモワールの\n書片をこっちに渡しなさい！: That's enough! Hand over those Grimoire fragments right now!
m920089.そのままの意味。魔神は本来、\n人が使役できるような存在じゃないわ。: Literally that. A demon god isn't something people can just command.
m920089.その時には何卒よろしくお願いします。: When that day comes, I hope you'll welcome me.
m920089.それだけ言いに来たの。それじゃあね。: That's all I came to say. See you.
m920089.それにしても、まさか古のグリモワールが、\nこんな所に封印されていたなんて。\n: Still, who would have thought the ancient Grimoire was sealed in a place like this… As expected of a demon hunter.
m920089.だ、大丈夫です。危ない所を助けて頂き\nありがとうございます。私はティファと言い: I-I'm fine. Thank you for pulling me out of that dangerous spot. I'm Tifa.
m920089.だから、今回は試しに、キメリエスの力の\nほんの一部だけを呼び出したのよ。: So this time I only called forth a tiny fragment of Kimeries' power as a test.
m920089.だから趣味。魔術書だったり、\n悪魔の事が書かれた本だったり。\nそういうのを読: Yeah, a hobby. Reading magical tomes, books about demons—just enjoy that stuff. Bad?
m920089.だが召喚に捧げられた供物、\n貴様のその身体は先に\n頂いておくとしよう。: But the offering you gave for the summoning—your body—I'll take that first.
m920089.ちっ……。\n見つかったか……。\nおい、運び屋。退路は確保してるんだろうな？: Damn… they found us… Hey, courier, you've secured an escape route, right?
m920089.ちっ、奴らここまで嗅ぎ付けるとは……ここで\n書片を奪われては元も子もない。\n:
Damn, they've tracked us this far… If they snatch the manuscript here, we're done for.
Hey, you fight too!
m920089.どうだ、ヴェルティ。\nグリモワールの解読は進んでいるか？:
How's it going, Velty?
Making progress on deciphering the Grimoire?
m920089.どうやら少し遅かったようね……。: Looks like we were a bit late…
m920089.どうやら竜人達に襲われているようですね。\nあのままでは彼女が危険です。\n急ぎ: It looks like the drake-men are attacking. She'll be in danger if we let this continue. Let's rescue her quickly!
m920089.な、なんだこの女！ 強引すぎるゾ！\n離せ、離すノダ！\nあ、ああーーーーーーー: Wh-what the—! Too aggressive! Let go, let go! Ah—!
m920089.な、何キョトンとした顔してるのよ！\nい、いきなり手なんて、握られたら\nお……: W-What's with that blank stare! I-I mean, if you just… grab my hand, it's only natural to be surprised!!
m920089.なな！？ 王子ども……！\n何を言ってるンダ。この書片は渡さんゾ！\n予算の大半: Wha—! Prince, kid…! What are you saying! I won't give up this fragment! I spent most of the budget to purchase it!
m920089.なるほど。では、次こそ実体の\nキメリエス様にお会いできるのだな？: I see. Then next time we'll finally meet the true form of Lord Kimeries, right?
m920089.なんだか王子、すっかり気に入られて\nしまったようですね。……あの、つかぬ事を\: It seems the Prince has completely won this little one over… If I may ask, what's this child's gender?
m920089.なんという雪……こう視界が悪くては\n教団員を見つけるのも一苦労ですね。: What a snowstorm… With visibility this bad, even finding cultists is a nightmare.
m920089.はい、よろしくお願いします。\n私達は引き続き書片の情報を集めましょう。\n王子:
Got it. We'll keep gathering info on the fragments.
Prince, good work today.
m920089.はい。この卵は竜族の中でも個体が非常に\n少ない聖銀竜、その卵です。: Yes. This is the egg of a Holy Silver Dragon, an extremely rare specimen among dragons.
m920089.はい。ですが、まだ辺りには運び屋が\n潜んでいるかもしれませんし、\n兵達には引: Yes. But there may still be smugglers lurking around, so I'll keep ordering the troops to continue searching.
m920089.はい。引き続き辺りの捜索を続けましょう。: Right. Let's keep searching the area.
m920089.ひとまずは教団員達を捕らえる事が出来ましたが……\n彼らが持ち去ったグリモワール: We've managed to capture the cultists for now, but the Grimoire fragments they stole can't be that insignificant.
m920089.ひとまずは機甲兵を\n鎮圧できたようですね。: Looks like we've managed to subdue the mech for now.
m920089.ふぅん……力の一部だけとはいえ、魔神キメリエスを\n退けるなんて……教団の連中よ: Hmph… even just a fragment of power, and you managed to repel Demon God Kimeries… That's far more useful for research than those cultists.
m920089.ふふふ。このグリモワールの書片ガあれバ、\n我らゴブリン軍の更なる戦力増強も見込: Heh heh. This Grimoire fragment should let our Goblin army boost its forces even more. The queen will surely be pleased.
m920089.ふん、人間に手を貸すのであれば\n同じ事じゃろうて。: Hmph, if you're willing to help humans, it's the same thing.
m920089.ふム、間違いないようだナ。\n……約束の金ダ、持っていくが良イ。: Hmm, that looks right. …I'll take the promised gold, alright.
m920089.ほらよ、これが例のグリモワールの書片だ。\n危ない橋を渡ってんだ、さっさと確認し: Here—this is the fragment of the Grimoire. We're crossing a dangerous bridge, so check it quickly.
m920089.まだ分かってないようだけど、\n私は、そこの甘い人間とは違うわ。: You still don't get it, but I'm not like those soft-hearted fools over there.
m920089.む、あれは、悪魔ハンタードルチェ！\nくそ、早くも嗅ぎつけたか。\n追い払ってや:
Huh, that's Dolce the demon hunter!
Damn, they've already sniffed it out.
I'll drive them away!
m920089.もう一度聞く、\nグリモワールをどこに運ぼうとしてた？: I'll ask once more: where were you taking the Grimoire?
m920089.やはり、話してくれそうもないですね……。\n一体これからどうしたら……。: As expected, he won't say a word… What are we supposed to do now?
m920089.アンナさん、彼らみたいな無法者に、\nそんな生ぬるい聞き方しても吐くわけないわ。: Anna, you can't expect a thug like him to answer a soft question. When you want answers, you do it like this.
m920089.ギャギャーッ！\nショヘン、ボアガ食ベタ。: Gyaaa! Shiten, the boa is eating it.
m920089.グリモワール、トンデイッタ！\nグリモワール、トンデイッタ！: Grimoire, it's insane! Grimoire, it's insane!
m920089.グリモワールに記載された特別な術式とはいえ、\n万が一にも呼び出した魔神を抑える: Even though it's a special formula written in the Grimoire, if we can't keep the summoned demon god restrained, I won't walk away unscathed.
m920089.グリモワールをどこに運ぼうとしてたんですか？: Where were you planning to take the Grimoire?
m920089.ゴブリン博士達は撤退したようですね。: Looks like the Goblin Doctor and his crew have withdrawn.
m920089.ドルチェさん……！\nそんな……銃口を額に向けるなんて……！: Dolce…! You can't… point a gun at his forehead like that…!
m920089.ドルチェさん、教団員の方から\nグリモワールを受け取りました。\nこの書片であっ:
Dolce-san, we received the Grimoire from the cultist.
Is this the right page?
m920089.ブツは既に複数の仲間の手に渡っている。\n残念だったな。: The pieces have already been passed to several of my comrades. Too bad for you.
m920089.ボ、ボアが食ベタだト！？\nば、馬鹿もンーーーーー！\n早く書片を吐かせロ！！: The boa's eating it!? You idiots—! Spit out the fragment quickly!! At this point the Prince and his party can use it too!
m920089.ミスリルドラゴンの連中め。竜族でありながら\n我ら竜人ではなく人間の下僕として使: Those mithril dragons… Even though they're dragons, they're being used as human servants instead of our kind. Where's their dragon pride gone?!
m920089.ヴェルティ……。聞いた事があるわ。\n確か悪魔研究の第一人者。:
Velty… I've heard of her.
She's supposedly a leading authority on demon research.
m920089.ヴェルティさんのあの様子……。\n魔神に操られてしまっているようです。\nこのま:
Velty-san's condition…
She's being controlled by the demon god.
If this continues, Velty-san's life is in danger…!
m920089.一応よろしくとは言っておくわ。\nでも、私の研究の邪魔は\n絶対にしないでね。:
I'll say “nice to work with you,” for the record.
But don't you dare interfere with my research.
m920089.予算の大半を使って買ったグリモワールを渡しタラ、\nワタクシ、女王様に殺されるノ: If I give up the Grimoire I bought with most of my budget, the queen will kill me! If I'm going to die, I can't hand it over!
m920089.事情が分からない？\n……まぁ今決まったばかりの事だしね。\nまったく、面倒臭い: You don't understand the situation? …Well, it's just been decided, after all. Honestly, it's such a hassle.
m920089.今の方が起動させてしまったのでしょうか……\n完全に暴走しています。可哀そうです:
Did we just trigger it…?
It's completely out of control. As sad as it is, we'll have to fight it to stop it.
m920089.任せておけ。金さえもらえれば、\nなんでも運んでやるさ。: Leave it to me. As long as I get paid, I'll transport anything.
m920089.依頼はこの書片とやらを運ぶだけの筈だ。\n護衛の為の金をもらっていない以上、\n: My job was only to deliver that fragment. Since I haven't been paid for any escort, I've got no obligation to guide you, even if you offered something.
m920089.全く、これだから人付き合いは嫌なのよ……\n……いい？ 私の目的は悪魔の研究ただ:
Honestly, this is why I hate dealing with people…
…Got it? My only goal is demon research, nothing else.
We're just allies of convenience, that's all.
m920089.凄いわ……知識が流れこんで来……っ！？\nぐっ……あ……\n……あぁっ………っ！:
Amazing… the knowledge is flowing in…!?
Ugh… ah…
…ahhh…!!
m920089.分りました！\n王子、追撃の準備をお願いします。\n「グリモワールの書片」を取り: Understood! Prince, please prepare the pursuit. Let's retrieve the Grimoire fragments.
m920089.別に私、世界の終末なんてどうでもいいもの。\n貴方達に協力したのは、魔神を呼ぶた:
I don't care about the world's end at all.
I only helped you so I could use you to summon the demon god.
m920089.勇猛な騎士が、魔界に堕ちて生まれた魔神ね。\nその強靭な鎧と剛剣の一振りで\n幾: A brave knight who fell into the demon realm and became a demon god. Legends say his indestructible armor and single mighty sword have razed countless nations.
m920089.危うく命が奪われる所だったのですよ？\n研究を続ければ、いつ本当に命を落とすか。: You almost had your life taken away, you know? If you keep pushing the research, you'll eventually lose your life for real.
m920089.召喚をする時は誰かしらの護衛の下\n安全な召喚を行う……まぁ体の良い監視でしょう: When we do summon, it'll be under someone's guard for a safe summoning… I guess it's a solid supervision.
m920089.吹雪の中では飛び道具を使う部隊は、\n遠くを狙えなくなるでしょう。: In a blizzard, any unit that relies on projectile weapons won't be able to hit anything far away.
m920089.嘆いてたってしょうがないわ。\n私の方で、引き続き奴らの足取りを\n探ってみる事: There's no point in whining. I'll keep tracking their movements myself and let you know if I find anything.
m920089.報告！ 教団員と思わしき輩は\n砦の方向に向かっているとのこと！: Report! The cultist-type individual is heading toward the fortress!
m920089.報告！ 教団員と思わしき輩を発見しました！\n山の方へと逃亡を謀っているようです:
Report! We've spotted a cultist-type individual!
They're trying to flee toward the mountains!
m920089.契約通り、我が知識の\n継承が済み次第その寿命の半分を頂く。: As agreed, once my knowledge transfer is complete, I'll claim half your lifespan.
m920089.実体は今よりも遥かに強大な力を持っている。\n完全に解読できるまでは、\n実体の: The true form wields power far beyond anything we have now. Until we fully decipher it, hold off on summoning the actual entity.
m920089.幼少の頃より育て上げれば我らに力を貸すだろうと\n卵を奪いに来たが……えぇい、退: We came to take the eggs, thinking they'd grow up to aid us, but if you won't step aside, we'll seize them by force!
m920089.彼らにとっては悪魔が神様なの。何を言っても無駄よ。\nいずれにしても、グリモワー: To them, demons are gods. No argument will change that. In any case, since the Grimoire contains a demon-summoning ritual, we can't let anyone have it!
m920089.待ちなさいヴェルティ。これ以上\nグリモワールの研究はさせないわ。: Hold it, Velty. I won't let you continue any more research on the Grimoire.
m920089.思ったより元気そうですね。: You seem more energetic than I expected.
m920089.悪魔を呼び出す書物……書片とは言え、\nあれを喰らって何の影響もないとは思えませ: A book that summons demons… even a fragment could have an effect if it's eaten.
m920089.悪魔を呼び出す術式を書いた禁断の書物……\n呼び出した所で、使役できなければ、\: A forbidden tome that contains the ritual to summon demons… Even if you summon one, if you can't control it, it'll just devour everything.
m920089.感心している場合ではない。もし正式な召喚が\n果たされれば、物質界はただでは済ま: This isn't the time to be impressed. If a proper summoning succeeds, the material world won't get off lightly...
m920089.我が名は魔神ビフロンス。\n我を召喚せし者よ。\n汝の望みを言うが良い。:
I am the demon god Bifrons.
Those who have summoned me.
State your wish.
m920089.握手って……嫌よ、他人の\n手に触るなんて……き、きゃぁっ！？: A handshake… No, I hate it, touching someone else's… Ah—!?
m920089.教団員の連中、それにヴェルティにも\n逃げられてしまったわね。: The cultists are gone, and Velty escaped as well.
m920089.敵は全て倒したようですが……。: Looks like we've taken down all the enemies…
m920089.既に契約は為された。\n望み通り、その魂の灯が消えるまで\n存分に我が力を振るう:
The contract has already been sealed.
As you wish, wield my power to your heart's content until that soul's flame fades.
m920089.書片すら食べようとしてしまうなんて。\n魔界ボアの食欲、恐るべしです。:
To think they'd even try to eat a fragment.
The demonic boa's appetite is terrifying.
m920089.書片を奪われれば貴様の研究も続けられなくなるぞ！\n召喚の準備はすぐに出来る。\: If the fragments are taken, you won't be able to continue your research! We can prepare the summoning right away. Come on, let's go!
m920089.最初に言った通りよ。今後は貴方達の下で\n悪魔の研究を行い、無暗やたらに\n危険: As I said at the start, from now on I'll conduct demon research under you and won't recklessly summon dangerous demons.
m920089.本当ですか！\nドルチェさん、王子、急ぎましょう。\n彼らはまだ近くにいるようで:
Really?
Dolce-san, Prince, let's hurry!
They're still nearby!
m920089.本当に気の早い人達……。\nまだ術式の全てを解読していないの。: You're really too eager... We haven't even decoded the entire formula yet.
m920089.正式な契約は貴方に話を通してからって\n話ではあったけど、もうこうして伝えたから: We talked about making it official once I've spoken with you, but I've already told you now. So I'll get back to research… What's that hand for?
m920089.毎度あり。それじゃ俺はこれで失礼するぜ。: Thanks as always. Well, I'll be taking my leave now.
m920089.王子、こっちよ。\n早くしないとグリモワールが奪われてしまうわ。:
Prince, this way.
Hurry, or the Grimoire will be taken.
m920089.王子、どうやら儀式が始まっているようね。\nだけど、まだ召喚はしていないみたい。: Prince, the ceremony seems to have started. But they haven't actually summoned anything yet. We need to stop the ritual quickly!
m920089.王子、ゴブリンが向かってきます。\n戦闘のご準備をお願いします。: Prince, goblins are heading our way. Prepare for battle.
m920089.王子、不用意に機甲兵を起動させてしまうと、\n暴走する危険性があります。\n慎重:
Prince, if you accidentally activate a mech it could go berserk.
Proceed cautiously!
m920089.王子、戦闘のご準備をお願いします。\n運び屋も現れるかもしれません、\n見つけ次:
Prince, prepare for battle.
The smuggler might show up, so grab any fragments we find.
m920089.王子、教団員が向かってきます！\n戦闘のご準備を！: Prince, the Cultists are approaching! Prepare for battle!
m920089.王子、運び屋のアサシンを捕らえました。\nですが、グリモワールの書片は所持してい: Prince, we captured the courier assassin, but he isn't carrying any Grimoire fragments.
m920089.皆さんが来てくれなければ\nどうなっていた事か……。\nありがとうございます！: If you hadn't come, who knows what would have happened… Thank you!
m920089.研究所の場所は調べればすぐにわかるわ。\n王子、アンナさん急いで向かいましょう。:
We could locate the lab in no time if we look it up.
Prince, let's hurry over with Anna.
m920089.私、これからは貴方達の下で\n悪魔の研究を続けていく事になったから。: From now on, I'll be continuing my demon research under your command.
m920089.私は悪魔の研究で得られた成果、価値のありそうな\n情報を貴方達に提供する。その代: I'll provide you with the results and any valuable information from my demon research. In return, you'll keep retrieving fragments and give them to me. That's all.
m920089.私一人じゃ、この子の家族を\n守り切る事が出来なかったと思います。\n本当に助か: I don't think I could have protected this child's family on my own. You really saved us.
m920089.良いだろう、契約は果たされた。\n受け取るが良い、我が英知を……！:
Very well, the contract is fulfilled.
Take it—my wisdom!
m920089.良かろう、その望み叶えよう。\n……対価は貴様の魂だ。\nその魂の灯が消えるまで:
Very well, I shall grant your wish.
…The price is your soul.
Our contract lasts until the flame of that soul is extinguished.
m920089.良くやったぞ、ヴェルティ。\nでは、早速召喚の儀を執り行おう。\n全員、術式の準: Well done, Velty. Then let's begin the summoning ritual right away. Everyone, prepare the formula.
m920089.趣味で魔神を召喚するような奴よ。\nとても野放しになんてできない。: Someone who summons demons as a hobby. We can't just let them run wild.
m920089.追加で依頼を受けても良いが、\n命の危険を伴う仕事だ。\n当然、高額を要求させて: I could take on extra work, but it's life-threatening, so I'll be asking for a hefty fee.
m920089.逃がさないわ！\n王子、急いで追いかけるわよ！: I won't let you escape! Prince, hurry and chase after them!
m920089.邪魔するわよ王子。: I'll get in your way, Prince.
m920089.間違いないですね。\n魔界マーケットで手に入れたのでしょう。\nしかし、こちらに: That's definitely it. He must've gotten it at the demon market. But will he hand it over…?
m920089.駄目です！ この卵は私の大事な家族……。\nあなた達に、渡すわけには絶対にいきま: ???: No! That egg is my precious family… I'll never give it to you!
m920089.騎士の姿をした魔神……。\nあれは『魔神キメリエス』か。: A demon god taking the form of a knight... That must be “Demon God Kimeries.”
m920089.魔界の瘴気の中では力が半減します。\n厳しい戦闘になるかと思いますが、\n王子、:
In the demonic miasma our power is cut in half.
It'll be a tough fight, so… Prince, please be especially careful.
m920089.魔界ボアが食べちゃうと危険ですね。\n他にも書片が落ちていないか、\n私は捜索を:
If the demonic boa eats it, that's dangerous.
I'll keep searching to see if any other fragments are left.
m920089.魔神を崇拝する教団員がこの地を何度も訪れていたの。\nなにかあるに違いないと思っ: Cultists who worship the demon god have visited these lands many times. I suspected something was up, but that it was the Grimoire—truly the worst.
m920089.魔神キメリエス、貴方の持つ\n悪魔の知識を私に寄越しなさい。: Demon god Kimeries, give me the demonic knowledge you possess.

m920113.――あてこそがぁ、悪逆非道の仙人を誅すべく、\nこの都に立ち上がったぁ……茨木童: —It is I, who has risen in this capital to punish the wicked, lawless hermit… Ibaraki-dōji!
m920113.――いいえ、こんなに素晴らしい舞台、\nここで終わってしまっては勿体無いわ。: No, a wonderful stage like this would be a waste to end here.
m920113.――おっと、それから王子。\n世話になった連中に挨拶を済ませたら、\nアタシも王: —And you, Prince. After you thank the folks who helped you, I'm heading to the kingdom too, so look after me.
m920113.――このまま演技を続けてください。\n大丈夫です、ここには私達がいますから。\n: —Please continue the performance. It'll be fine, we're here. Right, Prince?
m920113.――世界を救う、英傑のかぶきなんて、\n大盛況間違いなしってもんだろ？\nっつぅ: —Saving the world, a heroic kabuki— that's a guaranteed hit, right? So, please, make it happen!
m920113.――王子、次の街はこちらです。\nきっと皆さんお待ちかねですよ。: —Prince, the next town is this way. I'm sure everyone's been looking forward to it.
m920113.――王子、死した武者の亡霊を見かけた、\nという報告があったのは、この辺りだ。: —Prince, reports of a ghost of a fallen warrior have been sighted around here.
m920113.…………うぅっ、ありがてぇ！\nあんたはお天道様みたいな人だぜ……！！: …Ugh, thank you! You're like a shining sun himself…!!
m920113.…………へぇ、わかった。\nあんた達がそう言うんなら、任せてみるよ！: ………… I see. If you all say so, I'll leave it to you!
m920113.…………わかったよ。\nその目を見りゃ嘘じゃないって分かる。: …Got it. I can see you're not lying just by looking into your eyes.
m920113.……あれ？\nあっちの方に誰か……って、大変です！\nあの人、落ち武者に囲まれて: …Huh? Someone over there… This is bad! That person is surrounded by fallen warriors!
m920113.……えっ？ 気にしてない？\nほほーう、あんた中々に気っ風がいいね！: …Huh? You don't care? Hoho, you've got quite the easygoing attitude!
m920113.……え？\nラミィはさっき、自分は侍役をやりたいから\nお姫さま役はわたしに譲っ:
…Huh?
Ramii just said she wanted to be a samurai and would hand the princess role over to me…
m920113.……おや？\n王子、しばしお待ちを。あちらに人影が。: …Hm? Prince, please wait a moment. There's a figure over there.
m920113.……ちっ、ふわっと逃げちまいやがった。\nあれが仙人の力ってやつか……。: …Tch, they slipped away so easily. So that's what they call an immortal's power…
m920113.……って、あら？ あの顔、背格好……。\n間違いないわ、あなたが王子ね！: …Oh? That face, that stature… No doubt about it, you must be the Prince!
m920113.……どうしたんでしょうか。\n紅牡丹さん、何か考え込んでいるようですが。:
…What's on your mind?
You seem deep in thought, Benibotan.
m920113.……どうやら、無事に解決したようですね。\nあとは鬼刃姫さんにお任せしましょうか: …It looks like everything's been resolved safely. Shall we leave the rest to Kibahime?
m920113.……ふぅ。\n妖怪らしい動きというのも、\n中々難しいものですね……。:
…phew.
Even mimicking yokai movements is surprisingly tough…
m920113.……へ、へぇ、あんた本当に王子サマだったんだな。\n最初から知ってたら、\nもう: …Huh, huh, so you really are Prince-sama. If I'd known from the start, I'd have been a bit more careful about manners and stuff—
m920113.……ん、あぁ、いや。さっきここに、\nあの『千両かぶき姫』が来たんだけどな。: …Hmm, well… earlier, that “Thousand-Ryo Kabuki Princess” showed up here.
m920113.……ん？ いったい何の用……って、何ィ！？\n芝居のフリをして、あいつを倒すだっ: …Huh? What do you want… what the—! Pretend it's a play and take him down!?
m920113.……分かりました。\nそれでは、ひとまずゆっくり話せる場所で、\n詳しい事情をき:
…Understood.
First, let's find a quiet place and hear the full story.
m920113.……十天君、か。\n確かに、今の邪仙は金光聖菩が抜けた\n残りの十天君が率いてい: …Ten-Heaven Lord, huh. Indeed, the current evil immortal is the remaining Ten-Heaven Lord after Kin-kō Shōbō left.
m920113.……王子、いかがでしょう？\n東の国の復興を助けることにも繋がると思いますし、\: …Prince, what do you think? I believe it would help the east's reconstruction, and I'm still worried about that youkai that slipped in…
m920113.……皆さんがあんなに熱くなるということは、\nそれだけ舞台には、\n魅力が詰まっ: ……Everyone getting so fired up must mean the stage is packed with charm, right?
m920113.あ、あんた達に頼みがある！\nお願いだ、アタシと一緒に舞台に立ってくれないか！？:
I have a favor to ask you!
Please, will you join me on stage?
m920113.あ、アタシは……望むところだけど……。\nでも王子達は今、視察の旅の途中で……。: Ah, I'd love to… but the Prince and the others are currently on an inspection tour…
m920113.ああっ、あんた達なら、\n千両かぶき役者になれるに違いない！: Yes! With you, I'm sure we can become the “Thousand-Ryo Kabuki” actors!
m920113.あっ、王子王子、こっちこっちー！: Ah, Prince, Prince, over here, over here!
m920113.あてが驚かせちゃったから、\n欠片を飲み込んじゃったんだよね……ごめんね……。: I startled you, so I swallowed the fragment… sorry…
m920113.あなた達は、邪仙とその幹部、十天君とは\n因縁があると、知り合いから聞いているわ: I've heard you have a history with the evil immortal and his lieutenant, the Ten-Heaven Lord. So I thought I should let you know.
m920113.あの方、私達のことをご存知なのでしょうか……？: I wonder if they know who we are…
m920113.あれは……東天君！\n華の国の邪仙、十天君の一人です……！！: That's… the East Sky Lord! One of the Ten-Heaven Lords, the evil immortal of the Flower Realm…!!
m920113.あんた達の戦いは、\nこの目でしかと見させてもらった。\nあんた達なら間違いなく: I've only seen your battle with my own eyes. I'm sure you can step onto the stage without a doubt.
m920113.あー、戦ってるフリをするって思ってくれりゃいい。\n観客を楽しませるように、派手: Ah, just think of it as pretending to fight. Move flamboyantly to entertain the audience.
m920113.あーっと、詳しい話は後で！\nまずはこいつらを蹴散らさなきゃ。: Ah, details later! First we've got to kick these guys out.
m920113.い、いえっ、これは修行で……！\n良いところを見せようなどというつもりは……！！: N-no, this is just training… I didn't mean to show off!
m920113.いや、今はそんなことを言ってる場合じゃねぇか……。\n悔しいが、舞台が失敗でも構: No, now's not the time to complain… As frustrating as it is, I don't care if the performance fails! We have to get the audience out quickly!
m920113.いやぁ……ほんと助かったよ。\nあとちょっとでペロリと喰われちまうところだった。:
???: Phew… you really saved me.
I was about to be gobbled up any second.
m920113.いやいや、堂に入った演技でしたぞ。\nもしや舞台の才能がおありなのでは？: No, no, it was a performance worthy of a hall. Perhaps you have a talent for the stage?
m920113.いやホント、全員初めてとは思えない気迫だった！！: Seriously, the intensity didn't feel like anyone's first time!
m920113.うぅ、ごめんなさい……。\nついつい熱くなっちゃって……。:
Ugh, I'm sorry…
I got a bit carried away…
m920113.うううっ、やめろってんだい！\n目の前で褒められると恥ずかしくなっちまうだろう？: Ugh, stop it! Being praised right in front of me makes me embarrassed!
m920113.うむうむ。久々に心が躍ったぞ。\nそれにアオバのやつも頑張っておったしな。:
Indeed. My heart's dancing after a long time.
And Aoba was doing his best too.
m920113.えぇ。単刀直入にいえば、\n華の国の邪仙、東天君がこの国で、\n暗躍しているとい: Yes. To put it bluntly, we've received intel that the evil immortal of the Flower Realm, the Eastern Sky Lord, is operating covertly in this land.
m920113.えっ、さっきから向こうの方に見えてる妖怪さん、\n誰かが仮装してるってことですか: Huh, that monster over there—someone's in costume!?
m920113.えへへ、ちょっと恥ずかしいけど、\nいい舞台だったなぁ……。: Hehe, it's a bit embarrassing, but what a great stage it was…
m920113.お、おいおいおい！ てめぇ何者だ！: Hey, hey, hey! Who the hell are you!
m920113.お、アタシを知ってるのかい？\nでも『千両かぶき姫』なんて呼ばれたのは昔の話さ。:
Oh, you know me?
But being called the “Thousand-Ryo Kabuki Princess” is a thing of the past.
m920113.お、王子……皆……ッ！！\nよ、よぉし、それなら更に稽古に力を入れないとな！: Oh, Prince… Everyone…!! Alright, then we need to train even harder!
m920113.おっと、それから舞台の上ってのは、\n立ち位置が重要になるからね。: Oh, and on stage, positioning is crucial.
