m920113.知り合いからあなたが東の国にいる、\nという話を聞いて、追いかけてきたの。: I heard from an acquaintance that you were in the Eastern Country, so I came after you.
m920113.私の宝貝が届く範囲なら、\n一部だけど傷を肩代わりするわ。\nお礼はするから、お: If it's within my treasure's reach, I'll take on some of the damage for you. I'll repay you, so please help me!
m920113.紅牡丹さんが、丁寧に教えてくれたからですよ。\nこちらも貴重な体験ができましたし: That's because Benibotan taught us so carefully. We also got a valuable experience.
m920113.紅牡丹さんや、他の皆さんもすごかったです！\nまるで本物の鬼退治みたいでした……: Benibotan and everyone else were amazing! It was like a real demon hunt…
m920113.舞台に立てるのは三人だけ……。\n王子、配役には慎重を期してくださいね。: Only three can take the stage… Prince, please be careful with the casting.
m920113.茨木童子を演じている紅牡丹さん、\nかっこよかったですよねぇ……。: Benibotan, playing Ibaraki-dōji, you were so cool…
m920113.観客も盛り上がってるし、\n役者もしっかり役に入り込んでる。\nこいつぁ最高の舞: The audience's thrilled, and the actors are really getting into character. This is going to be the best stage ever!
m920113.語ってやる義理はない。\nしかし妖怪共を退けるとは、\n手を抜いてもいられないか: I have no obligation to explain. But if you're going to drive my yokai back, I won't hold back.
m920113.誰が小娘かァ！\n耳ィかっぽじってよぉく聞けぇ！！\n我こそがァ、酒呑童子が娘に: Who calls me a little girl! Listen up, ears wide open!! I am the strongest demon, the daughter of Shuten-dōji!!
m920113.逃げ足だけは一人前だったが、\nもはや逃げ場はあるまい。ここで終わりだ。: He may have been quick on his feet, but there's nowhere left to run. This ends here.
m920113.酒呑童子が相手ならば、\n新たに配下とした妖怪共の実力を試すのに\n良い機会と思: If it's Shuten-dōji I'm facing, I thought it'd be a good chance to test the strength of my newly-recruited yokai, but it's a fake.
m920113.随分と騒がしいとォ思えばッ、\nいつぞやの……アッ、人間共じゃ～ねェか！: What a racket! Ah, it's those… ah, humans, isn't it!
m920113.（…………わかりました。\n都の皆さんのためにも、紅牡丹さんのためにも、\n王子: (……Understood. For the sake of everyone in the capital, for Benibotan's sake, Prince, we'll absolutely win this battle…!!)
m920113.（あの東天君とやらはアタシに任せな。\nある程度の時間稼ぎくらいはしてやるさ！）: (Leave that East Sky Lord to me. I'll buy us a little time!)
m920113.（こいつはアタシ達の舞台だろ？ それなら、\nあんた達だけに戦わせるわけにゃいか: (This is our stage, isn't it? If so, I can't just let you fight alone.)
m920113.（このグシオンの欠片の力を得れば、\n傷を負う程に力が増していくらしいのだ）: (If we obtain the power of this fragment of Gushion, our strength apparently grows the more we're wounded.)
m920113.（しかしこいつぁ芝居だ！\nアタシも存分に『敵役』として、\n本気で演じさせても: (But this is a performance! Let me fully embrace the “villain” role and give it my all!!)
m920113.（しかし僅かばかりならば、\n我らにも魔神への耐性が付いているやも……）: (But if it's just a little, we might gain some resistance to the demon god…)
m920113.（なんと……しかし鬼刃姫様と約束したではないか。\n我らはもう、魔神の力には頼ら: (What…? But we promised Kibahime we wouldn't rely on the demon god's power any more…)
m920113.（むむむ……然り……では飲み込むのは止め――）: (Hmm… very well… then we'll stop swallowing—)
m920113.（確かに……いやしかし、\n鬼刃姫様の信頼を裏切るわけには……）: (Indeed… but we can't betray Kibahime's trust…)
m920113.（良いか、これは鬼刃姫様の戦いを、\nお助けするための秘策であるぞ……）: (Listen up, this is a secret technique to aid Kibahime's battle…)

m920198.――あれが、巨人スルト。\n炎の剣の担い手にして、\nアスガルドを滅ぼす運命にあ:
――That is the giant Surtr.
The bearer of the Sword of Flame,
destined to destroy Asgard.
m920198.――あーあ、好き勝手やらせちゃって。\n放っておいていいのかい？:
??? : ――Ah, let them do as they please.
Is it alright to just leave them be?
m920198.――ここが、ムスペルヘイム。\n渦巻く炎の眠る、第三層のもうひとつの姿ですのね…:
――This is Muspelheim.
The other face of the Third Layer, where swirling flames sleep……
m920198.――ここが、物質界。\nあっ……お邪魔しますね。:
――So this is the Material World.
Ah… sorry to intrude.
m920198.――そのとおりだ。\nきみは戦いに向いていないのだから、\n大人しく後ろに控えて:
――That is precisely the case.
You are no good at fighting,
so you would do well to stay out of the way.
m920198.――どうやら、王子たちは次の階層へ向かうようだね。: ――It seems the Prince is heading to the next level.
m920198.――ほう、剣に手を届かせたか。\nやはり可能性があるのは、お前だけだな。:
――Hm, you've reached the sword.
As expected, you are the only one with potential.
m920198.――人よ、この地は汝らが\n穢して良い場所ではありません。\n今すぐ立ち去りなさ:
Mortals, this is not a place you are permitted to defile.
Leave at once!
m920198.――彼女を止めるのは、私の役目です。: ――It is my duty to stop her.
m920198.――消えた、か。\nあれほど神々に怖れられた炎の剣も、\n本来解放すべき運命でな:
――So it's gone.
Even the Flame Sword, so feared by the gods,
is fragile if drawn at a time when its fate has not yet come.
m920198.――銀腕、何も言うな。\n彼女のいうとおりだ。:
――Silver Arm, say nothing.
She is right.
m920198.…………わかりました。\nあなたの言葉を信じます。:
...Very well.
I will believe your words.
m920198.…………森を抜けたか。\nだが、王国の近くにこんな場所があったか？:
...We've made it out of the forest.
But was there a place like this near the kingdom?
m920198.…………神の試練。\nそれを乗り越えることが、神の座へ至る条件。:
…………The trials of the gods.
Overcoming them is the condition for attaining divinity.
m920198.……お前は、戦況だけでなく、\n大勢を見極める目を磨くべきだな。:
……You should sharpen your eyes not just for the battlefield,
but for the greater picture.
m920198.……きみらには、手伝わせた報酬が必要か。\n答え合わせが欲しいのだろう？\nなに:
...Do you need a reward for your help?
You want to know the answer, don't you?
It is a simple matter.
m920198.……そうね。\n今のあなたは、昔とは違うと思っておきましょう。:
...I see.
Let us assume that you are different from before.
m920198.……それなら、早くしたほうがいい。\nすぐ近くで、こちらを窺っているやつがいる。:
...Then we should hurry.
There is someone watching us from nearby.
m920198.……はい。\nでは、その、これから――よろしくお願いします！:
...Yes.
In that case, um, from here on――please take care of me!
m920198.……まさか、私の崑崙を罠にはめた者と同じ？: ...Could it be the same one who set a trap for my Kunlun?
m920198.……やはり、ここであなた方は、\n排除しておくべきでしょう。:
...Very well.
I should eliminate you here, before it is too late.
--- scene: Gatekeeper of Asgard (battle, start) ---
m920198.……アスガルドの伝承に、お詳しいのですね？: ……You are well-versed in the legends of Asgard, I see.
m920198.……イコルがひとり勝ちするって？\nおいおい、それを見過ごしていいのかよ。:
……You're saying Icol wins either way?
Hey, are you really okay just letting that slide?
m920198.……全員、精神干渉を受けたみたいです。\n夢……いえ、白昼夢を見せられていたとい:
...It seems everyone has been subjected to a mental interference.
We were being shown a dream... or rather, a waking dream.
m920198.……存外、早かったな。\nなるほど、王子たちを味方につけたか。:
……Faster than I expected.
I see, you've made the Princes your allies.
m920198.……心を閉ざしてしまったのですね。\nハリンヘイム様、どうか目を覚ましてください:
...You have closed your heart to the world.
Lady Harinheim, please open your eyes.
Why have you given up!
--- scene: Gatekeeper of Asgard (battle, end) ---
m920198.……思ったより、武闘派だな？: ……You're more of a brawler than I expected, aren't you?
m920198.……気をつけ給えよ、王子。\nきみの敵は亜神ディアスだけではない。:
...Beware, Prince.
Your enemy is not just the Demigod Dias.
m920198.……物質界に、\nどうしてそんな子たちがいるんですの？: ...Why are children like that in the material world?
m920198.……私が、まだ諦めていないと、\nそう信じてくれたのですね。: ...You believe that I have not yet given up.
m920198.……良かった、アスガルドは、\n全てが終わっては、いなかったのですね。:
...Good. Asgard
has not been completely lost, then.
m920198.……転移と言うと、亜神ディアスですか？\n彼は軍勢すら、まるごと転移できたはずで:
...Teleported? Do you mean the Demigod Dias?
He was capable of moving entire armies in an instant.
m920198.あ、あ、アスガルドぉ！？\n待ってくださいな、ここは物質界では――:
A-Asgard?!
Hold on a moment, this is the Material World—
m920198.ああ、おそらくな。\n――王子、気をつけろ！ カラスの群れが来るぞ！:
Yes, most likely.
——Prince, be careful! A flock of crows is coming!
m920198.ああ、ぼくがそうなるように組み上げたからね。\nこれはいずれ、アスガルドを焼くは:
Ah, I built him that way.
This is the flame that was meant to burn Asgard.
The death of the future that was meant to kill them.
m920198.あなたが何を企んでいるのかは、知りません。\nでも、この第三層を、神々の墓標を、:
I don't know what you're scheming.
But I cannot allow this folly of burning the Third Layer,
the monument to the gods,
with your flames.
m920198.あなたが恨んだ、あなたが憎んだアスガルドの神は、\nもう誰も残っていないというの:
The gods of Asgard you resented,
the ones you hated,
are no more!
m920198.あなたの事が、ずっとずっと嫌いでした。\nでも、それでも、同じ階層の同胞だと思っ:
I hated you. For so, so long.
Even though... even though I thought of you as a fellow being of the same layer.
m920198.あの反撃の魔法陣は、一定距離までの攻撃に\n自動的に反撃を放つ術式です。:
That counter-attack magic circle is a formation
that automatically retaliates against attacks within a certain range.
m920198.あの子、ここが天界――\nオリュンポス第三層だって言ったのですわよ！:
That girl said this is the Celestial Realm—
the Third Layer of Olympus!
m920198.あの日、亜神ディアスがオリュンポスを支配した時、\n私は最終戦争を知らせる\nギ:
On the day the Lesser God Zeus took control of Olympus,
I should have sounded the Gjalarhorn
to herald the Final War.
m920198.ありがとうございます。\nでは王子くん、次の階層目指して、\n諸々の準備を整えて:
Thank you.
Then, Prince, let's get everything ready
so we can head to the next level.
m920198.あるいは神の命と共に、\n権能そのものを受け継ぐこと。:
Or, inheriting the divine authority itself,
along with the god's life.
m920198.あれはおそらく、オリュンポス第三層の固有種だ。\n第三層の亜神が連れている姿を、:
They are likely a species native to the third layer of Olympus.
I have seen the sub-gods of the third layer leading them a few times before.
m920198.あれは厄災をその内に封じた剣だ。\nいずれ第三層を焼き尽くすはずだった炎を、\n:
That is a sword that sealed a calamity within itself.
It is a disaster incarnate, forcibly shaped into a form
to contain the flames that were destined to consume the Third Layer.
m920198.いえ、あれ以降亜神イコルは消息を絶ちました。\nおそらくは、\nオリュンポスの上:
No, the minor god Ikol has gone silent since then.
She has probably
headed toward the upper levels of Olympus…
m920198.いや、ディアスが動いたのなら、\nもっと大規模な術になっている。:
No. If Dias had moved,
the spell would have been far more massive.
m920198.うぅー、それにしても暑いよぉ……。\nこれじゃあ到着前に焼き鳥になっちゃうぅぅ。: Ugh… it's so hot in here…
m920198.えぇ、彼女の術はすべての防護の力を砕くのです。\nどうか、気をつけてください。:
Yes, her sorcery shatters all forms of protection.
Please, be careful.
m920198.えぇぇ、ここどこ？ ほんとにどこ？: Ehhhh, where are we? Really, where is this?
m920198.えっ、あ、あの！ お待ちください！\n私たちが戦う理由はないのでは！？:
E-eh? P-please!
Wait a moment!
There's no reason for us to fight!
m920198.きみか、ぼくか、どちらが神を殺すのか。\nああ、今から楽しみだね、まったく。:
Whether it is you or me who kills the god.
Oh, I can't wait. It's truly exciting.
m920198.きみのように、直接王子に手を貸さないだけ、\n僕はまだ理性的だと思うけどな……。:
Unlike you, I don't directly interfere with the Prince.
I'd say I'm still the rational one here...
――Hm? What is this?
m920198.きみの許可を取る必要はないだろう？\nこの階層に、もはや管理者はいないのだから。:
I don't need your permission, do I?
There is no longer an administrator
for this layer.
m920198.くっ……やはり、雷神のようにはいきませんね。: Tsk... I see. I am no match for the God of Thunder.
m920198.これはむしろ、他者を惑わせ、\nあざむき、罠に導く類の魔性の術……。:
This feels more like a diabolical trick,
designed to confuse, deceive, and lure others into a trap...
m920198.ご先祖さまに、少し縁があったもので……。: My ancestors had a slight connection to them…
m920198.さぁ、そろそろ炎の剣の封印地点です。\n皆さん、心の準備をしておいてください。:
Now, we're nearing the seal on the Sword of Flame.
Everyone, please brace yourselves.
m920198.さぁ、スルトはまだ生きている。\nこの試練を見事、乗り越えてみせるといい。\n今:
Come now, Surtr is still alive.
See if you can overcome this trial with grace.
You, the great hero of humanity?
m920198.さぁ立て、スルト。\nお前の怒りはこんなものか。\nぼくを殺したいと、世界を焼滅:
Rise, Surtr.
Is this all your rage amounts to?
Scream your desire to kill me and burn the world to ashes!
--- scene: The One Who Weaves Schemes and Invites Ruin ---
m920198.さて、それじゃあ先に進ませてもらおう。\n王子、再会の時を楽しみにしている。:
Well then, I'll be on my way.
Prince, I look forward to our reunion.
m920198.そう、もはやきみには、\n巨人スルトを止める術などないのだから。:
Yes, for you no longer have
any means to stop the giant Surtr.
m920198.そこに、ぼくの関与した痕跡を残せば――: If I leave traces of my involvement there――
m920198.そこまで考えていません！\nただ、彼女が何を思ってあんなことをしたのか、\n理解:
I'm not thinking that far ahead!
I'm just trying to imagine what she was thinking
when she did such a thing.
m920198.そして、あなた方は森を歩む中で、\n気付かぬうちに、アスガルドにやってきていたと:
And you said earlier that you were walking through the forest
and, without realizing it,
ended up here in Asgard?
m920198.そして彼女の魔術は、\n心を乱し、魂を惑わせ、あらゆる敵意への\n抵抗力を失わせ:
And her sorcery is a technique of disruption
that disturbs the mind, confuses the soul, and strips away
any resistance to hostility.
m920198.そのとおりだとも。\nハリンヘイム、きみの役割は全て終わった。\nだからもう、何:
That is exactly right.
Harinheim, your role is completely finished.
So do nothing. Stay out of it.
m920198.それじゃあ、また会おう。\n次はもっと苛烈な試練を用意しておくよ。:
Well then, see you again.
Next time, I'll prepare a far more brutal trial.
m920198.それで、あれからイコルの動向は？\n何かわかったのか？: So, have you learned anything about Ikol's movements since then?
m920198.それでも、どうにかしてあの剣を止めないと……。\n王子、どうか慎重な指揮をお願い:
Even so, we have to find a way to stop that sword…
Prince, please command with great caution!
m920198.そんな……あなたたちは皆、\n亜神ディアスに精神支配されたものだとばかり……。:
I see... I had thought you were all
under the mental domination of the Lesser God Zeus...
m920198.そんな危険なものを、どうして創造したんだろ……。\n元々オリュンポスは、創造神さ: Why would anyone create something so dangerous…?
m920198.だから……だから今度は、\nあなたがオリュンポス全てを使って、\n最終戦争を引き:
So... this time, you intend to use
all of Olympus
to trigger the Final War?
m920198.だから、私は現状維持だけを望みます。\nこの地が壊れてしまわないよう、\n不確定:
So, I wish only to preserve the status quo.
To ensure this land is not destroyed,
I will eliminate all uncertain elements.
m920198.だが、その時が訪れるより早く、\n亜神ディアスはその全てを滅ぼしてしまった。:
But before that time came,
the Lesser God Dias destroyed them all.
m920198.だが、油断してると\n俺様に寝首をかかれちまうぜ？:
But if you let your guard down,
you'll get your neck slit by me, you know?
m920198.だがすぐに追ってこられては困るからな。\nこいつらの相手でもしていてくれ。:
But it would be troublesome if you followed right behind me.
Please keep these things busy for a while.
m920198.ちっ、話は後だ！\n王子、戦闘準備を！！:
Tch, we can talk later!
Prince, prepare for battle!
m920198.ですが、あなた方に悪意がなくとも、\nその行いが「彼女」の\n策謀の上にないとは:
But even if you harbor no ill will,
I cannot say for certain that your presence
is not part of "her" schemes.
m920198.でも、もうこれ以上、故郷を壊させはしません。\nイコルはおそらく、炎の剣の封印を: But I will not let our homeland be destroyed any further.
m920198.でも、滅びは本来訪れる形でなく、\n亜神ディアスの侵攻によってもたらされました。: However, the destruction was not meant to come in this form;
m920198.ところで……。\nハリンヘイムちゃん？\n話はそれだけですか？:
By the way…
Harinheim?
Is that all you wanted to say?
m920198.ともあれ、皆さんを起こしましょう。\nこんな状態で襲撃でも受けたら大変です。:
In any case, let's wake the others up.
If we get ambushed in this state, it could be disastrous.
m920198.どういうことですか？\nアスガルドというのはいったい……？:
What do you mean?
What is this "Asgard" place, anyway?
m920198.どうやら、私たちはすでに、\n何者かの術中に落ちているようですね。: It seems we have already fallen into someone's trap.
m920198.なぜ、あなたは誰かの命を、\n簡単に切り捨てることができるのですか。:
Why can you so casually
cut away the lives of others?
m920198.なっ……いつの間に！？\n貴様、何者だ！！:
W-what?!
When did you... who are you?!!
m920198.なるほど、剣と一体だという意味が分かりました。\n魔力が繋がっていて、\n炎の剣:
I see, so that's what it means to be one with the sword.
The magic is connected,
so he'll keep regenerating
unless we stop the Sword of Flame.
m920198.は、はい。\nですがそれと、私たちが戦うことに何の関係が……。:
Y-yes.
But how does that have anything to do with us fighting...?
m920198.はぁ……そういうことにしておきましょう。\nそれで、王子たちは今どこに？:
Haa... I'll let that slide.
So, where are the Prince and his party now?
m920198.ひとつ、あやつの駒が先に進むことに違いはない。\nこれは長らく刃を研ぎ続けた、\:
In either case, one of their pieces moves forward.
This is a reward, in a sense,
for the one who has been honing his blade for so long.
m920198.ひとつは、亜神ディアスの言葉を信じたこと。\n仮にも同じ亜神であるからと、\n異:
The first was believing the words of the Lesser God Zeus.
Because he was a Lesser God, just like me,
I allowed myself to trust a being of another faith.
m920198.ふぇっ、あっ、えっ？\nなに！？ えっ、ここどこー！？:
Feh! Ah, what?
What?! Where am I?!
m920198.ふふ、ああ、愉快だ。\nさぁ王子、共に神を殺しにいこう。:
Heh, ah, how delightful.
Come, Prince. Let us go kill a god together.
m920198.ふふ、亜神だから、管理者だから、\nそんなことを考えていては\n仙術の道は極めら:
Fufu. Thinking of yourself as a demigod,
or as an administrator,
will never let you master the path of the immortals.
m920198.ほう、人の身にしては詳しいな。:
Hm. You know quite a lot
for a mere human.
m920198.ぼく、眠ってた？\nうー……あれ、でも歩いてた記憶はあるし……。:
I was asleep?
Ugh... But I remember walking...
m920198.ぼくか、女神アイギスか、あるいは他の亜神か、\n誰かがいずれお前に望むことだろう:
Whether it's me, the Goddess Aegis, or some other minor god,
someone will eventually demand it of you.
m920198.ぼくは滅びを招いた大罪人で、\n世界に策謀を巡らす者で、今もなお、滅びの底から\:
I am a great sinner who brought on destruction,
one who weaves schemes across the world, and even now,
one who seeks to drag the world down into the abyss of ruin.
m920198.ま、待ちなさい！\nいったい何をするつもりなんですの！？:
W-wait!
What do you intend to do?!
m920198.まぁ、最初の顔よりは\n今の方がよっぽどいいか。:
Well, at least that face is much better
than the one you had at first.
m920198.まぁこんなに広くても、\n生き残っているのは極僅かなのですが。:
Well, even in a place this vast,
only a very few survivors remain.
m920198.まぁまぁ。\nイコルの考えを、真実を知りたいのでしょう？\nならば、共に歩んでい:
Now, now.
You want to know the truth of Ikol's thoughts, don't you?
Then, simply walk the path together.
m920198.まさか、彼らを喚んだのは、私を戦わせ、\nムスペルヘイムの封印から離れさせるため:
So... you summoned them to force me to fight,
to draw me away from the seal on Muspelheim...
m920198.まずはこの森を抜けましょう。\n白昼夢から目覚めることは出来たのですから、\n何:
First, let's get out of this forest.
Since we were able to wake from the waking dream,
there must be some cracks in the illusion...
m920198.もう、嫌なんです。\n何かを失うのが、壊れてしまうのが。:
I am tired of it.
I am tired of losing things, of everything falling apart.
m920198.もうひとつは、彼女を――裏切りと謀略の亜神たる、\nイコルを殺しておかなかったこ:
The second was failing to kill her.
I should have put an end to Eikorn, the Lesser God of Treachery and Strategy.
m920198.もとよりオリュンポス第三層へは、\n自ら赴くつもりではあっただろうが……。:
They would have intended to head to the Third Layer of Olympus
on their own accord, but...
m920198.やれやれ、何が愚かな神だ。\n今もそんな好戦的な顔して、\nいつイコルを殺してや:
Oh, come now, what foolish god?
You're still wearing that belligerent face,
always thinking about when you're going to kill Ikol.
m920198.ようやく落ち着いたか……。\n王子、亜神イコルの後を追おう。:
It's finally quiet...
Prince, let's go after the Lesser God Ikol.
m920198.わぁあぁあっ！？\nどこから出てくるんですか！？:
Waaah!?
Where did you come from!?
m920198.アスガルドの亜神は冗談が下手なのかしら。\nどこにあっても、謀略を巡らせるあなた:
Do the demigods of Asgard have no sense of humor?
No one can believe the words of one who schemes in the shadows,
no matter where they stand.
m920198.アスガルド全土に、\n最終戦争を知らせる警報装置のようなものです。\nハリンヘイ:
It is a device that alerts all of Asgard
to the coming of the Final War.
Lady Harinheim is the Gatekeeper of this land, after all.
m920198.イコル、もうやめてください。\nあなたのことは嫌いですが、\n数少ない同胞の生き:
Ikol, please stop.
I may not like you,
but I don't want to kill one of the few surviving members of our kind.
m920198.イコル、私たちの勝ちです。\n抵抗をやめて――:
Ikol, we have won.
Stop resisting――
m920198.イコルがどちらを手にしても関係ない、か。\nまぁ、あんたが言うならそうなんだろう:
So it doesn't matter which one Icol gets, huh.
Well, if you say so, I suppose that's how it is.
m920198.イコルのクソガキ、あれの封印を解くつもりだぞ？\nオリュンポスが焼け落ちてもいい:
That brat Icol intends to break its seal, doesn't he?
Are you saying it's fine if Olympus burns to the ground?
m920198.イコル！ もうやめてください。\nどうしてそうまでして、\n炎の剣を解放しようと:
Ikol! Please, stop.
Why are you going to such lengths
to unleash the Sword of Flame?
m920198.オリュンポス第三層の門番にして、\n炎の世界、ムスペルヘイムを封じる御方。\n亜:
She is the Gatekeeper of the Third Layer of Olympus,
and the one who seals the World of Fire, Muspelheim.
The Lesser God, Lady Harinheim!
m920198.スルーズ、あなたなら知っているでしょう。\nアスガルドが滅んだ原因を。:
Thrud, you know the truth.
You know what caused the fall of Asgard.
m920198.スルーズさん、お知り合いですか？: Thrud, do you know this person?
m920198.ハッ、笑わせてくれる。\n誰が、ぼくを殺すって？:
Hah, you're a laugh.
Who's going to kill me?
m920198.ハハッ、冗談さ。\nそれじゃあ、俺は高みの見物と洒落込むか。:
Hah, just kidding.
Well then, I'll sit back and watch the show.
m920198.ハリンヘイム、きみの役割は終わった。\nあとは安全な場所から、\nこの世界の行く:
Harinheim, your part is done.
From a safe distance,
simply watch how this world ends.
m920198.ハリンヘイム、きみの役割は終わった。\nどこか安全な場所にでもこもって、\n世界:
Harinheim, your role is over.
Hide somewhere safe
and watch the world burn away.
m920198.ハリンヘイム、きみをニ度も騙すことになる。\n謝罪だけはしておこう。\n止める気:
Hringheim, I will have deceived you for the second time.
I should at least apologize.
I have no intention of stopping you, though.
m920198.ハリンヘイムの目をそらしてくれたおかげで、\nようやくムスペルヘイムへの道が開く:
And because you kept Harinheim's attention,
the path to Muspelheim is finally open.
m920198.ハリンヘイム様！\nどうか話を聞いてください！:
Lady Harinheim!
Please, hear me out!
m920198.パリオス！ しっかりしろ、パリオス！: Pallios! Snap out of it, Pallios!
m920198.ムスペルヘイム、炎の剣の眠る、\nアスガルドのもうひとつの姿、ですか。:
Muspelheim, where the Flame Sword sleeps...
Asgard's other face, is it?
m920198.ムスペルヘイムに眠る炎の剣は、\n世界すら焼き尽くすとされるもの。\n封印を解か:
The sword of flame that sleeps in Muspelheim
is said to be able to burn the world itself.
We cannot allow its seal to be broken.
m920198.ムスペルヘイムに眠る炎の剣を解き放つ。\nオリュンポスそのものを、焼き尽くすため:
I will unleash the Flame Sword sleeping in Muspelheim.
To burn Olympus itself to the ground.
m920198.ムスペルヘイムは灼熱の世界ですからね。\n炎の剣の封印まで後少し、頑張って――: Muspelheim is a world of scorching heat.
m920198.一応は家族だかんな、心配くらいするさ。\nで、とぼけてていいのか？\nムスペルヘ:
……Well, we are family, in a manner of speaking. I suppose I'm allowed to worry.
And are you really going to play dumb?
The Sword of Flame from Muspelheim is far too dangerous to ignore.
m920198.主役はイコルかハリンヘイムか、それとも王子か。\n英雄譚ってのは間近で見なくちゃ:
Whether the protagonist is Icol, Harinheim, or the Prince.
You have to see a hero's tale up close.
m920198.亜神、イコル……ですのね。: So you are the Lesser God, Ikol...
m920198.亜神イコル、あなたまで前線に出るつもり？: Demigod Ikol. Are you planning to join the front lines?
m920198.亜神ディアスの待つ最上層まで、\n登り続けるしかなさそうですね。:
It seems we have no choice but to keep climbing
all the way to the topmost level where the minor god Zeus awaits.
m920198.亜神ディアスの策謀も、\nイコルの計画も、すべて私が打ち砕きます。: I will shatter the schemes of the Sub-God Dias,
m920198.人が神の座に至るにあたって、\n何が必要か、知っているかな。:
Do you know what is required
for a person to reach the seat of a god?
m920198.人を惑わすのは、彼女の得意とするところ。\nアスガルドへ軍を迷い込ませるような策:
Misleading people is her specialty.
A scheme to lure an army into Asgard...
It is certainly the work of the Lesser God Eikorn.
m920198.今、第三層の管理者は私が代理で遂行しているので、\n王国の皆さんには、無制限に通:
Since I am currently acting as the administrator of the third level,
I will grant the kingdom's people unrestricted passage.
m920198.今のは、一応場を和ませる冗談のつもりです。: I was just trying to lighten the mood with a joke.
m920198.今はそう、分からないという顔をしておくといい。\nだが、お前も薄々勘付いているの:
For now, just keep up that "I don't know" expression.
But you can probably tell, can't you?
m920198.仕方ありませんわ。\n王子さま、暑さによる体力減少に注意してくださいな！\nさぁ: There is nothing we can do about it.
m920198.何も、変わっていないじゃないですか。\nイタズラばかりして、誰かを困らせて、\n:
Nothing has changed.
You only play pranks, trouble others,
and that is what set the destruction in motion.
m920198.先程から、ハリンヘイムが殺したがっている、\n裏切りと謀略の亜神だよ。:
I am the Lesser God of Treachery and Intrigue,
the one Harinheim has been dying to kill
ever since we first met.
m920198.剣の形として、炎と共に封じて以来か。\nお前の怒りがここまで伝わってくるようだ。:
Ever since I sealed you in the form of a sword,
alongside the flame.
I can feel your rage reaching this far.
m920198.創造神さまの意図は、誰にも分かりません。\n第三層が、必ず滅びを迎える運命にある: No one knows the Creator God's intent.
m920198.助けを求めるのでなく、\n諦めるのでもなく、\n私が、立ち上がるのを、待って……:
Not because I am calling for help,
not because I have given up,
but waiting for me to rise again...
m920198.勝ったのは、ぼくだ。: I am the one who has won.
m920198.号砲の亜神殿も、どうやら吹っ切れたようですね。\nなすべきことが見つかった、とい: It seems the Sub-God's Temple of the Signal Cannon has finally found its resolve.
m920198.夢は僕の領分だ。\n夢見る者たちの動向は、自然と垣間見えてしまうのさ。:
Dreams are my domain.
I naturally catch glimpses of what the dreamers are up to.
m920198.大嫌いだ、きみのことが嫌いだ。\nだから、もうこの戦いに関わるな。\n二度とぼく:
I hate you. I hate you so much.
So, stay out of this battle.
Never show yourself before me again.
m920198.天槍騎兵、アスガルドの騎士がひとり、スルーズです！\nただいま、この地へ戻りまし:
I am Thrud, a Sky Lancer and knight of Asgard!
I have just returned to this land!
m920198.失いたくない、壊れてしまうのを見たくない。\nだから、今度は諦めるのではなく、\:
I don't want to lose, I don't want to see things break.
So, this time, instead of giving up,
I want to fight.
m920198.実に望ましい結果だ。\n想定しうる最善の過程を歩んでいる。:
A most desirable outcome.
You are walking the best possible path.
m920198.小さな勝利など、掴ませておけばよい。\n目の前の些事に惑わされぬよう、目を磨くこ:
Let him have his small victories.
You need to sharpen your eyes so you aren't distracted by trivialities.
m920198.常に最前線にいる戦神に言われたくはない。\n余興だろうと、手を抜くのは良くないだ:
I'd rather not hear that from the War God who is always at the forefront.
Even if this is just a diversion, it's not good to hold back, is it?
m920198.当然ですとも。\n第三層の亜神は、皆強き戦士ですからね！:
Of course.
The Sub-Gods of the Third Layer are all formidable warriors!
m920198.彼女こそ、私の隙をついてギャラルホルンを隠し、\n亜神ディアスがオリュンポスを攻:
She is the great sinner who exploited my negligence to hide the Gjalarhorn,
creating the opening that allowed the Lesser God Zeus
to attack Olympus.
m920198.我が血をわけた子孫なれば、\nそれくらいの気概を見せねば嘘というものだ。\n好き:
If you are a descendant who shares my blood,
you should at least have that much spirit.
Come take my head whenever you like.
m920198.戦う意志がない者に、無理強いはできない。\n彼女が諦めたというのなら、\nもはや:
We cannot force someone who lacks the will to fight.
If she has given up,
then there are no words left to say.
m920198.戦っていて思ったのですが、\nこんなに熱く炎が燃え盛っているのに、\nどこか寂し: I was thinking during the battle, but…
m920198.敵の罠である可能性も捨てきれませんが、\n今はそれでも、進むしかなさそうですね。:
We cannot rule out the possibility that it is an enemy trap,
but for now, we have no choice but to move forward.
m920198.敵意への抵抗力……？\nまさか魔法への耐性まで？:
Resistance to hostility...?
You mean even resistance to magic?
m920198.晴れない霧、無限に続く森、\nそして物質界にいないはずの生物。:
The unlifting fog, the endless forest,
and creatures that should not exist in the material world.
m920198.望みどおり、その戒めを解き放とう。\n世界を、この階層そのものを焼き尽くすはずだ:
As you wish, I shall release that restraint.
The power that was meant to burn the world,
this very layer to the ground,
now has no target to aim at.
m920198.楽器の音色、か……？\n森の奥から聴こえるな……。:
The sound of an instrument...?
It's coming from deep within the forest...
m920198.様付けはやめてください。\n私は同胞を守れなかった、愚かな神ですので。:
Please drop the honorific.
I am a foolish god who failed to protect my kin.
m920198.武力を持つ集団がアスガルドへ来たというだけで、\n実力を行使する理由には十分です:
The mere fact that an armed group has come to Asgard
is reason enough for me to use force!
m920198.残念だよ、ハリンヘイム。\nアスガルドでも、きみの目は曇っていない方だと\nぼく:
How disappointing, Harinheim.
Even in Asgard, I thought your eyes were clearer than most.
m920198.準備が整い次第、第四層にも行けるように、\n上層への門も稼働させておきますので。:
As soon as preparations are complete, I will also activate the gate to the upper levels
so that you can proceed to the fourth level.
m920198.滅びの炎にあらがってみるか、王子。: Let's see if you can resist the flame of destruction, Prince.
m920198.濃密なこの魔力の香り……。\n人を惑わし、あざむき、嘘をもって翻弄する、\n我が:
This dense aura of magic...
It deceives, it misleads, it toys with lies...
The presence of my hated archenemy...
m920198.炎の剣、そして巨躯なるスルトが目覚めた果てに、\nそれが打倒されようと、\nオリ:
The Sword of Flame, and the awakening of Surtr, the Giant—
whether he is defeated,
or turns his blade against Olympus—
m920198.炎の剣の灯火は、まだ消えていない。\nさぁ王子、滅びの炎を砕いてみせるがいい。:
The flame of the Sword of Fire has not yet been extinguished.
Come, Prince. Show me that you can shatter the flames of destruction.
m920198.炎の剣は、ただの魔剣ではないのです。\nいずれ世界を滅ぼす業火を、\n剣の形に整: The Sword of Flame is not merely a magical blade.
m920198.炎の災禍か、神の道を歩む者が生まれるか、\nいずれの運命にせよ、\nどちらも未だ:
Whether it is the calamity of flame,
or the birth of one who walks the path of the gods,
either fate is still within my grasp.
m920198.王国の方々です。\n亜神ディアスの策謀を砕くべく、\n戦い続けている物質界の皆さ:
They are from the Kingdom.
They are people of the Material World
who continue to fight to break the Lesser God Zeus's schemes.
m920198.王国付近の森を行軍していたはずが、\n気付けば、全員がアスガルドに迷い込んでいた:
They were marching through the forest near the Kingdom,
but before they knew it, the entire group had wandered into Asgard.
m920198.王国周辺の種とは、少し違うカラスでしたね……。: Those crows were a bit different from the species found around the kingdom...
m920198.王子、きみたちが意図どおりに動いてくれたおかげで、\nこちらの計画は上手く進みそ:
Prince, thanks to you playing along,
our plan is proceeding smoothly.
You truly are a different kind of man
for having defeated Galius.
m920198.王子、どうしました。\n彼女が、助けを求めると思っているのですか？:
Prince, what is it?
Do you think she is calling for help?
m920198.王子、まずはこの旋律の主を探しましょう！: Prince, let's find the one playing this melody first!
m920198.王子、スルトの魔力が増大していきます！\nせっかく削った魔力は、また元通りに……:
Prince, Surtr's mana is surging!
All the mana we drained is coming right back...!
m920198.王子、物質界の英雄、さん？\nイコルと戦うのなら、覚えておいてください。:
Prince, Hero of the Material Plane, sir?
If you are to fight Ikol, please remember this.
m920198.王子たちの気配が消えた……。\n眠った……わけではないな、\nこれは、強制的に転:
The Prince's presence has vanished...
They aren't asleep...
Was he forcibly teleported?
m920198.王子は僕のお気に入りなんだ。\nそれに、見守っているのも神らしくていいだろう？:
The Prince is my favorite.
Besides, doesn't it fit a god to watch over him?
m920198.王子殿下、兵の配置には注意してください。\nあの剣も巨人も、凄まじい熱を放ってい:
Your Highness, please be careful with your troop placement.
Both that sword and the giant are radiating intense heat.
Just getting close will likely scorch your bodies.
m920198.珍しいな、お前がここに来るとは。: Unusual. I didn't expect you to come here.
m920198.知り合い、というか……ですね……。: Know them? That's not quite the right word...
m920198.私はあの日、ふたつの過ちを犯しました。: On that day, I committed two grave errors.
m920198.私は仙道関係ないので……。: I have nothing to do with the immortal path...
m920198.私は無事です。\nそれに、地上の信徒たちの中にも、\n支配を逃れた者たちが何人も:
I am unharmed.
Besides, among the believers on the ground,
there are many who escaped his control.
m920198.私を、連れて行ってください。\n私はもう、これ以上、何も失いたくないんです。:
Please, take me with you.
I don't want to lose anything else.
m920198.第三層の亜神として、運命は受け入れますが、\n運命に記されざる滅びには、ちゃんと: As the Sub-God of the Third Layer, I accept my fate,
m920198.第三層は、複数の世界を内包している。\nそれらは遥かな未来に激突し、\n最終戦争:
The Third Layer contains multiple worlds.
They were destined to collide in the distant future,
bringing about the Final War.
m920198.結末が同じであれど、過程を変えてやれば、\n人は容易く感情を乱されるものだ。:
Even if the ending is the same, changing the process
is all it takes to easily disturb a person's emotions.
m920198.良いだろう、お前たちにはまだ\n力が足りていないという現実を教えてやる。:
Very well. Let me teach you the reality
that you are still lacking in power.
m920198.行ってみるしかありませんわ。\n少なくとも、永遠に森でさまようよりは、\n良い選:
We have no choice but to go and see.
At least, don't you think that is a better choice than wandering the forest forever?
m920198.街……いえ、廃墟、でしょうか。\n誰か話を聞ける方がいれば良いのですが……。:
A town... or rather, a ruin, I suppose.
I wish there was someone we could ask for directions...
m920198.裏切りと、謀略の亜神、か。: The Demigod of Betrayal and Intrigue, I see.
m920198.見ないこともできるのでしょうに、\nあえてそれをしないのが、あなたの嫌いなところ:
You could have chosen not to look.
The fact that you deliberately don't is exactly what I dislike about you.
m920198.覗き見とは趣味の悪い。\nまさかずっと王子を見ていたのですか？:
Peeking is such a tacky hobby.
Did you really keep watching the Prince this whole time?
m920198.誰が、誰に勝ったと？: Who said I lost to whom?
m920198.謀略の盤上遊戯ごときに翻弄されぬ男であると、\nどうか、僕に見せておくれ。:
Please show me that you are a man
who will not be toyed with by such a petty game of intrigue.
m920198.責任感が強くて、誰からも好かれて、\nぼくにすら優しい言葉をかけてきて、\nぼく:
Your strong sense of duty, the way everyone loved you,
the gentle words you even directed at me,
the way you looked out for me so I wouldn't be alone.
m920198.階層の管理者がついていくなど、\n邪魔だと思うかもしれませんが――:
I know it might seem like a nuisance,
for a level administrator to tag along, but――
m920198.鳥神の民には、あまり縁がない場所でしょう。\n第三層には、このような\n複数の世:
It's not a place the Bird God's people are often associated with.
The Third Layer is like this:
multiple worlds coexist here.
m920198.鳥神の被造物たちでしょう？\nそして彼らは、物質界にいるはずの人間の軍。:
Creatures of the Bird God, are you?
And you are a human army that should be in the Material World.

I suddenly feel quite uneasy.

you are guests in our care just like the rest of them.
We can't put you in any more danger than this—

Oh, please, there is no need to worry.
It certainly sounds like some sort of foreshadowing, but—
m920217.いつの間にそんなもん造ってたのか……。\nそんで、何処にあるんだそのリゾートは？:
When did they build something like that……?
And where is this resort, anyway?
m920217.いや、追う必要はないだろう。\nスイカの十や二十は渡してやってくれ、\n今はそれ:

Just let them have ten or twenty watermelons.
There is something far more important to deal with right now.
m920217.いやぁ、何でもありですねぇ！: Well, I suppose anything can happen!

They always put on a heroic front in front of us, after all.

In the end, I've been a burden to you all right up to the last.

So, I'm taking this watermelon!
You guys, grab one each and make off with it!
m920217.ギャギャ！ イタイ！ イタイ！ アッチイケ！: Gyagyaa! It hurts! It hurts! Go away!
m920217.ギャギャ！ オサナイ！ カケナイ！ シャベラナイ！: Gyagyaa! Don't be naughty! Don't run! Don't talk!
m920217.クールでミステリアスな伝説の占星術師ですがー？？: I'm a cool and mysterious legendary astrologer, you know??
m920217.グ、グレーターデーモン？ 何故ここに……？: G-Greater Demon? Why are you here...?
m920217.グルメジャングルにも慣れたものだ。\nこれだけの面子が集まれば勝利は固い。:
I've grown accustomed to the Gourmet Jungle.
With this lineup, victory is assured.
m920217.グルメジャングルに適応した料理というものを教えよう。: I shall teach you how to cook for the Gourmet Jungle.
m920217.グルメジャングルの、真の王が……。:
The true king of the Gourmet Jungle…
--- scene: Barbarian King VS Barbaric Valor ---
m920217.グルメジャングルの王者とも事前に交渉をし、\nセキュリティ体制は万全に整えてあり:
We have already negotiated with the King of the Gourmet Jungle,
and our security measures are in perfect order.
m920217.グルメジャングルの魔獣たちを刺激せぬように、\nこれまでどれほど細心の注意を払っ: How much care we've taken to avoid provoking the Gourmet Jungle's magic beasts...!
m920217.グルメジャングルは理より外れた孤島。\n皆様の安全性に対する懸念はもっともですが:
The Gourmet Jungle is an isolated island that defies reason.
Your concerns about safety are well-founded, and we are fully aware of the risks involved.
m920217.シェフ！ 施設内に逃げ遅れた宿泊客が！: Chef! There are guests who didn't make it out of the facility!
m920217.ジャイアントアノマロカリスさんは、\n全身がとある難病の薬になるんです。: The Giant Anomalocaris is a cure for a certain rare disease. Its entire body can be used as medicine.
m920217.ジャイアントアノマロカリスさんは絶滅危惧種ですのよ！\n近隣の漁師の方々の献身的: The Giant Anomalocaris is an endangered species! Thanks to the dedicated conservation efforts of the local fishermen, the population has only just begun to recover recently…
m920217.テメェら、見損なうんじゃねぇ！\n船長は前々からこのリゾート地を狙ってたがなァ、:
Don't you dare look down on us!
Our captain had been targeting this resort for ages, but
the local conditions turned out to be way too sketchy, so we had to wait for a better time!
m920217.デカ猿、お前もやらかしちまったなァ。\nあたしの前で野蛮なる王を名乗んのは──:
Big Ape, you've really messed up this time, haven't you?
Calling yourself the Barbaric King in front of me is—
m920217.デケぇな……今までどこに隠れてやがったんだ？: Big guy… where have you been hiding all this time?
m920217.デモシェフか……まあ、思ったより悪くはねぇな。: Demon Chef……Well, it's not as bad as I expected.
m920217.トゥアンよ、我は同じ女王として恥ずかしいぞ。: Tuan, as a fellow queen, I am deeply ashamed.
m920217.トンチキ星占いが何か言ったかァー！？: Did that Nonsense Star-Reader just say something?!
m920217.ハッ、見つかっちまったもんは仕方がねェ！\n悪党だろうが、嘘つきだろうが上等じゃ:
Hah, well, if you've caught us, there's nothing we can do!
Being a villain or a liar is fine by me!
Being chased by a cute little girl isn't so bad either!
m920217.ハッハァッ！ 及ばねぇなァ！？: Hah-haah! You can't keep up with me, can you?!
m920217.ハハハ、スイカなら余るほどある。\nおかわりも遠慮せずしてくれたまえ！:
Hahaha, we have plenty of watermelons to spare.
Please, help yourselves to seconds!
m920217.ハハハ、心配無用、これは魔界産ではない。\n少し特別だが、物質界産の美味しいスイ:
Hahaha, don't worry. This one isn't from the Demon Realm.
It's a bit special, but it's a delicious watermelon from the Material World.
m920217.バルバロス・マグヌスまで出てきたときは、\nさすがの私も内心では少し焦りましたよ:
When Barbalos Magnus appeared,
even I was a little shaken inside, I must admit.
m920217.フォローになってねぇぞオイ！？: That's not following the story at all, you idiot!
m920217.フッ……ボロボロだぜ、身も心もな……。: Hah…… I'm a wreck, body and soul……
m920217.フハハハハ！ そうだろう、そうだろう！\nここはデモシェフ商会の総力を結集して建:
Fuhahaha! I knew it, I knew it!
This is a brand-new, large-scale complex resort facility, built with the full might of the Demon Chef Trading Company!
m920217.フルーツポンチもご用意できますよ。: We can prepare fruit punch as well.
m920217.リゾート施設内の安全確保のために、\nグルメジャングルの王者との交渉を行った際、:
When we negotiated with the ruler of the Gourmet Jungle to ensure
safety within the resort facility,
the magical beasts remembered the taste of the watermelon we brought.
m920217.レジャーは楽しく、食事は美味しく。\n愉快で快適な旅行体験を約束するとも。:
Leisure is fun, and the food is delicious.
I promise you a pleasant and comfortable travel experience.
m920217.ワオ！ ユーアーグレートソルジャー！: Wow! You are a great soldier!
m920217.ワシはジャイアントアノマロカリス漁の途中でね。\n君たちはダイビングか、デモシェ: I was in the middle of my Giant Anomalocaris hunt. Are you diving? Is this provided by the Demoshef Company?
m920217.ワシを、許すと言うのかい……？: You… are willing to forgive me?
m920217.一度だけ、ジャングルにまで姿を現したことがある。\nそのとき、目撃者は奴をこう呼:
It has only once manifested itself as far as the jungle.
At that time, the witnesses called it this—
m920217.上空から岩をぶつけることで獲物を弱らせ、\n巣に運んで食べてしまう凶悪なドラゴン:
They're vicious dragons that weaken their prey by dropping rocks from the sky,
then carry them back to their nests to eat.
m920217.上等な品ですわね、産地をお訊ねしても？: It's a fine specimen, indeed. May I ask where it's from?
m920217.乱獲され個体数が激減したのも、\nそれが原因だったはずですわ。: That is likely why overfishing caused the population to plummet in the first place.
m920217.事前に海水で冷やしておいたスイカが、\n騒動の余波で海に流れてしまったのです。\:
The watermelons we had chilling in the seawater
ended up washed out during the commotion.
……So we just need to retrieve all of them, right?
m920217.今回はデモシェフ商会の気合が窺えますねぇ。\n本気でグルメジャングルを物質界でも:
You can really feel the Demon Chef Trading Company's dedication this time.
They might be seriously trying to turn the Gourmet Jungle into a top-tier resort in the Material World.
m920217.今朝収穫したばかりの新鮮なスイカです。\nこちらでスイカ割りなどどうかと思いまし:
It was harvested fresh this morning.
I thought we might try our hand at watermelon cutting.
m920217.仕方ねぇ、避難完了までの時間稼ぎだ。: I guess we have no choice. We'll just have to buy time until the evacuation is done.
m920217.何でも星占いのせいにできると思うなよ！？: Don't you dare blame everything on the stars!
m920217.先にそれを言え！ アイツら連れ去られるぞ！: Say that first! They're going to get them off with them!
m920217.全然元気じゃねぇか！？: He doesn't look even a little tired!
m920217.出来立てのリゾート地に来てるぐらいですからねー。\nゴブリンの中でもかなりの富裕:
Well, they are staying at a brand-new resort.
They might be part of the goblin upper class.
That probably means they have a bit more education and refinement than the average goblin.
m920217.分かりました、私も前に出ますので、\n辛くなったらすぐに言ってくださいね？:
Understood. I'll take the front line, so
please tell me right away if it gets too tough, okay?
m920217.副デーモンシェフ、持ってきてくれたか。: Deputy Demon Chef, you brought it, did you?
m920217.勝って、食って、気持ちよく寝るぞ！: Let's win, eat, and get some well-earned rest!
m920217.千年戦争を戦い抜いた者にしか分からない、\n彼女たちだけの特別な絆があるのでしょ:
There must be a special bond between them
that only those who have fought the Millennium War can understand.
m920217.向こうの者たちを見てみよ。\nせっせとスイカを回収しておる。\n汝らも見習って早:
Look at the others over there.
They are diligently retrieving the watermelons.
You should follow their example and get to work──
m920217.周囲を巻き込んで今回の大規模侵攻に発展したと。: And it escalated into this large-scale invasion, dragging the surroundings into the chaos.
m920217.味は聞いてないぞ。: I haven't heard anything about their taste.
m920217.善意だから余計厄介だってんだよ！: It's precisely because it's good intentions that it's troublesome!
m920217.喧嘩しないの。そろそろ次の波が来るわよ。: No fighting. The next wave is coming.
m920217.大丈夫かよ、カカオみてぇに暴れねぇだろうな。: You sure it's safe? It's not gonna go wild like that cocoa, right?
m920217.大丈夫ですか？ 日射しが強いようですけど……。: Are you alright? The sun seems quite intense...
m920217.大口の顧客から依頼があったんだよ。\nジャイアントアノマロカリスが欲しいとね。\: I received a request from a major client. They wanted a Giant Anomalocaris. Apparently, they intend to use it to treat their daughter.
m920217.奴らを餌で釣って進路を誘導し、\n集まったところを一網打尽にする。:
We will lure them with bait to guide their path,
then wipe them all out once they gather.
m920217.実際、多少のトラブルは想定していましたが、\n今のところその気配もなく快適そのも: I did anticipate a few hiccups, but so far, it's been nothing but smooth sailing.
m920217.導きの星もそれ見たことかと爆笑していることでしょう。: The Star of Guidance is probably laughing its head off at the sight of all this.
m920217.待って、ただでさえ魔獣の侵攻が激しいってのに、\nここで二手に分かれちゃあ各個撃:
Wait, the magic beast invasion is already intense enough.
If we split up here, we'll just get picked off one by one.
m920217.待て、あれは我が社の従業員ではないぞ？: Wait, those are not our employees?
m920217.後生ですから嵐雨はおやめください。:
Please, for the sake of the facility, no storms.
--- scene: Ancient Species Attack (battle, end) ---
m920217.心意気は立派だが、実力が伴わねぇとな。\n無理なら無理と言うのも勇気の一つだぜ。:
That's a noble sentiment, but it's useless without the skill to back it up.
Knowing when to back down is a kind of courage, too.
m920217.急いで警備員を向かわせろ！\n怪我人が出る前に避難を完了させるのだ！:
Send the security guards immediately!
Get the evacuation finished before anyone gets hurt!
m920217.悠長に話している場合ではないだろう！\nあんなものが暴れたらリゾートは滅茶苦茶だ:
We don't have time for small talk!
If that thing goes on a rampage, the resort will be destroyed!
We should begin evacuating off the island immediately!
m920217.意外とそうでもないのかもしれんぞ。\n実際、スイカは純粋に美味しいのだし。:
It might not be that simple.
After all, the watermelon was genuinely delicious.
m920217.慰安旅行も合同演習もいつもの場所でいいだろ。\nわざわざ見えてる地雷を踏みに行く:
A company trip or a joint exercise can just happen at the usual place.
There's no reason to deliberately step on a landmine we can see coming.
m920217.我々レベルになると気配で場所が分かるからな。\n目隠し程度では大した問題にはなら:
At our level, we can sense where it is just by the aura.
A blindfold wouldn't pose much of a challenge.
m920217.手羽先の唐揚げが美味しい翼竜だ！\n甘辛いタレに絡めると実に美味だぞ！:
They're pterodactyls with delicious fried wing tips!
Coating them in a sweet and spicy sauce makes them absolutely divine!
m920217.散れ散れ！ 誰が行くんだよそんな厄ネタ！\n絶対にロクなことにならねぇって分かる:
Scatter, scatter! Who's going to such a cursed place?
You know it's bound to go wrong!
m920217.新鮮な高級食材もたんまりとありますからねー。\n魔界の寵児の手腕、とことん見せて:
We have plenty of fresh, high-end ingredients, too.
I can't wait to see the full extent of the Demon Chef's skills.
m920217.日頃のストレス解消のために始めた家庭菜園が、\nグルメジャングルの土壌と化学反応:
I started a home garden to relieve my daily stress, and it
had a chemical reaction with the soil of the Gourmet Jungle…
m920217.未だかつて誰一人としてその全容を知らぬ彼の地には、\n古代より姿を変えずに生きる:
No one has ever known the full extent of that place.
It is said that giant beasts have lived there unchanged since ancient times.
m920217.本来ならばここはグルメアイランドとでも言うべき土地。\nしかし、そう呼ばれていな:
Properly speaking, this land should be called the Gourmet Island.
However, there is a good reason it is not known by that name.
m920217.極めて卑劣で低俗な手ですが、効果的な戦術かと。\nやはり闇の組織の幹部、中々の策:
It is an extremely despicable and vulgar tactic, but an effective one.
As expected of a high-ranking member of a dark organization, he is quite the strategist.
m920217.残りの夏は、ゆっくり過ごせそうでなによりだ。: I'm glad we can spend the rest of the summer at our leisure.
m920217.気持ちは分からないでもないですけどね。\nこのスイカ、とんでもなく美味しいですし:
I can't say I don't understand.
These watermelons are incredibly delicious.
m920217.決してジャングルの向こうには行ってはいけない。\nそこは、人類の生存圏から大きく:
You must never go beyond the jungle.
That is a land of death, far removed from the sphere of human survival.
m920217.海にいっぱいスイカが浮いてますー！: There's a ton of watermelons floating in the sea!
m920217.海中ではいつも戦ってばかりでしたからね、\nたまにはこういうのも新鮮で良いと思い: We are always fighting underwater, after all. It's nice to do something fresh like this once in a while.
m920217.王子殿下には改めて感謝しませんと。\n我々もリゾートに誘っていただけて──: We must thank Your Highness once again. We were even invited to the resort──
m920217.皆様、この度はデモシェフ商会プレゼンツ。\n人魚のスキューバダイビングにようこそ: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the Mermaid Scuba Diving, presented by the Demoshef Company~♪
m920217.礼はいいから早く建物に入れ！\n連れて行かれても知らねぇからな！:
Save the thanks and get inside the building!
I'm not responsible if they take you!
m920217.移れじゃねぇよ、お前も集めんだよ。: Don't tell me to "begin it," you're supposed to help gather them too.
m920217.結局、このスイカはどこで仕入れたんですの？\nどうやら貴重な代物というのは分かり:
Where on earth did you get these watermelons from?
I can tell they're quite rare, but…
m920217.縁を切れそんな星。: Cut ties with a star like that.
m920217.義理人情と損得勘定、どちらも重要です。\nゆえにどちらが正しいということもありま:
Both obligation and self-interest are important.
Therefore, neither can be said to be entirely correct.
In that case, let's leave the decision to our representative.
m920217.脳が理解を拒否するワードだぜ……。: My brain is refusing to process that word...
m920217.自分たちが狩る側だと思ってる馬鹿共に、\n年季の違いってやつを教えてやるとするか:
Let's teach these fools who think they're the hunters
the difference between a rookie and a veteran.
m920217.船長ォ！？ ひでぇ、奴ら鬼かよ！？: Captain!? Ugh, are those guys demons or what!?
m920217.蛮王……ってことはトゥアンの親戚？: The Barbarian King… so is he Tuan's relative?
m920217.蛮王──バルバロス・マグヌス。\nその拳を受けて立っていられる者はいないと。:
The Barbarian King—Barbalos Magnus.
No one can stand before its fists.
m920217.許すかどうかを決めるのは漁師の方々ですわ。\n私たちはただ、謝罪の場を設けるだけ: It is up to the fishermen to decide whether to forgive you. We are merely providing a chance to apologize.
m920217.転んで怪我しないように気を付けて！: Be careful not to fall and get hurt!
m920217.陽気なゴブリンたちが襲われているぞ！\n見たことのないタイプのドラゴンだ！:
The cheerful goblins are under attack!
They're a type of dragon I've never seen before!
m920217.頑張ってこの島の天気を嵐にしちゃいますので！: I'm going to work hard to turn this island's weather into a storm!
m920217.食べたいですー！: I want to eat that too!
m920217.食べ過ぎ厳禁ですからねー。\nあなた減量終わってないでしょ？:
Now, now, no overeating.
You haven't finished your diet, have you?
m920217.馬鹿な！？ 施設の警備体制は完璧なはず……！: What nonsense?! Our security protocols are supposed to be flawless...!
m920217.馬鹿め、我は女王であるぞ？\n頭脳労働担当に決まっているであろう。:
Fool. I am a queen.
It is obvious that my role is mental labor.
m920217.魔獣たち、スイカに釣られ順調に集まっています。\nもう間もなく接敵する予想です、:
The magical beasts are taking the bait and gathering smoothly.
We expect contact soon. All units, prepare to intercept.
m920217.魔獣たちは一度知ったスイカの味を忘れられず、\nジャングルの王者の制止を振り切っ:
Unable to forget the taste of the watermelon they had once known,
the beasts ignored the ruler's warnings and went on a rampage.
m920217.魔獣の大群、来ます！: A massive horde of magical beasts is coming!
m920217.（……グルメジャングルより王国の方が危険では──？): (……Is the Kingdom actually more dangerous than the Gourmet Jungle?)
m920217.（こいつが自信満々のときって、\nなんかちょっと不安なんだよなー）: (When he gets that confident look on his face, it actually makes me a little nervous...)
m920217.（なんとも惨めですが……不思議と惹かれませんねぇ……）: (It's quite a sorry state of affairs…… yet strangely, I find myself drawn to it……)
m920217.（やはり誠心誠意か……。\n結局のところ商売で一番大事なのは、\n『心』なのかも:
(So it really does come down to sincerity……
In the end, the most important thing in business
might just be having a good "heart"……)

m920220.……そういえば群青姉妹は？: ……Oh right, what about the Indigo Sisters?
m920220.……そうですね、今は快復を待ちましょう。: ……Yes, let's wait for her to recover for now.
m920220.……なんか、思ったより爽やかに終わったな。: ……Huh, that ended more smoothly than I expected.
m920220.……ふぅ、あの子もまだまだみたいね。帰るわよ。: ……Hmph. That child still has a long way to go. Let's go.
m920220.……ふっ、大丈夫なのですか？\n修道会の異端審問官ともあろう御方が、\n神の御業:
……Hm. Are you alright?
As the Inquisition Officer of the Order,
you should not speak as if doubting the work of God.
m920220.……アイネさん、すごく落ち着いた方ですね。\n戦神マレスの無茶振りに少しも動じて:
……Aine-san, you're remarkably calm.
You don't seem the least bit rattled by War God Mares' outrageous requests.
m920220.……心当たりはいくつかありますが、\n憶測でものを言うのはやめておきましょう。\:
……There are a few possibilities,
but let's not jump to conclusions.
We'll hear her side of the story once she wakes up.
m920220.……金糸雀か紫苑呼んでこよっか？: ……Should I go call for the Golden Nightingale or the Aster?
m920220.──そこまで、勝者は王国の王子！: ──That's enough. The winner is the Prince of the Kingdom!
m920220.──それで、団長の容体は？: And how is the Captain doing?
m920220.──アイネ、決勝の相手はどんなやつなんだ？: ──Aine, who are we up against in the finals?
m920220.──ッ、分かったよ！ やりゃあいいんだろ！？: —Got it! You want me to fight, right?!
m920220.──二試合目の挑戦者を発表しましょう。: ──Let us announce the challenger for the second match.
m920220.──師から受け継ぎし我が奥義を見よ！: Behold the secret art I inherited from my master!
m920220.──待っていたぞ、王国の戦士たちよ。: ──I've been waiting for you, warriors of the Kingdom.
m920220.──我が名はゴブリン王子、小鬼の未来を照らす者なリ。: ──I am the Goblin Prince, the one who illuminates the future of the goblins.
m920220.──改めて、此度の司会進行を務めるアイネと申します。: ──Allow me to introduce myself once more. I am Aine, your host for this event.
m920220.──早く行け！ 長くは保たんぞ！: Hurry! I can't hold out much longer!
m920220.──時間です、最初の挑戦者を紹介しましょう。\n彼こそは魔界の冬を担う者、キング:
──The time has come. Let us introduce the first challenger.
He is the one who bears the winter of the Demon Realm: the King of Snowmen.
m920220.──有象無象と宿命付けられ、\nこの世に生まれた者たちがいた。:
──There were those born into this world,

doomed to be labeled as mere nobodies.
m920220.『…………フッ』じゃねーのにゃ。\n絶対そんなこと考えてないのにゃよ。:
It's not like he was “Heh”ing on purpose.
He definitely wasn't thinking about that at all.
m920220.『──などと、今頃ウルカノが喚いていることだろう。\nしかしそこは流石の俺様、貴:
『──As I thought, that's probably what Vulcano is yelling about right now.
But of course, I, your humble master, am well aware of your current situation.』

I will neither achieve my ideal nor face judgment for my sins.

I will die alone, the very hypocrite I despised most.)
m920220.（ふん……卑怯者の私には似合いの末路か）: (Hmph… a fitting end for a coward like me.)
m920220.（今まで多くの者の尊厳を踏み躙ってきた。\n何も知らぬ部下を騙し、彼らの信仰を穢:
(I have trampled the dignity of so many.

I deceived my own subordinates, who knew nothing, and defiled their faith.

For the sake of my ideal, I have stained my hands in blood.)
m920220.（今回は幻影な分、効いちゃあいるんだろうが……）: (Since it's just a phantom this time, it probably won't affect him much……)
m920220.（摩訶イタチは傷つくほどに凶暴性を増し、\n疾風のような速さで戦場を駆け抜ける難:
(The Maha Weasel grows more ferocious with every wound it takes,
a formidable foe that races across the battlefield like a gale—)

m940002.――あ、あなたたち！\nこっちには前チャンプ、アナトリア様がいるんですよ！？\n:
――Ah, you guys!
The former champion, Lady Anatolia, is right here!
At the very least, let's talk first――
m940002.――あ、あれ？\nあの雪上部隊って、帝国軍とは違うよね……。\nベラート伯爵の紋:
—Wait, what is that?
That snow unit doesn't look like the Imperial army, does it…….
They're bearing Count Belard's crest…….
m940002.――あえて、帝国の布陣が完了するのを待つとは。\n盟友ハイドース殿は、\n奴らに:
——To deliberately wait until the Empire's formation is complete.
It seems our ally, Lord Hydos,
intends to leave them with not a shred of an excuse.
m940002.――あれは……大変です！\nもう戦闘が始まりそうですよ！:
――That is……bad news!
It looks like combat is about to begin!
m940002.――あれは古の、帝国騎士団。\n骸帝が編み出した剣技を担う、我々の先達です！:
――Those are the ancient Imperial Knights.
Our predecessors who wielded the sword techniques devised by the Skeletal Emperor!
m940002.――いいや、その歩みはここで止めさせてもらう。: —No. I'll have to stop you right here.
m940002.――いや、いるよ。\n正規軍は忠誠心の高い兵士ばかりだけど、\nそうじゃない連中:
—No, there is.
The regular army is full of loyal soldiers,
but there are others in the Empire who aren't.
m940002.――いや、訂正しよう。\nそうか、セグナンド、貴様も戦士の顔になったな。\nどう:
—No, let me correct that.
I see. Segnand, you've finally taken on the face of a warrior.
It seems you've made up your mind.
m940002.――うぅぅぅ、どうしよ、どうしたらいい？\nボクにできること、何かない！？:
――Uuuu, what do I do, what should I do?
Is there anything I can do?!
m940002.――えっ、こんな北の僻地まで、\n王国軍が視察に来てるの？:
???: ――Huh? The Kingdom's army is doing an inspection
all the way out in this northern backwater?
m940002.――おぉっと……そのまま、\n動くんじゃねぇ……ぞっ、とぉッ！！:
???: —Oh, hold on… don't just
move like that… gotcha!
m940002.――おお、久方ぶりの物質界だ。\nここは白の帝国だな。\nははは、昔もこの辺りま:
――Oh, it has been a long time since I last walked the material world.
So this is the White Empire.
Hahaha, we pushed as far as this region in the old days, too!
m940002.――おっと、ここにいたか！\nそろそろ戦闘が始まるぜ、\n連中が砦の「城門」に押:
――Oh, so you're here!
The battle is about to start.
They're swarming toward the fort's "Main Gate"!
m940002.――けっ、これだから気に入らねぇんだ。\n思いやりと慈しみなんかで、\n無数に増:
――Tch. That's exactly what I can't stand.
Do you really think compassion and mercy
are enough to deal with the endless tide of the dead?
m940002.――ここが、憎きアダマスを信仰する国、か。: ――So this is the land that worships the detestable Adamas.
m940002.――ここまで、堕ちたか。\n仇を討つでもなく、強き者との戦いを望むでもなく、\n:
――So this is how far you have fallen.
Not seeking revenge, not yearning for battle with the strong,
but instead making plans to slink away with your tails between your legs.
m940002.――この先だ。\n冥界第二層で、私の部族は匿ってもらっている。:
—It's ahead of us.

Our tribe is being sheltered on the second layer of the Underworld.
m940002.――この冥界にて蘇りし、\n最も強き時代の帝国軍にて、今の帝国を終わらせよう。:
――Here in the Underworld, resurrected,
we shall end the current Empire with the might of the strongest era's army.
m940002.――この場に、言葉が必要か？: ――Are words necessary in a place like this?
m940002.――この港が落ちるか否か。\nこの戦いが、帝国の試金石となる。:
――Whether this port falls or not.
This battle will be the Empire's trial by fire.
m940002.――これで終わりか、冥界軍。\n皇帝の首はここだぞ。:
――Is this the end, Netherworld Army?
The Emperor's head is right here.
m940002.――さぁ、女神アダマスよ。\n此度の戦は始まったばかり。\nその首、どう落として:
Now then, Goddess Adamas.
This war has only just begun.
I wonder how I shall claim that head…
m940002.――さて、そろそろ時間か。\n帝国軍、王国軍の目は洋上に引きつけた。\n……上手:
――Well, it seems the time has come.
We've drawn the eyes of both the Imperial and Royal armies to the sea.
……Do your best, Lord Segundo.
m940002.――さて、どう出る冥界軍。\nこちらの備えは万全だぞ？:
――Now then, what will the Netherworld army do?
Our defenses are fully prepared.
m940002.――そこに、亜神にあってはならない、\n私怨が存在しないと本当に言い切れるのかし:
――Can you truly say with certainty that there is no personal grudge there,
something a demi-god ought not to harbor?
m940002.――そして、今やその理想に呼応する者は、\nこの物質界だけに留まらないのだよ。:
――And now, those who answer that ideal
are no longer confined to this material world.
m940002.――そんなバカな。\n皆、気を抜くな！ オーク勇者が立ち上がった！:
――No way.
Everyone, stay sharp! The orc heroes have risen!
m940002.――だが、だからこそ、この戦はワシらのものよ。\n戦果を取られたくなければ、\n:
――But that is precisely why this battle is ours.
If you don't want your glory stolen,
follow us without hesitation, you orcs of the current generation!!
m940002.――だがなぁ、呼び声に応えてしまったワシらも悪いが、\nあまり死者に頼るでないぞ:
――But, while we may have answered the call,
you shouldn't rely on the dead too much, young one.
m940002.――で、伝令！ 伝令ッ！！\n左翼歩兵部隊、被害甚大！\n再編成が間に合いません:
――And the messenger! The messenger!!
The left-wing infantry has taken heavy casualties!
We can't reorganize in time! Send reinforcements immediately!
m940002.――では、また会いましょうぞ。\n白の王国を、取り戻すために。:
—Then, until we meet again.
To reclaim the White Kingdom.
m940002.――では、此度の大戦、\nもはや異種族と帝国の戦いには収まらないということか。\:
――So this great war
can no longer be contained to a conflict between the other races and the Empire.
You are turning your blades against soldiers of the same nation, are you not?
m940002.――でも、この戦いは勝てるよ。\n何しろ砦ひとつの防衛に、\n我が愛しの王子が参:
――But we're going to win this fight.
After all, my beloved Prince is fighting alongside us
to defend a single fortress!!
m940002.――ところで、リンクスよ。\nそろそろ、良いのではないか？:
――Now then, Lynx.
I believe the moment has come.
m940002.――どうか、私の家族たちを助けてほしい。\nあの、人の形をした災禍、\n死してな:
—Please, save my family.

Kill that disaster in human form,

the Third Emperor of the White, who rages even in death.
m940002.――なぜ、私たちを置いていった。\n我が献身は、我が忠誠は、\n決してハイドース:
—Why did you leave us behind.
My devotion, my loyalty,
were never directed at Haidos.
m940002.――ならば、冥界軍の蜂起に際して、\n君らも帝国に反旗を翻すと思っていたのさ。: If that's the case, I had assumed you would have raised the banner of rebellion against the Empire when the Netherworld forces revolted.
m940002.――なるほど、ね……。\n白の帝国だけならまだしも、\n王国がここまで厄介だなん:
――I see…….
If it were just the White Empire, it would be one thing,
but for the Kingdom to be this troublesome…….
m940002.――ねぇレーネ、どうして追ってきたの？: ――Hey, Lehne, why did you follow us?
m940002.――ねぇ！ ちょっとー！\nアタシひとりじゃ限界があるんだけどー！！:
―Hey! Just a sec!
I'm reaching my limit here, okay!!
m940002.――はぁ……やれやれ……。\n獣人の誇りとか何とか、\nそんなのアタシだって分か:
―Haa... Oh, come on...
I know all about Beastman pride and whatnot.
m940002.――はっ。\n総員、陣形を整えろ！\nまもなく敵の第二波が来るぞ！:
――Yes, sir.
All units, form up!
The enemy's second wave is coming soon!
m940002.――はっ！！\n斥候は下がれ。その傷では戦えないだろう。:
—Yes, sir!
Scout, fall back. You can't fight with that wound.
m940002.――ふむ、帝国軍ばかりか王国軍までも。\n帝都からにしては、随分と早い到着だ。:
――Hm, not just Imperial soldiers, but the Kingdom's army as well.
For a force coming from the Imperial Capital,
they've arrived remarkably quickly.
m940002.――ほら、そこから\nこちらを見張っている、伏兵がいたりするからね！:
—There.
Someone's watching us from over there.
Looks like we've got ambushers!
m940002.――まったく、セグナンドにも呆れたものだな。\n前線に出た時の、あの表情を見たか: ——Truly, I am exasperated with Segnando. Did you see that expression on his face when he went to the front lines?
m940002.――もう、気付いているのだろう？\n今の帝国は、既に限界なのだと。:
――You must have realized it by now,
don't you? The Empire has already reached its limit.
m940002.――やられたことと、同じ手段をもって報復する。\nそれも正々堂々と、真正面から。:
――They've been wronged, and they're striking back with the same means.
Fair and square, head-on.
That's why they've risen again, I suppose.
m940002.――やられました。\n陛下、ダークエルフの野営地は、\n骸帝の配下と思しき部隊に:
—We've been defeated.
Your Majesty, the Dark Elf camp has been
occupied by what appears to be Skeleton Emperor forces.
m940002.――よし、敵拠点を潰せたか。\nこれで多少は動きやすくなるな。:
――Good, we've destroyed an enemy stronghold.
This should give us a bit more room to maneuver.
m940002.――オークの王よ、なぜこの地に留まる。: ??? : ――King of the Orcs, why do you remain here?
m940002.――ダークエルフの部隊が、砂浜に上陸します！: ――A Dark Elf unit is landing on the beach!
m940002.――ダークエルフ居留地だが、\nひとまず、東の森を開墾することとする。:
――Regarding the Dark Elf settlement,
we will begin by clearing the eastern forest for cultivation.
m940002.――ッ、な、なに？ なんだか地面が揺れてるような！: ――Wha, what? The ground feels like it's shaking!
m940002.――ッ！\n貴様は……。\nなぜ生きている、その神器は何だ？:
――Hah!
You….
Why are you still alive? What is that divine weapon?
m940002.――ディアナ様！\n王国の死霊魔術師より報告です！\n周辺から、異様な魔力を感知:
――Lady Diana!
A report from the Kingdom's necromancers!
They've detected unusual magical energy in the vicinity!
m940002.――ハイドースが黒炎をまとって……。\nいいえ、これは……！:
――Hydos is enveloped in Black Flame…….
No, this is……!
m940002.――ハイドース様。\n帝国の防衛網が偏り始めたわ。:
――My lord Hydos.
The Empire's defensive lines are beginning to shift.
m940002.――ハハッ、今の世を生きる若人たちに、\nこんな捨て身の攻撃をさせるわけにはいか:
――Hah! I can't let the young ones of this age
make such a desperate sacrifice.
m940002.――マルレーン！ 陛下っ！ 王子殿下ぁ！！\nはぁっ……はぁ……っ！！\nほ、報:
—Marleen! Your Majesty! Prince!!
Haa……huff……!!
I'm……here to report! This is a report!!
m940002.――リンクスよ、指揮官が前線に出るなとは、\n確かお前から聞いた言葉ではなかった:
――Lynx, didn't you once say
that a commander should not take the front lines?
m940002.――リンクス！\nようやく、ようやく追いつきました……。:
――Lynx!
I finally… finally caught up to you…
m940002.――三代目、白の帝国皇帝。\n帝国領土を盤石のものとした、\n血と骸による勝利の:
――The Third, the White Emperor of the Empire.
The true emperor who stands upon a victory forged in blood and bone,
having secured the Empire's territory as unshakeable as stone.
m940002.――下がって！\nなにぼーっとしてるの！？:
――Get back!
What are you standing there for!?
m940002.――亜神にその刃を届かせるか。\n見事だ、白の皇帝よ。:
――To bring your blade to a demigod.
Impressive, White Emperor.
m940002.――人ガ空を飛ぶ時代カ……。\n不敬ダト言ってやりたいトコロダガ、\nむしろコレ:
—The age when humans fly through the sky…
I would call it an affront to tradition,
but perhaps this is the true power of humanity.
m940002.――伝令！ 伝令！\nオーク部隊に不穏な動きあり！\n敵部隊に――新たにオークの:
――A messenger! A messenger!
Unusual movements among the Orc units!
A new Orc Hero has joined the enemy forces!
m940002.――伯爵は上手くやっているようね。\n自尊心ばかり高い俗物かと思えば、\nそれな:
――The Count is doing a decent job.
I thought he was just a vain fool,
but he's actually quite useful.
m940002.――体勢を整えるため、あえて撤退した、\nといったところかな、あちらの部隊は。: ――and more that their units deliberately withdrew to regroup.
m940002.――傷つき、倒れ、命が散っていく。\n悲しいものだな、我が冥界の力が満ちるほどに:
――They are wounded, they fall, and their lives are scattered.
How tragic. As the power of my Underworld swells,
so too does the chain of tragedy spread across this earth.
m940002.――先代、まさか本当に蘇ってくるとは。: Predecessor… I never truly expected you to return.
m940002.――全員等しく、オレが裁いてやるよッ！！: ――I will judge every single one of you equally!!
m940002.――兵には、小休止を取らせろ。\nこの男は、俺が弔う。:
――Give the troops a brief rest.
I will see to this man's farewell.
m940002.――冥界、どうやって行くんだろう。: ――How are we supposed to get to the Underworld, anyway?
m940002.――冥界軍を迎え撃つぞ、総員配置につけ！！: ――Prepare to meet the Netherworld army! All units, take your positions!
m940002.――出撃命令だ。\n……いや、でも行き先は封鎖階層って言っていたよな。:
――Deployment order.
…Wait, but didn't they say the destination was the Sealed Layer?
m940002.――勝利より、兵を取りましたか。\nさすがは冥界の亜神。:
???: ――You have taken soldiers rather than victory.
Truly fitting for a Sub-deity of the Netherworld.
m940002.――単純に考えるのなら、\n亜神ハイドースの魔力の総量でしょうね。:
――If we think simply,
it would be the total amount of magical power possessed by the Lesser God Hyades.
m940002.――友を迎えるのが、随分と遅くなってしまった。\nちびっこではなく友として、\n:
――It took me far too long to welcome a friend.
Not as a little one, but as a friend,
the day has come for you to become a warrior who roars.
m940002.――反逆？\nどうやら勘違いしているようだな。:
――Rebel?
It seems you have us all mixed up.
m940002.――古い砦だな。\n冥界にこんなものがあるとは、\n死者の国にも、穏やかでない時:
――An old fortress.
To think the Underworld has something like this.
It seems the Land of the Dead has had its turbulent times, too.
m940002.――否、ダ。\nハルモニアよ、こちらへ付くナラバ好きにシロ。\nそうでないならば:
――No.
Harmonia, if you wish to stay by my side, do as you please.
If not, then die by my thunder, along with the people of this land.
m940002.――国とか種族とかどうでもいい。\nあたしが戦うのは、あたしの前で誰も死なせない:
――Countries and races are none of my business.
I fight so that no one dies in front of me.
m940002.――地下からでも、\n物質界に戻れるのではなくて？:
――So we can return to the Material World
from below, then?
m940002.――報告！\n敵軍が回り込む形で、工場地帯に侵入とのこと！:
――Report!
The enemy is flanking us and has breached the industrial district!
m940002.――報告！\n無数のアンデッドが砦に接近中！:
――Report!
Countless undead are approaching the fortress!
m940002.――失礼します。\nダークエルフ族長、セグナンド氏のご息女、\nイルヴィ様をお連:
—Pardon the intrusion.

I have brought Ilvi, daughter of Segnando,

the chieftain of the Dark Elves.
m940002.――存外、早かったな。\nしかしこの男の時間稼ぎも、意味があったか。:
――That was faster than expected.
But it seems that man's stalling bought us some time.
m940002.――弱い、弱すぎるぞ。\nそれでも白の帝国の名を継ぐ者たちか？:
――Weak. Far too weak.
Are these the ones who carry the name of the White Empire?
m940002.――必ず、この国が崩壊するより前に、\n祖国をこの歪みきった体制から開放するのだ:
——I swear, before this nation crumbles,
I will free our homeland from this twisted regime!!
m940002.――悔いておるのか、メリュジアナ。\nおぬしが王国に付くことを選んだその時に、\:
――Are you regretting it, Meliusiana?
That when you chose to stand with the Kingdom,
you did not take care of those who chose to part ways.
m940002.――悲しみが聴こえます。\nただただ、悲哀が、嘆きの音だけが。:
???: ――I can hear the sorrow.
Only grief, only the sound of lamentation.
m940002.――我が兵よ、我が民たちよ、今行くぞ！\n黄金に輝く鋼の騎馬！\n最新鋭バトルタ:
――My soldiers, my people, we move now!
Behold the golden gleam of our steel cavalry!
Witness the might of our state-of-the-art battle tanks!
m940002.――我が同胞たちよ、魔界の連中とは違う、\n物質界に生きる強きダークエルフの同胞:
――My fellow tribesmen! You strong Dark Elves
who live in the material world, unlike those of the Demon Realm!
m940002.――我が悲願、その最初の一手。\n憎きアダマスの首が、今や目前にある。:
――The first move toward my long-held wish.
The head of my hated Adamas is now within reach.
m940002.――我らが父祖の地を害した帝国に鉄槌を！\n流れた血は、同量の血によって贖わせる:
――Let us strike the Empire that harmed our ancestral lands with an iron fist!
The blood that has been spilled shall be avenged with an equal measure of blood!
m940002.――戦う理由、\nどうやら見つかったようだね、我が友よ。: ――It seems we have found our reason to fight, my friend.
m940002.――戦争など、強がりで参戦するものではない、か。\nそんなこと、最初から分かって:
―War is not something you join with mere bravado, is it.
I knew that from the very beginning...
m940002.――敵は市街に侵入した可能性がある。\n帝国の兵よ、民を守ることを最優先としろ！:
The enemy may have breached the city.
Soldiers of the Empire, the protection of the civilians is your top priority!
m940002.――敵襲ー！ 敵襲です！！\nオークの部隊が動き始めましたー！！:
――Enemy attack! It's an enemy attack!!
The Orc units are starting to move!
m940002.――未だコノ身、雷霆まとう竜には及ばヌが。\n闇水晶が力をモッテ、その一端を見せ:
――Though this body cannot yet match the dragon clad in thunder,
the Dark Crystal grants me power. Let me show you a glimpse of it.
m940002.――本当に死者を、それもオーク勇者を蘇らせるとは。\nハイドースの権能は底なしな:
――To actually resurrect the dead, and orc heroes of all things.
Is Hydos's power truly bottomless?
m940002.――殿下、下がってください！\n何かが出現しようとしています！！:
――Your Highness, get back!
Something is about to appear!!
m940002.――法を破ったのは、どちらかしら。\nハイドース様……いえ、亜神ハイドースの侵攻:
――Now then, which one of us is the one breaking the law?
Lord Heidemarie… no, the demi-god Heidemarie's invasion…
Can it truly be said to have been conducted in accordance with the law?
m940002.――王子、吹雪が迫ってるよ。\nこのままだと、遠距離がより狙いにくくなるかも……:
—Prince, a blizzard is approaching.
If we stay here, it might make it harder for our ranged units to hit their targets…….
m940002.――王子様、城壁が破られました。\n獣人部隊の強襲……これは、リンクスの部隊です:
――Prince, the city wall has been breached!
A beastmen unit is launching a surprise attack… This is Linkus's unit!
m940002.――王子！ 冥界軍が前線を下げ始めました！: ――Prince! The Netherworld army is falling back!
m940002.――皆、こっちだ！\nあの氷原の向こうに、私たちの野営地がある！:
—Everyone, this way!
Our camp is just beyond that ice field!
m940002.――私ならそうする、ということです。\nまだセグナンドは手の内を見せていない、\:

m940002.……どうやら、話は通じていないようだな。: ……It seems we aren't getting through to her.
m940002.……どうやら、話は通じるようだな。: ……It seems we can communicate after all.
m940002.……なるほど、狙いは俺の首ひとつではなく、\n白の帝国そのもの、ということか。:
……I see. Their target isn't just my head,
but the White Empire itself.
m940002.……なるほど。\nつまりこれから向かうのは……。:
...I see.
So the place we're heading to is...
m940002.……ねぇマルゴット。\nどうしても陥としたい都市があったら、\nマルゴットならど:
……Hey, Margot.
If there was a city you absolutely had to capture,
what would you do?
m940002.……はぁ、はぁ。\n補給が追いついてないなぁ……。\n他に支援が欲しい前線は！？:
???: ……Hah, hah.
Supply lines are failing to keep up…….
Are there other front lines requesting support?!
m940002.……はぁ、やるしかない、かぁ。\nマルゴット、他の兵士にも伝えに行こ。:
……Haa, I guess we have no choice.
Margot, let's go warn the other soldiers.
m940002.……はぁ。\nこれでは戦場ではなく、子猫の喧嘩じゃないか。:
……Haa.
This isn't a battlefield, it's a kitten's quarrel.
m940002.……はぁ。\n軍師が取り乱してどうするのですか。\nロミルダ、この軍師どこかに連:
……Hah.
What's the use of the strategist panicking?
Romilda, please take this strategist somewhere else.
m940002.……はぁ。ねぇあなたたち、\n兵たちには聞かせられない会話よ、これ。:
……Sigh. You two,
this conversation is not something the soldiers should hear.
m940002.……はぁ。分かったよ、皇帝。\nだからそんな、らしくもない顔しないで。\nあんた:
……Haa. Fine, Emperor.
But stop making that face. It doesn't suit you.
You look nothing like yourself.
m940002.……はい。\nいずれこんな日が来ると、気付いていたはずなのに……。:
……Yes.
I should have known a day like this would come…
m940002.……はっ。\nアウローラ様、トゥーダ様が\n治療にあたっておりますが、容態は……:
……Hah.
Aurora and Tuda are attending to him, but his condition is……grrh…….
m940002.……はっ。\n全軍、周囲の警戒を厳とせよ！\nこのまま山岳地帯を進むぞ！:
...Yes, sir.
All units, tighten your perimeter watch!
We press on through the mountain range!
m940002.……はっ。\n我らは皆、無念を抱え、屈辱に耐え続けた同胞。\n必ずや皆の力で、雪:
……Hmph.
We are all comrades who have carried regret and endured humiliation.
Together, we will surely avenge that disgrace.
m940002.……ははっ、それなら\n帝国軍を俺たちだけで蹴散らしてやりましょう。:
……Hah, in that case,
let's scatter the Imperial Army all by ourselves.
m940002.……は？\nいや、顔とかじゃなく、今は名誉と領地の話を――: ……Huh? I'm not talking about her face. I'm talking about honor and territory—
m940002.……ふふっ、御冗談を。\nですが、少し緊張が解れました。\nこちら側の指揮官にも:
……Heh, what a joke.
But it did ease my tension a bit.
I'd like to teach our commander that lesson too.
m940002.……ほう。\n鍛冶職人をやめて、軍師になるか？:
……I see.
Leaving the forge to become a strategist, are we?
m940002.……まぁ、えぇ、そうね。\nこういう人柄だから、\n兵たちはあなたに付いていくの:
……Well, yes, I suppose so.
With a personality like that,
I wonder why the soldiers follow you…….
m940002.……まさか、我が軍の最新鋭艦か？\nベラート伯爵め、いったいどこから設計図を……:
……Could they be our latest prototype ships?
That Count Belato, where did he get the blueprints……
m940002.……まさか、魔王軍幹部と相対するとはな。\n王子、お前も休んでおけ。\n次の戦い:
……To think I would be facing a high-ranking officer of the Demon King's army.
Prince, you should rest as well.
In the next battle, they will surely come at full force.
m940002.……まさかカテリナさん、\nダークエルフの襲撃すら陽動に使った、敵の作戦は――:
……Could it be, Katerina,
that the enemy's strategy used even the Dark Elf attack as a diversion――
m940002.……まさか血気盛んな戦士たちが撤退するか。\n誉れよりも仲間を優先するとは、\n:
...I never thought such hot-blooded warriors would choose to retreat.
To prioritize their comrades over glory...
Is the Netherworld Army truly that kind of organization...?
m940002.……まずい。まずいのは分かる。\n敵に雪上装備の部隊がいるとか、誰も気付いてない:
……This is bad. I know it's bad.
There are snow-equipped troops on the enemy side, and no one else seems to have noticed.
But if I go to report it, I'll be right in the middle of the battlefield…….
m940002.……まずい。激マズだこれ！\nレーネは急いで避難して！\nアタシは陛下に報告しな:
……This is bad. No, it's really, really bad!
Lehne, evacuate immediately!
I have to report to His Majesty!!
m940002.……まだ、もうしばらくは遠慮しておきましょう。\n気分は悪くありませんが、身体に:
……I'll hold back for now.
It's not unpleasant, but it does take a toll on the body.
m940002.……まだベラート伯爵が\n姿を見せないのが気がかりですが。: ……I'm still worried that Count Belato hasn't shown himself yet.
m940002.……むっ、ククッ……カッカッカ！\nそうか、そうか……！:
……Hm, Ku-ku…… Kaka-kaka!
I see, I see……!
m940002.……もし、その後の結末が悲惨なものだったとしたら？\n魔王ガリウスのような、世界:
……What if the aftermath is a tragedy?
What if you were hoping for a future that changes the world itself,
like the Demon King Galious?
m940002.……やはり、最初の叛逆の折、\n領地と兵は取り上げておくべきでした。\nもっと強:
……In hindsight, we should have stripped him of his lands and troops when he first rebelled.
If I had pressed the matter more strongly back then……
m940002.……やはり、王国軍が出てきたか。\n女神アイギスの信徒たちは、\n味方に取り込み:
……So, the Kingdom's army has finally arrived.
I would have liked to recruit the followers
of the Goddess Aigis to our side.
m940002.……やれやれ。\nやっぱり、てめぇとは話が合わねぇな。:
……Tch, well, well.
I knew we'd never see eye to eye, you and I.
m940002.……やれやれ。\n王子、サザンカを見ておいてやってくれ。\nどうやら最前線に出る:
……I see, I see.
Prince, keep an eye on Sasanqua.
It seems she's determined to stay on the front lines.
m940002.……やーな感じですね。\nあのご先祖様軍、皆笑いながら消えていきますよ。:
……What an eerie feeling.
Those ancestors are all vanishing with smiles on their faces.
m940002.……よし、頑張ろ、レーネ。\nこれが終わったらお菓子買いに行こ！:
……Alright, let's do our best, Lehne.
Once this is over, we're going to get some sweets!
m940002.……よしっ！\n帝国式魔導砲台、整備完了です！\nいつでも撃てますよー！！:
……Alright!
The Imperial-style magic artillery is fully prepared!
We're ready to fire at any moment!!
m940002.……ん、分かった。\nでも本当に気をつけるべきなのは武人としての\n伝承が残るア:
……Hm, I see.
But the one who really needs to be careful is Atnates uncle, whose legacy as a warrior is still spoken of――Hm, what is that sound?
m940002.……んー、どうして、なのかなぁ。\n戦っていれば、そのうち分かるのかなー。: ……Hmm, I wonder. Maybe I'll figure it out once I've been fighting for a while.
m940002.……アダマスの、神器め。\nこんなことで……砕けるとはな……。:
……Adamas's, so-called divine artifact.
To think it could shatter over something like this…….
m940002.……イリオス、やめておきな。\nあいつらはあたしらとは、たどった道が違うのさ。:
……Ilios, leave it be.
They have taken a different path from us.
m940002.……オレは今、すこぶる機嫌がいい。\nさぁ人間ども、オレの相手をするのは誰だッ！:
……I'm in a fine mood right now.
Well then, you humans… who among you dares to face me?!
m940002.……カテリナさん、存外やる気ですね。\nてっきり駄々をこねるかと思いましたが……:
……Katerina, you're surprisingly motivated.
I half expected you to throw a tantrum…….
m940002.……クロコさま、\nもう、共に戦うことはできないのですか？:
……Lord Croco,
can we no longer fight side by side?
m940002.……ソノ忠義には、礼を言おウ。\nダガ、お前の主ハ、モハヤ私ではないだろウ。:
……I am grateful for your loyalty.
However, it is no longer me you serve.
m940002.……ソロソロ時間ダ。\nコノ戦いコソ、帝国攻略の分水嶺ト聞いてイル。\n各々、本:
……It's almost time.
I've heard this battle will be the turning point
in the conquest of the Empire.
I pray that each of you can achieve your true aim.
m940002.……ダークエルフの少女、だと？\n脱走兵――いや、亡命を求めているということか？:
……A Dark Elf girl, is it?

A deserter—no, she's seeking asylum, then?
m940002.……ッ！！\n陛下、下がって！\nこの魔力は――人が受け止められるものじゃないよ:
……!!
Your Majesty, get back!
This magic――it's too much for a human to withstand!!
m940002.……ハイドース殿、恩に着ますぞ。\n兵たちよ、白の皇帝を討て！\n己が手で白の王:
……Thank you, Lord Hydos.
Soldiers, slay the White Emperor!
Reclaim the White Kingdom with your own hands!!
m940002.……ハルモニアよ、最後のはなむけだ。\n次の激突デハ、我が目的の一端ヲ見せテやろ:
……Harmonia. Consider this my farewell.
In the next clash, I shall show you a glimpse of my true purpose.
m940002.……フッ、あいつらしい、か。\n帝国兵たちよ、これは帝国の戦いだ。\n王国兵に遅:
……Hah, that's just like him.
Soldiers of the Empire, this is the Empire's war.
Do not let the Kingdom's troops outpace us!
m940002.……ヘカティエ様が誰かを褒めるなんて、珍しい。\n友だち、いたんですね……。:
……It's rare for Hecatie to praise someone.
So you have friends, huh…….
m940002.……ベラート伯爵は、ああ見えて人望の厚い男だ。\n少々自己顕示欲が強すぎるがな。:
……Count Belato is a man of great renown, despite appearances.
He is simply a bit too eager for the spotlight.
m940002.……ベラート伯爵領は、\n確かに腐敗の温床ではありましたが、\n重税もなく、兵も:
……It's true that Count Belart's domain
was a hotbed of corruption,
but I've heard there are no heavy taxes, and his soldiers are formidable.
m940002.……メリュジアナ、説得は無用ですわ。\n彼らとて、覚悟の上での反乱でしょう。:
……Meliusiana, there's no point in reasoning with them.
They must have known full well what they were doing when they rebelled.
m940002.……リエーフ。諦めが悪いのね。\nまだ私と仲良くできるとでも思っているの？:
……Lev. You really never do give up, do you?
Do you still think we can be friends?
m940002.……レオナ、兵に伝えろ。\n飛空戦艦は車両部隊を輸送しているはずだ。\n可能であ:
……Leona, relay the order.
The flying warships are likely transporting vehicle units.
If possible, shoot them down before the units can deploy.
m940002.……ワシの息子のくせに、頑張ったんだな。\n戦うことしか教えられなかったが、\n:
...You've done well, for my son.
I could only teach you how to fight, but...
I see, you've become a king...
m940002.……不可解だな。\n冥界の亜神、ハイドースに与した勢力が、\nなぜ今更になってそ:
……I don't understand.

Why would a faction loyal to Haidos, the sub-deity of the Underworld,

suddenly do something like this?
m940002.……事実は変わらない。\nだが、冥界軍に与するというのなら、\n再び剣を向けるし:
……The facts remain unchanged.
However, if they choose to side with the Underworld army,
we will have no choice but to turn our swords against them again.
m940002.……人同士が殺しあった、憎しみと後悔、\n悲哀と苦痛の満ちるこの地より、\n冥界:
……There was, indeed, a time when the Gate of the Underworld
opened from this very land,
a place filled with hatred and regret,
sorrow and pain, born of men killing one another.
m940002.……人質をとられたか、セグナンド。\nだが、こちらも大人しく\n首を差し出すわけ:
……So you've taken hostages, Segnand.
But I can't simply sit here and offer up my neck.
m940002.……何が勇姿なものか。\n賄賂と不正で蓄えた資金の結晶だろう。:
……Mighty indeed.
It's just a crystallization of funds amassed through bribes and corruption.
m940002.……何が来ようと、することは変わらない。\nまずは兵に休息を取らせろ。:
……No matter what comes, our course remains the same.
Order the troops to rest.
m940002.……何を仰っているか、分からないわ。: ……I do not understand what you are saying.
m940002.……何を言ってイル。\n黒き竜人族ハ、モハヤお前の民ではナイ。:
……What are you saying?
The Black Dragonkin are no longer your people.
m940002.……俺が言うまでもなかったか。\n敵とすれば怖ろしいが、\n味方となれば心強いも:
……I suppose I didn't need to say that.
They must be terrifying as an enemy,
but surely they would be a formidable ally.
m940002.……俺が退けば、民が死ぬ、か。\n――女神アダマス、力を借りるぞ。:
……If I retreat, the people will die.
――Goddess Adamas, lend me your power.
m940002.……先代も。\n最期にふさわしい、堂々たる戦いでした。:
……The Predecessor as well.
It was a dignified battle,
worthy of her final moments.
m940002.……先輩方は、いったいどんな戦法で、\n帝国軍の足止めをしているのですか？:
……How exactly are the veterans
holding back the Imperial army?
m940002.……全軍、戦闘準備。\nアンデッドを蹴散らし、この先へ向かう。:
……All units, prepare for battle.
Sweep aside the undead and advance.
m940002.……兵を引き上げました、か。\n次の激突に、全戦力を当てるつもりでしょうね。:
……They've pulled their troops back.
They intend to commit their full strength to the next clash.
m940002.……冥界から蘇った者たち、ね。\nでも力は不安定みたい。:
……Those resurrected from the afterlife, huh.
But their power seems unstable.
m940002.……冥界の亜神、ハイドースに与した者の中に、\n私の友人がいるんです。\nその子:
……Among those who serve the Underworld's lesser god, Hyades,
there is a friend of mine.
She might be leading that unit.
m940002.……冥界軍、退いていきます。\nおそらく、次の侵攻が最大のものになるかと……。:
……The Netherworld army is retreating.
I suspect the next invasion will be their most powerful yet……
m940002.……初めて斬り結んだが、\nこれが帝国、そして王国の精鋭たちか。: ……This is my first time clashing with them. So these are the elite forces of the Empire and the Kingdom.
m940002.……剣をとれ。\n敵が誰であろうと、関係ない。:
……Draw your swords.
It doesn't matter who the enemy is.
m940002.……剣を向けたまま交渉を迫るのが帝国流では？\nなんて思っていたけれど、\n陛下:
I thought forcing negotiations while pointing swords was the Empire's way,
but Your Majesty and Diana have certainly become more reasonable.
m940002.……剣を向けて交渉って、\nそれ脅迫って言わないかしら？:
……Forcing negotiations while pointing swords?
Isn't that just called intimidation?
m940002.……力に酔ったか、ダークエルフの長め。: ……Have you been intoxicated by power, Dark Elf chief?
m940002.……勝っても負けてもいいから、死ぬな、と。\nえぇ、分かったわ、ハイドース様。:
……Whether you win or lose, don't die, is that it?
Yes, I understand, Lord Hydos.
m940002.……命までは、届かなかったか。\nしかしもう、その灯火も尽きかけている。:
……I failed to claim your life.
But your light is already fading.
m940002.……嘘は、言ってなさそう。\n隠し事の上手そうな顔だけど、\n本当に、あの亜神の:
……She doesn't seem to be lying.
He has a face that's good at keeping secrets,
but he really does seem to understand that Demigod.
m940002.……国を奪われたのだろう？\n国とは故郷であり、骨を埋めるべき父祖の地だ。:
……You were stripped of your country, were you not?
A nation is one's homeland, the ancestral land where one should be laid to rest.
m940002.……声が、聞こえただけだ。\n帰ってこいと、俺を呼ぶ声がな。:
……I just heard a voice.
A voice calling me back.
m940002.……大地がそんな急に移動したら、\nその上にいるの、危ないんじゃないの！？:
……If the ground moves that suddenly,
isn't it dangerous for everyone standing on it!?
m940002.……奴を殺せば、皆を助けてくれるのか。: ……If we kill him, will you save everyone?
m940002.……嬉しそうだな、ベラート伯爵。\nそんなに白の皇帝と戦いたかったのか？:
……You look pleased, Count Belart.
Did you want to fight the White Emperor that badly?
m940002.……建前と、形式が必要なのです。こういうのは。: ……We need a pretext and proper procedure. For something like this.
m940002.……強く、なったのう。\n実に、竜人らしい苛烈な戦いじゃった……。:
……You have grown strong.
Truly a fierce battle, befitting the Dragonkin……
m940002.……彼の、最後の王命だ。\n臣下ならば、それに応えてみせよ。:
……That is his final royal command.
As his subjects, you must obey.
m940002.……後少し、もう少し、\nほんの一歩が足りないというのか。:
……Just a little more, just a little more,
is it that one final step is all that's missing?
m940002.……惜しい戦士だ。\nなぜお前ほどの実力を備えた男が、\n国家の長などに収まって:
……A pity you are such a capable warrior.
Why does a man of your caliber content himself with being a head of state?
m940002.……想定以上に、帝国軍からの離反者は多いようだな。: ……It seems there are more defectors from the Imperial army than we anticipated.
m940002.……慌てるな。\n戦闘の準備はできている。:
……Stay calm.
We are prepared for battle.
m940002.……我々が行こう。\nダークエルフが誇りを胸に抱く者たちよ！\n死氷の亜神、白の:
……We'll go.
Dark Elves who carry their pride in their hearts!
Let us repay the grace of the Sub-God of Dead Ice and the White Empire!!
m940002.……我が王のような、勇者では？\nいくつもの戦場を駆け抜け、\n勝利をその手にも:
……A hero, like our King?
Someone who has charged across countless battlefields
and seized victory with their own hands?
m940002.……指揮官はハイドース様ですから。\n私は前線指揮官、兵と共に最前線に立つのが役:
……The commander is Lord Hydos.
I am the field commander; it is my duty to stand at the very front with the troops.
m940002.……提督、もったいぶった言い方をする必要はない。\nあれは、元は帝国艦隊のひとつ:
……Admiral, there is no need to be so coy.
It is, originally, a part of the Imperial fleet.
m940002.……敵の配置が広範囲に渡っています。\nこれだけの広さの戦場では、\n遠方の部隊:
……The enemy's deployment covers a wide area.
On a battlefield this large,
it will be difficult to provide support to distant units.
m940002.……敵勢力が多すぎる。\n白の王国時代の貴族どもめ、\nこれを好機と見て、反旗を:
……There are too many of them.
Those nobles from the era of the White Kingdom
must have seen this as their chance to raise a banner of rebellion.
m940002.……断る。\n私はもはや、貴様の一族ではない。\n庇護される幼き日々は、もう終わ:
……No.
I am no longer of your clan.
The days of being sheltered and protected are over.
m940002.……時が満ちようとしている、か。: ……The time is nearly ripe, is it.
m940002.……時は来た。\n先陣を切った獣人、オークの戦いぶりは聞いているな。:
……The hour has arrived.
You have heard of the ferocity of the Beastmen and Orcs
who led the charge, I presume.
m940002.……来たか、亜神ヘリューズ。\n陛下、どうなさいますか。:
……So you've arrived, the Demigod Heleus.
Your Majesty, what are your orders?
m940002.……東の山脈に隠れて、\n敵の全容が把握できない状況ですか。:
……With them hidden behind the eastern mountain range,
we cannot assess the full extent of the enemy force.
m940002.……死の音色。\nどれだけの命を、奪ってきたのでしょう。\nあなたの背後には怨嗟:
……The sound of death.
How many lives has it taken?
All I hear behind you is the wailing of the damned.
m940002.……気のせいだ。\nこれは我らが怒りを突き立てるための戦い、\n享楽のための戦で: ……You must be mistaken. This is a battle to sharpen our fury, not a battle for pleasure.
m940002.……照れるなぁ、それ。\nさぁ、走るよ！ 物質界に帰ろう！:
……You're making me blush.
Come on, let's run! Back to the Material World!
m940002.……物質界のダークエルフ、\nその長が自ら出てきたか。:
……The leader of the Dark Elves of the Material World
has taken the field himself.
m940002.……犠牲者は、多い。\nだが、我らも父祖の誇りを継ぐ者だ。\nまだここから、やり:
……There were many casualties.
But we are the inheritors of our ancestors' pride.
We can still start over from here.
m940002.……王子、こうなることが分かっていたのですか？: ……Prince, did you know this would happen?
m940002.……王子。なに、気にするな。\nかつて伝えられなかった別れの言葉を、\n今こうし:
……Prince. Don't worry about it.
I was finally able to say the words of farewell
I never got to say before.
m940002.……王子？\nまさか、奴の声が分かるのか？:
……Prince?
Can you understand what she's saying?
m940002.……白の帝国の、雪上部隊のことですか？\nしかし、ベラート伯爵の領地には、\n積:
……The White Empire's snow unit, you mean?
But Count Belard's territory shouldn't have included any snowy regions…….
m940002.……相変わらず、頭が固いのね、ティルト。: ……You're still as stubborn as ever, Tilt.
m940002.……確かに、そうですな。\n白の王国を取り戻す、その理想のために、\n歩みを共に:
……Indeed, you are right.
For the ideal of reclaiming the White Kingdom,
we must carry the pride of those who walked this path with us.
m940002.……私から説明しましょうか。\n念のために言っておくのなら、\n世界の実験場たる:
……Allow me to explain.
And for the record,
this is nothing like Olympus, the world's testing ground.
m940002.……私が、迷っている？\n馬鹿な……そんなこと……。:
……Me? Wandering?
How absurd… there's no way…
m940002.……私がこの地を離れることを決めたから、でしょうか。\n封鎖が解け、\n冥界の、:
……Perhaps it is because I have decided to leave this land.
The seal is breaking,
and it is trying to return to the Underworld's original position.
m940002.……自分でここにいることを選んだ者が、\nいったいどれだけいるのか疑問だけれど。:
……I wonder how many of them
actually chose to be here.
m940002.……良い、とは？\nなんのことかしら？:
……The moment has come?
For what, my lord?
m940002.……苦しい戦いではありますが、\nきっと、勝利をつかみ取りましょう！:
……It will be a grueling fight,
