but we will surely seize victory!
m940002.……行け。\nこの者は、俺たちが丁重に弔っておこう。:
……Go.
We will pay our respects to this man.
m940002.……褒めてな……うぅん、確かに褒めてるね。: ……I'm not prais… Ugh, I guess I am.
m940002.……覚悟はできているようだな。\nならば容赦は――:
……So you are prepared, then.
In that case, I shall show no mercy—
m940002.……親友だった、よ。\n王国の飼い猫になった無冠のチャンピオンは、\nもはや獣人:
……You *were* my dearest friend.
The untitled Champion who became the Kingdom's pet cat
is nothing but a defeated traitor to the Beastmen now.
m940002.……言い方を変えよう。\nあの森は、元よりダークエルフたちの住んでいた場所だ。:
……Let me put it another way.
That forest was originally home to the Dark Elves.
m940002.……言葉を交わす必要はない。\n彼女が嗅ぎつけてくるのも時間の問題だ。:
……There is no need to exchange words.
It is only a matter of time before she sniffs us out.
m940002.……記録不明。\nルインの記憶装置内には、該当する情報が存在しません。: ……No record found. There is no information matching that in Ruin's memory banks.
m940002.……話をするには、戦いを止めさせねばならないか。: ……To talk to her, we'll have to stop the fighting first.
m940002.……読まれていた、ということ？\n仕方ない、兵に撤退命令を。:
……So we were read.
Fine. Order the troops to retreat.
m940002.……諦めぬコトコソ、人の強さカ。\nナラバ同じ空デ、ソノ戦いぶりヲ見せてもらオウ:
……To never give up… that is the true strength of humanity.
Very well. Since we share this sky, let me see how you fight.
m940002.……謙遜するな。\nその着眼点は、間違っていない。\n敵の動きは、最初から奇妙だ:
……Do not be so modest.
Your observation is not without merit.
The enemy's movements have been strange from the very beginning.
m940002.……連中は庇護とは思うまい。\n侵略戦争を仕掛けたのは、俺たちなのだからな。:
……They don't think of it as protection.
We are the ones who launched this war of aggression, after all.
m940002.……闇水晶の力だけデハ、ここが限界カ。\n冥界の亜神ヨ、私ハ退くぞ。:
……The power of the Dark Crystal alone has its limits here.
Sub-deity of the Netherworld, I withdraw.
m940002.……陛下、冥界軍が動き始めました。: ……Your Majesty, the Netherworld army has begun to move.
m940002.……骸帝。\nあの鎧、あの武具、まさに肖像画で見たお姿だ。:
……The Skeleton Emperor.
That armor, that weaponry… it is exactly the figure I saw in the portrait.
m940002.……黙レ、黒き竜人の裏切り者。\nモハヤ、誰もお前を族長トハ認めナイ。:
……Shut up, you traitor to the Black Dragonkin.
No one acknowledges you as our chieftain anymore.
m940002.「ボクには路地裏が似合うのさ」なんて言って、\nアタシの誘いを断ったのはレーネの:
You're the one who said, "I look better in the alleys,"
and turned down my invitation――
……Hm? What's that sound?
m940002.あ、れは……。\nまさか……うそ、そんなことって……。:
W-What is….
Could it be… no, that can't be…
m940002.あ、アンジェリーネ様、いったいどこへ――: Ah, Angeline, where exactly are you――
m940002.あぁ……もうっ！\n覚えてろよマルレーン！\nあんたを！ 助けに行くんだから！:
Ah……I give up!
Just you wait, Marleen!
I'm going to save you! Consider it a favor!!
m940002.あぁもう！ うるさいリンクス！\n誇り高き咆哮は！ 何者をも斬り裂く爪は！\n獣:
Oh, for crying out loud! Shut up, Lynx!
My proud roar! My claws that can tear through anything!
What are a Beastman's fangs for, anyway!!
m940002.あぁ？ てめぇら、逃げるつもりか！？: Huh? Are you guys planning to run?
m940002.ああ……そいつは、助かる。\nお前の約束なんて、信じちゃいないがな。:
Ah…… that is a relief.
I don't believe a word of your promises, though.
m940002.ああ、ここだ。\n敵の目標は最初から、俺をここに引きずりだすことにある。:
Ah, it is here.
The enemy's true objective was to lure me out to this location from the start.
m940002.ああ、こんな状況で、例えば――\n――そう、例えばどこかの王子様が、\n颯爽と私:
Ah, in a situation like this, for example——
——that's it, for example, if some prince
came galloping in to save me, looking so dashing……
m940002.ああ、せめて恋くらいしてから死にたかった。\n軍人になった以上望めないことだけど:
Ah, I wish I could have fallen in love before dying.
It's something I can't afford now that I'm a soldier!
m940002.ああ、そこで死ぬのなら、奴はそこまでの男だからな。\n貴様らも死力を尽くした褒美:
Yes. If he dies there, then he was only a man of that caliber.
I will let you go as a reward for giving it your all.
m940002.ああ、つまり黒炎も斬ってしまえばいいと。\n単純で助かりますね。:
I see, so we just need to cut down the black flames as well.
How simple. That is a relief.
m940002.ああ、どうだ、冥界への土産話ができただろう。\nだから、今度こそ、安心して逝って:
Ah, so you've got a story for the underworld, then.
Now, rest easy and go...
m940002.ああ、もう……。\nあったま来た……鬼を……怒らせたな……。:
Ah, come on…….
I'm losing my patience…… I've really angered the demon…….
m940002.ああ、オークは戦いに生き、戦いに死ぬ誇り高き種族。\n連中の死に花、見届けてやら:
Aye. Orcs are a proud race that lives for battle and dies in it.
I have to see their final bloom through to the end.
m940002.ああ、屈辱を忘れぬ獣人の新たな姫よ。\nさて、そろそろ包囲も完了する頃だ。\n―:
Aye, the new beast-folk princess who has not forgotten her humiliation.
The encirclement should be complete by now.
――Let us begin the battle.
m940002.ああ、帝国式魔導砲の情報、大儀である。\n我が配下であれば褒美を与えるところだが:
Indeed. The information on the Imperial-style magic cannons was most helpful.
If you were one of my subordinates, I would grant you a reward, but…
m940002.ああ、無論最終目標はハイドースの首だが、\nそのために帝国軍人や、\n協働する王:
Ah, naturally, our ultimate goal is Haidos's head.
But I have no intention of sacrificing Imperial soldiers,
or the Kingdom's troops who are cooperating with us, to get it.
m940002.ああ、白の皇帝の生き血で真っ赤に磨いておいてやろう。\n――さて、そろそろ、か。:
Aye, I'll polish it bright red with the living blood of the White Emperor.
――Well, it's about time.
m940002.ああ、領域の主に結界を解除してもらえば、\nこっちの「重機」でも突破可能か……。:
Ah, if the Lord of the Domain releases the barrier,
then even our "heavy machinery" can break through, I suppose…
m940002.ああ、頼まれたとも。\n無論全力で断ってやったけれどね！: Yes, I was asked. Though I naturally refused with all my might!
m940002.ああ。\n――死した後、魂となって冥界でまた会おう。:
Aye.
――After we die, let's meet again in the Underworld as souls.
m940002.ああ。こちらの手の内も明かしてしまった以上、\n次からの攻勢はより過酷なものとな:
Indeed. Now that we've revealed our hand,
their next offensive will be far more brutal.
m940002.ああ。幕引きをすべきは、俺じゃない。\n……帰ってこい、戦友。:
Yes. It is not my place to draw the curtain.
……Come back, comrade.
m940002.あいつが物質界のオーク、\nそのすべてを束ねる長、オークロードってわけか……。: So that's the leader who unites all the orcs of the material world…… the Orc Lord…….
m940002.あいつは根っからの戦闘狂だ。\n強者と戦うのが、楽しくて楽しくて仕方ない類のな。: That man is a born battle maniac. He simply can't get enough of fighting the strong.
m940002.あいつらは、千年の間先祖が守ってきた土地を、\n白の帝国に奪われ、隷従させられた:
They are likely a people whose lands,
guarded by their ancestors for a thousand years,
were stolen by the White Empire, and who were forced into servitude.
m940002.あたしには、あいつらの考えてることが分かるよ。\n連中もあたしも、どこまで行って:
I can tell what they're thinking.
They're warriors, just like me.
m940002.あたしはね、じめじめしたのは嫌いなんだ。\n過去の遺恨、大義、友のための戦い、大:
You see, I hate things being all murky and ambiguous.
Past grudges, righteous causes, fighting for friends... all very well and good.
m940002.あちらも、きっとそれと同じ問いを、\nベラート伯爵にしたことだろう。:
They are surely asking the same question
of Count Belart on their side.
m940002.あっ……あぁ、もうっ！\n考えなしに最前線に……！:
Ah… Ah, come on!
Charging to the front line without thinking…!
m940002.あっ……言われてみれば、確かに……？\nでも、どうしてか反逆しようとか思わなかっ: Ah…… now that you mention it, I guess that makes sense……? But for some reason, I never even thought about betraying them.
m940002.あっ、あの、なぜ抱っこを……？\nでも……はい、ありがとうございます。\nちょっ:
Ah, um, why the hug……?
But…… yes, thank you.
I feel a little better now.
m940002.あっ、そっか、そうだよね！\nあはは、やっぱ故郷は守らないとだしね！:
Oh, right, that's it!
Hahaha, I guess you have to protect your hometown, after all!
m940002.あっ、な、ないですー。\nど、どうしよう、本当に王子様が現れてしまった……！:
Oh, n-no, I'm fine.
Wh-what am I going to do, the Prince has actually shown up……!
m940002.あとは今の世を生きる……お前たちの役目だ……。\n存分に戦え、戦って、戦って、名: So that's the Orc Lord, the one who commands all the orcs of the material world...
m940002.あなた、さっきの……。\n撤退したと思っていたけど、\n今度は妨害してくるなんて:
You… you were just here a moment ago.
I thought you had retreated,
but now you're trying to obstruct us? What are you thinking?
m940002.あなたが、獣人の誇りと尊厳ではなく、\n人間と手を取り合うことなんて、選んだから:
You chose to reach out to humans
instead of upholding the pride and dignity of the Beastmen...!
m940002.あなたという人は……。\n――全軍、心して聞け！\n伝令はすべての前線へ伝えよ！:
You really are…
――All units, listen carefully!
Send this order to every front line!
m940002.あなたの怒りは理解できます。\n私がそれだけのことをした、その事実も分かっていま:
I understand your anger.
I am also aware of the fact that I did something so grave.
m940002.あなたは、白の皇帝ですね。\n骸帝と少しだけ似た音色を感じます。:
You are the White Emperor, aren't you?
I sense a tone in you that is somewhat similar to the Skeleton Emperor's.
m940002.あなたも、相変わらずご自身の創造物に冷たいようだ。\n見捨てていった騎士にかける:
And you, as ever, are cold toward your own creation.
That is the kind of word you use for a knight you abandoned.
m940002.あの場は、戦士としてのあの男に譲っただけだ。\nかの王が帝国に道を開けたなら、\:
I merely yielded the field to that man as a warrior.
If that King has opened a path to the Empire,
it would be against my code of chivalry for a knight to overturn it.
m940002.あの女には、我が主は殺させない。\nあなたの真意を問うのも、あなたに何故と問うの:
I will not let that woman kill my master.
Whether to question your true intentions, to ask you why,
or to take your life—those are rights that belong to me alone.
m940002.あの拠点を潰さないと、こちらの展開も難しい。\n敵の支配力を削るためにも、\n敵:
We cannot deploy effectively unless we crush that stronghold.
To weaken the enemy's control,
we should prioritize destroying their strongholds.
m940002.あの軍艦……まずいな、大砲が陸を向いてやがる。\n王子、あいつら上陸前にぶっ放し:
Those warships……this is bad, their cannons are aimed at the shore.
Prince, they're going to open fire before they even land!
m940002.あの鎧……あの構え、まさか……。: That armor… that stance, no way…
m940002.あはは、そんなこと言って、\nレオラっち辺りに言い含められたんでしょ？: Ahaha, you're saying that, but Leona told you to keep an eye on me, didn't she?
m940002.あまり、時間もなさそうだ。\n単刀直入に事情を聞かせてもらおう。:
We don't seem to have much time.

Let's get straight to the point. Tell me the situation.
m940002.あやつには、罪なき無力な民が、\n必死に武器を振りかざして己を殺しに来るという、:
It seems he lacks the thrilling experience
of innocent, powerless people
desperately swinging their weapons to try and kill him.
m940002.あら、それくらい鎮められなくて何が皇帝なのかしら。\n早く目を覚まして、\n帝国:
Oh, if she can't even calm that down, what kind of empress is she?
She needs to wake up soon and show everyone that the Empire's greatest power is right here.
m940002.あら、それは分かっていたことよ？\nかつての白の王国を取り戻そうだなんて、\n貴:
Oh, that was to be expected, wasn't it?
The idea of reclaiming the former White Kingdom
must have sounded like a sweet temptation to the nobles.
m940002.あら、大牛と子猫の間違いじゃない？: Oh, wouldn't you say it's a quarrel between a bull and a kitten?
m940002.あれが帝国の援軍なのだとしたら、\nなぜ海から……それにあの軍艦、\n軍旗を掲げ:
If those are the Imperial reinforcements,
why are they coming from the sea? And those warships
don't appear to be flying any banners.
m940002.あれが物質界のオークの長、オークロードか。\n魔界のオークとは、やっぱり考え方が:
So that's the Orc Lord, the leader of the orcs in the Material World.
They really do think differently from the orcs of the Demon World.
m940002.あれが話に聞いた帝国の新兵器、か……。\n敵兵力の把握は十分だ、戦線を下げろ！！:
So that's the Empire's new weapon they've been talking about...
We have a full grasp of their forces. Fall back!
m940002.あれだけの攻撃を受けて、何故進めるの……。\nもう何度も倒れたはずだというのに。:
How can they keep advancing after taking that much damage……
They should have fallen many times already.
m940002.あれだけ倒しても、まだ攻めてくるのか。\n先ほどまでとは士気が段違いだぞ！:
We've taken them down that many times, and they're still attacking.
Their morale is on a completely different level than before!
m940002.あれは……ドラゴニュートキャバリアか。\n連中、どうやら戦力を惜しむ気は無さそう:
Those are… Dragon Knight Cavalry.
Looks like they're not holding back their forces.
m940002.あれは、ラビリスの幻影……？: That is… a phantom of Labrys?
m940002.あれはあくまで幻影よ。\n体力さえ削りきれば、突撃も止まるわ。:
It is nothing more than a phantom.
Once you deplete its health, the charge will stop.
m940002.あれを……いや、あの化け物を倒せるのは、\nきっと、貴殿らしかいないはずだ。\n:
That thing—no, that monster—

only you could possibly defeat.

That is why I have come here.
m940002.あんなので焼き払われたら、\n簡単に陣地を占拠されちゃうわ。\nセグナンドを放置:
If we get burned by that,
our position will be overrun in no time.
Leaving Segnand alone is too dangerous!
m940002.あー、はいはい……。\nそれじゃあ素敵な王子サマに任せるとするわ。:
Ah, yes, yes...
I suppose we can leave it to our wonderful Prince, then.
m940002.いいえ、レオナちゃん。\nそんなことをしていたら、\nより精強な軍勢が、命を捨て:
No, Leona-chan.
If we had done that, an even stronger army would have come charging at us, ready to die for him.
m940002.いいえ、届きます。\nこうして、言葉を交わしてくれています。:
No, they will.
We are still speaking, aren't we?
m940002.いいじゃないか、心が躍るってものさ。\n大義と誉れ、どちらが勝つか勝負ってやつさ:
That's fine. It makes my blood pump.
It's a showdown between a righteous cause and honor.
m940002.いいでしょう。\n見捨てたつもりはないけれど、\nその感情くらいは受け止めてあげ:
Fine.
I never intended to abandon him,
but I suppose I can accept that much of your feeling.
m940002.いいのかベラート伯爵。\nそのすり潰される軍は\nお前のかつての同胞たちだろう？:
Are you sure about this, Count Belart?
The army being crushed
will be your former compatriots, won't it?
m940002.いいや、あいつは死に場所を決めたんだ。\n傷なんて、もはや勲章が\n増えたくらい:
No, he has simply chosen his place of death.
To him, a wound is nothing more than
another medal added to his collection.
m940002.いいや、アタシも頑張らないとなって思っただけ！\nさぁ怪我人を運ぶよ！ 手を貸し:
No, I just realized I need to step up my game, that's all!
Now, let's get these wounded to safety! Give me a hand!
m940002.いえ、あれは……あれは王でも、剣士でもなく……。\n魔女……いえ、もっとおぞまし:
No, that thing… it wasn't a king, or a swordsman…
It was a witch… no, something far more abhorrent.
m940002.いえ、まるで微笑んでいるように見えましたので。: I'm sorry, you simply appeared to be smiling.
m940002.いえ、もうひとつ。\nつい先ほど、王国のシノビより、\nこれより王国軍が駆けつけ:
No, one more thing.
A messenger from the Kingdom's shinobi just arrived,
saying the Kingdom's army is on its way.
m940002.いえ、スケルトンサイクロプスの影は見えましたが、\nほかは雑兵ばかりです。:
No, I only spotted a Skeleton Cyclops.
The rest are just grunts.
m940002.いえ、遠慮しておきましょう。\n我が使命はただひとつ、\n彼に「世界を頼む」と託:
???: No, I shall pass.
I have but one mission,
for I have been entrusted with the words, "I leave the world to you."
m940002.いえね、ベラート伯爵についたのは、\n果たして、伯爵領の兵だけだったのだろうか、:
No, I'm wondering whether only soldiers from the Count's own lands
actually joined him.
m940002.いつだってちびっこのため、\n放っておいたら、誰も助けてくれない場所に\n行って:
I've always fought for the little ones,
and to shine a light for those who would be left behind
in places where no one else would help!
m940002.いま一度、子孫らのために、\n国を取り戻す戦いに駆けつけたいと。:
They wish to rush to the front once more,
to fight for the recovery of their nation, for the sake of their descendants.
m940002.いや、その被害は、祖国を思う者たちの血そのものだ。\n被害を忘れてはならないが、:
No, that damage is the very blood of those who care for their homeland.
We must not forget the cost,
but we must never be ashamed of the blood that was spilled.
m940002.いや、その誇りに敬意を払おう。\n貴様の首ひとつで、その者らは見逃してやる。:
No, I shall pay respect to that pride.
For the price of your head, I will let those people go.
m940002.いや、勇者とはあくまで旗印に過ぎない。\n戦働きを見届け、その死に様を看取り、\:
No. A hero is merely a banner.
The strongest is the one who witnesses their comrades' deeds,
watches over their final moments,
and carries their souls toward a shared, radiant victory.
m940002.いや、進軍を止めるな。: No. Do not halt the advance.
m940002.いやいや、ここは千年戦争の後、\n人類同士が殺し合った、戦乱の時代の古戦場ですぞ:
No, no. This is a battlefield from the Age of Chaos,
after the Millennium War, when humans turned on each other.
m940002.いやいや、戦えるんだから戦闘員さ、トゥーダ。\n神官戦士殿直々に、ちゃんと訓練も:
Oh, don't be so formal. If I can fight, I'm a combatant, Tuda.
I've been properly trained by the Divine Warrior herself, after all.
m940002.いやいや、私はあくまで同盟者ですからな。\n褒美は最前線で戦った、\n獣人、オー:
No, no. I am, after all, merely an ally.
It would be proper to bestow the rewards upon the beastmen, orcs, and Netherworld soldiers who fought on the front lines.
m940002.いやーな臭いがしますの。\n腐って、停滞しきって、澱んだ臭いが……。:
???: What a foul stench.
It's rotten, stagnant, and thick…
m940002.うぅん、あれはどちらかというと、助命嘆願かな。: ???: Hmm, I'd say it's more of a plea for mercy.
m940002.うっさい黙れッ！\n鬼は最強なんだ！ 思い知れクロコー！！:
Shut up! Keep your mouth closed!
Demons are the strongest! I'll show you, Croco!!
m940002.うむ……感謝しておるぞ、冥界の亜神よ。\n――しかし、まさかわしを選ぶとは、\n:
Mm… I am grateful, you lesser deity of the Netherworld.
But I do not quite understand why you chose me.
m940002.うむっ、実に竜人らしい！\nこれで、わしも大往生できるというものよ！:
Mm, truly befitting the Dragonkin!
Now I can rest in peace with a smile!
m940002.うむッ、見事な戦いぶりであるッ！\n白の帝国を相手どり、よくぞ戦い抜いたッ！！:
Hmph! A magnificent fight!
To hold out against the White Empire! Well done!
m940002.うわぁ、すごい満足そう。\n――それより、そろそろ敵が追いついてくる頃だよ。\n:
Wow, you look really satisfied.
――Anyway, the enemy is about to catch up.
Stay alert in the surroundings!
m940002.うん、そうだね。\n……あの人が守りたいと思うものを、\n今この場所で守れるのは:
Yeah, that's true.
……Of the things that person wants to protect,
we are the only ones here who can do it.
m940002.うん、国のためでも、種族のためでもない。\nあたしの金棒は、目の前で命を奪わせな:
Yeah, it's not for the country, or for our race.
My golden staff is for stopping those who would take lives right in front of me!
m940002.うん、私の予想が正しければ――: Yeah, if my guess is correct――
m940002.うんうん、これでよし。\n人の子の友情は、なんと尊きものなのだろう。:
Mm-hmm, this is good.
The friendship of mortal children is truly a noble thing.
m940002.うんうん、だよねー。\nでも、雲ひとつないこの空に、\n何かが飛んでいる気配はな:
Mm-hmm, right.
But looking at this cloudless sky,
I don't sense anything flying around……
m940002.えぇ、そのとおりです。\nシャディアは申し訳無さそうな顔をしますが、\nその表情:
Yes, that's right.
Shadia always looks so apologetic,
but every time I see that face, I pinch her cheeks.
m940002.えぇ、それでは楽しい山越えの時間、ですね。\n各員、吹雪ではぐれないよう、連絡を:
Alright, then it's time for our fun mountain crossing.
Everyone, stay in close contact so we don't get separated in the blizzard!
m940002.えぇ、でも、間違えたままであっても、\n勝利は勝利、解放は解放に違いない。:
Yes, it is. But even if we are wrong,
victory is still victory, and liberation is still liberation.
m940002.えぇ、エスネアも元気で……。\nそ、それよりクロコさまがご無事で、本当に良かった:
Yes, Esnea is doing well too…….
B-but, I'm so glad you're safe, Lord Croco!
Have you come here to…… to reinforce us, perhaps?
m940002.えぇ、人間にしておくには惜しい戦士ばかり――と、\nセグナンド様、何か良いことで: Indeed. They are warriors too precious to leave in human hands—— I beg your pardon, my lord Segnando, did something please you?
m940002.えぇ、以前冥界の門が開いた時より、\nむしろ安定しているくらいですな。:
Indeed. It is actually more stable
than when the Gate of the Underworld first opened.
m940002.えぇ、大丈夫。\n第二層は封鎖階層ですから。:
Yes, they are fine.
The second layer is a sealed layer.
m940002.えぇ、子爵、あなたも。\nしかし驚きましたわ。\n誰よりも忠義を重んじるあなたが:
Yes, Viscount. You as well.
Though I must say, I am surprised.
You, who value loyalty above all else, standing on that side.
m940002.えぇ、完璧かと。\nただ、時が時ならば、\n革命の戦火が巻き起こりそうな演説でし:
Yes, it was perfect.
If the timing had been different,
that speech could have sparked a revolution.
m940002.えぇ、必ず。\nそれでは先代、おさらばです。:
Yes, I certainly will.
Then goodbye, Predecessor.
m940002.えぇ、感情にまかせて焦るなんて、\nレオナちゃんらしくないわ♪: Yes, acting on impulse is just not like you, Leona-chan♪
m940002.えぇ、私も同意見よ。\nけれどそれは、今ではないの。:
Yes, I agree with you.
But not now.
m940002.えぇっ！？ まだ起動試験も終わってないんですよ！？: W-What!? The activation tests aren't even finished yet!?
m940002.えぇと、格納庫みたいな箱を積んだ、\n大型の飛空戦艦だったかと……。\nそれから:
Um, they were large flying warships
carrying cargo bays that looked like hangars……
And they had a lot of turrets!
m940002.えぇー、マルレーン寝相悪いしなぁ。: Ehh, Marleen, your sleeping position is terrible, you know.
m940002.えっ……えぇと、分かった。\nでも砕けた剣なんて、いったい何に使うんだ。:
Huh…… well, I guess so.
But what are you planning to do with a shattered sword?
m940002.えへ……褒められると照れますよ。: Ehehe… I get shy when I'm praised.
m940002.お、親父！？ いったいどこから！？: D-Dad!? Where did you even come from!?
m940002.おい、それより連中の数の方が問題だ。\nあれはどう見ても正規兵の軍だ。\n部隊単:
Hey, that's the least of our worries. Their numbers are the real problem.
That's a regular army, through and through.
It's a scary sight when they move in organized units, isn't it?
m940002.おいおい、なんだァこの気配は。\n死者のくせに、オレの領地で何してやがる！:
Hey, hey, what's this presence?
You're dead, so what are you doing in my territory!
m940002.おいおい、オレの鎚で殴られたんだから\nぺっちゃんこになってくれねェと困るぜ？: Hey, hey. If I hit you with my hammer, you'd better go flat, or I'm gonna have a problem.
m940002.おいおい、ヘカティエ、勘違いしてねぇか？\nオレが守るべき法とは、冥界のそれだ。:
Hey, hey, Hecatie, aren't you getting something wrong?
The law I am bound to protect is that of the Underworld.
m940002.おいおい、突っ込んでくるぞ！\n本当にあれが亜神の戦い方かよ！:
Whoa, he's charging in!
Is this really how a demi-god fights?
m940002.おいヘカティエ、てめぇに止める権利はねぇだろ。\nこいつはオレの領地で勝手に戦っ: Hey, Hecatie. You don't have the right to stop me. She fought on my turf without permission. She attacked my prey.
m940002.おい女ァ！\nオレの言葉を遮った罪は重いぜ。\nこのラビリス様の言葉をなァ！！: Hey, woman! The crime of interrupting me is a serious one. You interrupted the words of Lord Labrys!
m940002.おぉ……アンジェリーネ様。\nご機嫌麗しゅう。:
Oh…… Lady Angeline.
How do you do.
m940002.おぉ、ありがたい……！\n白の王国を想う者たちよ！ 今は撤退の時だ！:
Oh, I am grateful……!
Those who care for the White Kingdom! It is time to retreat!
m940002.おぉ、おぉ……！\n我らが先達が、白の王国の戦士たちが……！！:
Oh, oh……!
Our predecessors, the warriors of the White Kingdom……!!
m940002.おぉ、おぉ、メリュジアナよ。\n実に懐かしいのう。\nさぁ、もっとよく顔を見せて:
Oh, oh, Meliusiana.
How nostalgic this is.
Come, let me see your face more clearly.
m940002.おぉ、おぉ、殺人機械の――こほん、\nこれは失礼な呼び名ですな。\nルイン嬢、ご:
Oh, oh, the murder machine—ahem,
that is a rather rude way to address me.
Miss Ruin, I'm glad to see you in good health.
m940002.おぉ、おぉ！\n先代、再びお会いできる日が来るとは……！！:
Oh, oh!
To think I would meet you again, my predecessor...!!
m940002.おぉ、おぉ！ 兵たちよ、見よ！\n伯爵殿が最前線に、我らと共に立つぞ！:
Oh, oh! Soldiers, look!
The Earl stands at the front lines, with us!
m940002.おぉ、セグナンド殿。\nはて……どうでしょうな……。:
Oh, Lord Segnand.
Well……how should I put it…….
m940002.おぉ、ハイドース殿。\nお見苦しいところを見せてしまいましたな。:
Oh, Lord Hydos.
I apologize for the unsightly state of affairs.
m940002.おぉおぉ、ここから見えるだけでも\nなかなかの大軍勢だ。:
Oh my, even from up here,
I can see they've brought quite an army.
m940002.おお、ハイドース様の小間使いか。\nワシらの戦いぶり、どうかあの御方に伝えてくれ:
Oh, Lord Hydos's errand girl.
Please convey how we fought to your master.
m940002.おっと、それは違うぞ陛下。\nサザンカは決して、帝国のためには戦っていない。:
Oh, I beg your pardon, Your Majesty.
Sasanqua never fights for the Empire.
m940002.おっ待たせしましたー！\n帝国軍掘削部隊、冥界にトンネルぶち抜いてきました！:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
The Imperial excavation unit has bored a tunnel straight into the Underworld!
m940002.おふたりは、強すぎます。\nですが私とて、黒き竜人族の長。\n――この血に恥じぬ:
You two are far too strong.
But I, too, am the leader of the Black Dragonkin.
I will fight in a manner worthy of this bloodline.
m940002.おまかせあれ。\n私の王子様を呼んでこよう♪:
Leave it to me.
I'll go get my Prince♪
m940002.おや、お褒めに預かり恐悦至極。\n今の喜びをパーセントで表そうか？:
Oh my, I am deeply honored by your praise.
Shall I express my current joy in percentages?
m940002.おやアブグルント。……前線による、かな。\n総じて言えばこちらの方が押されている:
Oh, Abgrund. ……It depends on the front, I suppose.
Overall, we are being pushed back, but that is part of the plan.
m940002.お久しぶりです、墓守のリッチさん。\nお騒がせしてすみません。:
It's been a while, Lich, the gravekeeper.
Forgive the disturbance.
m940002.お前が望むのなら、我はお前にも、\n帝国に棲まう獣人にも手を差し伸べよう。:
If that is your wish, I will extend my hand to you,
and to the Beastmen dwelling in the Empire.
m940002.お前の部族が全滅すれば、\n皇帝としての器を手に入れた奴と戦える。\nそうでない:
If your tribe is wiped out,
you'll be able to fight a man who has truly earned the title of Emperor.
Otherwise, the age of the Skeleton Emperor will simply begin anew.
m940002.かつてこの地を守った戦士たちよ。\n王子、絶対に気を抜かないようにね。:
Warriors who once defended this land.
Prince, please stay vigilant at all times.
m940002.き、騎兵その２……ひひーん……っ！\n皆さん大丈夫ですか！？\n増援部隊、ただい:
C-Cavalry Unit 2… hihiiiin…!
Is everyone okay!?
Reinforcements have just arrived…!
m940002.くそっ、砲弾が痛ェ！\nオレの領地に何しやがる！？:
Dammit, these shells hurt!
What do you think you're doing in my territory!?
m940002.くっ……だめだ、この砦はもう……！: Grr… No good, this fortress is already…!
m940002.くっ……なんという力だ……。\nまさかオークでない者に、これ程の使い手がいたとは:
Grrr… what a force……
To think a non-Orc could wield such power to this degree.
m940002.くっ……山岳に退いたか！\n陛下、このまま行軍すれば、包囲されるやも――:
Grrr... They've retreated into the mountains!
Your Highness, if we keep marching like this, we might get surrounded—
m940002.くっ……敵の数が多すぎるか。\n仕方ない、これは切り札だったが……。:
Grr…… The enemy numbers are too great.
I suppose there's no choice. This was my trump card, but……
m940002.けっ……戦士が息子に死を看取られるなんざ、\n全然嬉しくないだろうが……。:
Tch... For a warrior to be seen off by his own son...
It's not exactly a thrill, is it...
m940002.けれど、この地は創造神が物質界の民に与えたもの。\n神々の争いで、奪い合うような:
However, this land was given by the Creator to the people of the material world.
It is not something to be seized in the quarrels of gods.
m940002.こ、この黒炎は……まさか亜神ハイドース様の……？: T-This black flame…… could it be…… from the Lesser God Hydros?
m940002.ここが冥界、と。\n……思ったよりも、悪い気はしませんね。:
So this is the underworld.
…It's not as unpleasant as I expected.
m940002.ここで、あなたに立ちはだかる全ての力は、\n人が亜神に抗わんとする、\nその意志:
All the power standing in your way here is what was grasped
at the end of the will of humans
striving to resist a demigod.
m940002.ここで、己が信徒と共に冥界の黒炎に焼かれるがいい！\n精神体の一欠片まで消え去れ:
Here, burn with the black flames of the underworld along with your followers!
Let even a fragment of your spirit be erased, Goddess Adamas――!!
m940002.ここで追撃をすれば、その部隊は残らず返り討ちにあうぞ。\n……今回は、痛み分けだ:
If we pursue them now, our entire unit will be wiped out.
……This time, it's a draw.
m940002.ここは複数の街道の交差点だからね。\n地形的にも、西から帝都へ入るためには、\n:
This place is a crossroads for several major roads.
Geographically speaking, anyone coming from the west to reach the Imperial Capital
has to pass through here, almost without exception.
m940002.ここまでは上手く潜入できましたけど……。\nうぅ、さっきより敵が増えてますし、\:
We managed to infiltrate this far without issue, but……
Ugh, there are more enemies than before,
so it looks like we won't be able to avoid a fight……
m940002.こちらにも、可愛くも愚かな後継者に、\n自ら引導を渡すくらいの慈悲はある。\n剣:
We, too, have the mercy to grant our
adorable, foolish successors a swift end.
Draw your sword and face us with the full might of the Empire.
m940002.こちらの兵を展開できる隙間ができたのだから、\nここからは反撃、というわけだよお:
Now that we have an opening to deploy our forces,
it's time for the counterattack, my dear.
m940002.こちらの戦力も、随分と失われてしまった。\n此度の戦、勝利したとしても、\n我が:
We've lost a significant portion of our forces.
Even if we win this battle,
my territory will have suffered heavy losses.
m940002.このためって、いったいどういうことなの！？\nこんな所に大穴開けたって何も……。:
Stalling for what, exactly!?
Opening a hole like this doesn't change anything…
m940002.この先に待っているのがヘリューズだとして、\n彼女がダークエルフたちを守るために:
Assuming Helyus is waiting ahead,
and she chose to fight in order to protect the Dark Elves…
well, I suppose this is what would happen.
m940002.この地が冥界に最も近い場所である理由、\n数多の戦士が眠る場所である理由、\nそ:
The reason this place is closest to the Underworld,
the reason so many warriors sleep here,
and the reason resentment still swirls here—
m940002.この地で、いったい何が……？\n冥界の門が開いた正式な記録は、\n白の帝国にはな:
What on earth is going on here…?
There should be no official record of the Gate of the Underworld opening
in the White Empire…
m940002.この戦いは帝国が背負うべきもの。\nされど、民に血を流させるわけにはいかない。:
This war is a burden the empire must bear.
However, we cannot let the people shed their blood.
m940002.この砦は帝都に至る街道の、守りの要だ。\n「城門」も強固な防御力を誇っているが、:
This fort is the key to defending the road to the Imperial Capital.
The "Main Gate" boasts strong defenses,
but there's no such thing as perfect preparation for war.
m940002.この都市には、古くから住まう者もいれば、\n航海の果てに住み着いた者たちもいる。:
This city is home to those who have lived here since time immemorial,
those who settled here at the end of their voyages,
and those we annexed through war.
m940002.こら、無駄口を叩かない。\n周辺警戒を厳となせと言われたばかりだろう？:
Hey, no idle chatter.
Didn't you just get ordered to keep a close watch on our surroundings?
m940002.こらこら、喧嘩は戦闘が終わってからだよレディたち。\nさぁ、襲撃が止まった今の内:
Now, now, save the bickering for after the battle, ladies.
Come on, the assault has paused!
Let's hurry and resupply!
m940002.こらっ、また起きてきたな！？\n前線は王子たちに任せたまえ。\nサザンカはよく戦:
Hey, you're up again, aren't you?
Leave the front lines to the princes.
You've already fought well enough, Sasanqua.
m940002.これが我が覇道の行き着く先、\n我が血を継ぐ帝国軍の、当代の姿だというのか。:
??? : Is this the end of my path of hegemony?
The current state of the Imperial army, which bears my blood?
m940002.これが起動試験となる。……すまないな。\n――王子、この砲は広範囲を凍結させ、\:
This will be the activation test. ……I'm sorry.
――Prince, this cannon is a new weapon that can freeze a wide area
and significantly slow the enemy's advance.
m940002.これなら、誰ひとり残さず収容が可能だ。\nさぁ呆けていないで撤収を急げ！:
This will allow us to evacuate everyone without leaving anyone behind.
Stop gawking and hurry up and retreat!
m940002.これなるは、我らが怒り、父祖の怒り、\n虐げられし者たちの声なき怒り。:
This is our anger, the anger of our ancestors,
the silent rage of the oppressed.
m940002.これは……まずいな……。\n王子、気を抜くな――来るぞ！:
This is……bad.
Prince, stay alert――here they come!
m940002.これは、故郷を取り戻す戦いだ。\n胸を張って舵を取れ。\nさぁ、今しばらく海上支:
This is a war to reclaim our homeland.
Hold your head high and take the helm.
Now then, I'm counting on you for naval support for a while longer.
m940002.これは軍と軍の戦い……。\n戦場を知る者同士の争い、ということですね……。:
This is a war between armies…….
A clash between those who know the battlefield, I suppose…….
m940002.これまで、よくぞ耐えてきた。\n貴様ら白の王国貴族の無念、\n我ら冥界軍と共に晴:
You have endured well until now.
Let us clear the resentment of the White Kingdom's nobles
together with the Netherworld Army.
m940002.これまで、冥界は偵察すら不可能な場所だったものね。\n他の者たちも、\n気になる:
Until now, the Underworld was a place where even reconnaissance was impossible.
Everyone else,
please report anything that concerns you.
m940002.これも、ある意味じゃ慈悲なのかもね。\n苦しまないようにしたんだと思うよ。:
In a way, it might be a mercy.
I think they did it so they wouldn't have to suffer.
m940002.これより先、我らと志を同じくする、\n数多の戦士たちが同じ道を駆け抜けることとな:
From this point on, countless warriors
who share our cause will run the same path.
m940002.これより先、未来の帝国は、\n迷い、選び、それでも立ち止まらない、\n力強く歩み:
From this point on, the future Empire will be
a nation that wanders, chooses, yet never stops,
walking powerfully forward――for its people.
m940002.これより帝国軍は物質界へ撤退する！\nこれは、陛下と、アンジェリーネ様の命令であ:
The Imperial army will now retreat to the Material World!
This is the command of His Majesty and Your Ladyship Angeline!
m940002.ご無事で何よりです。\nそろそろ冥界軍も\n動き出すでしょうから、危ないところで:
I'm so glad you're safe.
The Underworld army should be moving soon,
so that was a very dangerous spot.
m940002.ご苦労でした、マルゴット教導隊長。\nあなたが防衛部隊を指揮してくれていたのです:
Well done, Instructor Captain Margot.
So you were the one commanding the defense force.
m940002.ご配慮痛み入る。\n――ではまた、冥界にてまみえよう。:
I appreciate your consideration.
Then, until we meet again in the Netherworld.
m940002.さぁ、そろそろ決着と行こうか。\n全員逃さねぇ、ひとり残らずオレが殺してやるよ！:
Now then, let's settle this.
I won't let a single one of you escape. I'll kill every last one of you!
m940002.さぁ、ヤツが真っすぐ突っ込んでくるよ。\nオークの王の死に様、受け止めてやりな！:
There, he's charging straight at us.
Witness the death of the King of Orcs!
m940002.さぁ、冥界軍が来るわ。\nみんな、迎撃の準備を！:
Come, the Netherworld Army is approaching.
Everyone, prepare to intercept them!
m940002.さぁ、戦いはまだ続いているぞ。\n世界を救う王子のその意志、\n王国軍も皆、受け:
Now then, the battle is far from over.
Let us show them that the Kingdom's army
has inherited the will of the Prince who saves the world!
m940002.さぁ、戦いはまだ続いているぞ！\n我らは王国軍。\n盟友たる帝国の民を守るため、:
Now then, the battle is far from over!
We are the Kingdom's army.
We take up our swords to protect the people of our ally, the Empire!
m940002.さぁ、殺し合おう。\n帝国の未来を、この目に見せてみよ！！:
Come, let us kill each other.
Show me, with your own eyes, the future of the Empire!!
m940002.さぁ、疑問が解けたのなら、\nちゃんと周囲を警戒していておくれよ。:
Now then, if your doubts are resolved,
please keep a proper watch on your surroundings.
m940002.さぁ、若者の道を切り開くのは、\n死にゆく老兵の役割だ――まぁ、もう死んでるんだ:
Now then, clearing the path for the youth
is the duty of the dying veterans――well, we're already dead, but!
m940002.さぁ、行くぞ同胞たちよ。\n――我らの反逆を見せてやれ。:
Now then, let's go, my compatriots.
――Show them our rebellion.
m940002.さぁ、負傷者は早く撤退しろ！\nそう長くは――いや、格好つける意味もないか。\n:
Now, the wounded, retreat immediately!
I can't hold them off for long—no, there's no point in making a show of it.
I have seconds to spare. Hurry!!
m940002.さぁ前を向いて！ 武器を構えて！\nまだ門は破れてない、諦めるには早すぎるんだか:
Now look forward! Take your weapons!
The gate hasn't been breached yet, it's too early to give up!
m940002.さぁ我が配下たちよ、\n誇りを胸に、立ち上がったオークよ！\n先代勇者たちが開い:
Now then, my followers!
Orcs who have risen with pride in your hearts!
The path our predecessors opened—tear it apart, right now!!
m940002.さぁ王子、次の戦闘の準備だ！\nお前も戦士なら、あいつらを受け止めてやりな！:
Now then, Prince, let's prepare for the next battle!
If you're a warrior, then stand firm and face them head-on!
m940002.さぁ竜人族が兵たちよ！\n地上にさらなる穴を開けてやれ！\nもはやこの都市はわし:
Come now, Dragonkin soldiers!
Pierce yet another hole in the surface!
This city is ours now!
m940002.さすがは冥界軍、兵力も無尽蔵ですか。: As expected of the Netherworld Army, their forces are seemingly endless.
m940002.さすがは教導隊長。\nやり口がやらしー。:
Just as expected from the Drill Instructor.
That's a pretty sneaky tactic.
m940002.さっきの、アンジェリーネ様たちの話、聞いてた？\nどちらもこの国のことを考えてる:
Did you hear what Angelina and the others were saying earlier?
They are both thinking of this country.
So, it's probably unlikely that anyone in the city will get hurt.
m940002.さっきも言っただろう。\n私はサザンカを友だと思っているからだとも。\nさぁ、警: As I said earlier, it is because I consider Sasanqua my friend. Now then, let us maintain our vigilance. The enemy's assault is not over yet.
m940002.さて……セグナンドはどう出るか……。\nあの男が、まさか後ろで\n震えているとい:
Well then……how will Segnand play his hand…….
That man surely isn't just trembling in the back.
m940002.さて、この報告を聞いたとき、\nあいつはどんな顔をするだろうか……。:
Now, when he hears this report,
what kind of face will he make……?
--- scene: story talk 1 ---
m940002.さて、それを考えるのは戦闘が終わった後だ。\nここで砦が落ちたら何の意味もないか:
Well, we can worry about that after the battle is over.
If this fortress falls, it won't mean a thing.
m940002.さて、ではそろそろ、\n我が死者たる魔力を注いで、冥界の門を――:
Now then, it is about time I poured
my power as the dead into the Gate of the Underworld—
m940002.さて、では今の皇帝はなにができる？\n何をもって我らに対抗せんとする。:
Now then. What can the current Emperor do?
With what does he intend to oppose us?
m940002.さて、な。\n俺も白の帝国も、恨みを買いすぎている。\n今さら誰が殺しに来てもお:
Who knows.
Both I and the White Empire have made too many enemies.
It wouldn't be surprising if anyone came to kill us now.
m940002.さて、ワシには会わない方がいいヤツがいるからな……。\nさっさと冥界に戻ると――:
Now then, there's someone I'd rather not run into...
I'd better head back to the underworld before I do—
m940002.さて、帝国兵ども、\nそろそろ幕引きってやつだ。\nオレを楽しませてくれた礼をし:
Well then, you Imperial soldiers…
It's about time to wrap this up.
I'd better thank you for the entertainment.
m940002.さて、戦いの勝敗は誰にも分からないものだからね。\n兵のひとりとしては勝つつもり:
Well, no one can know the outcome of a battle.
As one soldier among many, I intend to win.
…However, my main concern is Lord Adamas.
m940002.さて王子よ、貴君にはひとつ助言を授けよう。\nセグナンドたちダークエルフにも、\:
Now then, Prince. I shall offer you a piece of advice.
Among the Dark Elves, including Segnand's forces,
there exist mages known as Druids.
m940002.さらばじゃ、メリュジアナ。\nエルドラ様と、ハクノカミ様にもよろしく伝えておくれ:
Farewell, Meliusiana.
Please give my regards to Lord Eldra and the White Kami.
m940002.しかし……クロコさま！\nなぜ……何を目的に戦っているのですか！？:
But…… Lord Croco!
Why…… what is your purpose in fighting us!?
m940002.しかし、それは自分のための戦いである。\n誇り高き我ら獣人は、\n誰かのために戦:
But that was a fight for yourselves.
We, the proud Beastmen,
possess the strength to fight for others.
m940002.しかし、それゆえに期待しよう。\n神なる竜に連なる戦士よ。\n竜族の雷、この目に:
However, that is precisely why I have high hopes.
Warrior who stands with the divine dragon.
Let me see the thunder of the dragon with my own eyes.
m940002.しかし、そんな古い構えを、\n今の時代でも伝承しているのは、\n重要な意味がある:
However, the fact that such an old stance
is still being passed down in this era
must have a significant meaning.
m940002.しかし、よくもまぁ撤退ルートの構築に、\n冥界をぶち抜くトンネルを作ろうなんて思:
But seriously, who came up with the idea of digging a tunnel
through the Underworld to create a retreat route?
m940002.しかし、姫……っ。\nこの者らは、本来私が……。:
But, Princess…
These people were originally under my…
m940002.しかし、陛下……このままでは、あなたが……ッ！！: But, Your Majesty…… if we do nothing, you'll……!!
m940002.しかし私を捜索している間、\n敵部隊の一部をこちらに\n釘付けにしていると思えば:
Still, while they're searching for me,
I'm keeping part of their units pinned down.
Not the worst outcome, I suppose.
m940002.せっかくの最新鋭バトルタンクが……！\nくぅぅぅっ、覚えておけ、白の皇帝めッ！！:
My state-of-the-art battle tanks……!
Grrr, remember this, you White Emperor!!
m940002.せめて城門は守りきらないとですね。\nあれが破られたら、砦に敵が侵入しちゃいます:
At the very least, we must hold the gates.
If they're breached, the enemy will pour into the fortress.
m940002.そいつは魅力的だ！\n我が王よ、玉座を磨いておいてくださいよ！:
That sounds appealing!
My King, keep the throne polished and ready!
m940002.そう、でしたな……。\nそれではセグナンド殿、地上の制圧は任せましたぞ。:
Yes, I see…….
Then, Lord Segnand, I leave the ground operations to you.
m940002.そういうことよ。\nさぁ王子、剣を構えなさい。\nあなたの前に立ちふさがるのは―:
Exactly.
Now then, Prince, draw your sword.
What stands before you is――the legend of the orcs!!
m940002.そういうわけだ。\n心霊スポットというと聞こえが悪いけど、\nつまりは誰よりも多:
That's the idea.
"Haunted spot" sounds a bit grim, but it simply means
a place where more people have died than anywhere else.
m940002.そういうサザンカこそ、\n普段から「鬼こそ最強！」とか叫んでいるじゃないか。:
And yet, Sasanqua,
you're the one who's always shouting "Oni are the strongest!"
m940002.そうか、お前は戦場に出てまだ短かったな。\n戦場における、最強の存在がどんなもの:
I see. You haven't been on the battlefield for long, have you.
Do you know what the strongest presence on a battlefield truly is?
m940002.そうしちゃいましょうかねぇ。\n幸い、波長のあう者もいるようですし……。:
Let's do just that, then.
Fortunately, it seems we have some kindred spirits here…
m940002.そうだね。これは街を守るためだし――って、\nマレブランケ！ 動いたっ！！\n敵:
I know. We're doing this to protect the town—wait,
Malebranche! They're moving!
The enemy fleet is deploying landing craft!
m940002.そうだッ！ だが追撃してくる者は皆殺しにしろ！\nそうして――次の戦の為に生き残:
That's right! But if any of you pursue us, kill them all!
And then—survive for the next battle!!
m940002.そうね……相手はただのダークエルフではない、\n冥界と手を結んだ連中よ。:
That's right……our opponents are no ordinary Dark Elves.
They are allied with the Underworld.
m940002.そうはいかないのが、人というものなのさ。\n人間は誇りのために、容易く剣を抜くか:
That is the nature of humans.
Humans will draw their swords easily for the sake of pride.
m940002.そう聞こえたならば謝罪しよう。\nただ、真なる雷を、知っているがゆえな。:
If that is how it sounds, I apologize.
I only speak thus because I know what the true thunder is.
m940002.そして、その無力な民を薙ぎ払い、\n血の丘で美酒に酔いしれる、\nあの得も言われ:
And the indescribable pleasure of mowing down those powerless people
and getting drunk on fine wine atop a hill of blood.
m940002.そして、まだ流動的ではあるが、\nこれは保護ではなく、\n将来的には割譲されるも:
And while the situation is still fluid,
you may consider this not as protection,
but as a territory to be ceded in the future.
m940002.そして、物質界においても、\n死の香りの強まる場所であれば、\n擬似的な冥界の門:
And in the Material World, in places where the scent of death is strong,
a pseudo-gate to the Underworld can open spontaneously.
m940002.そしてその、新たな神器。\n女神アダマス、己が肉体を魔力と化し、\n神器に注ぎ込:
And that new divine weapon.
Goddess Adamas, did you turn your own body into magic power
and pour it into the weapon?
m940002.そして生者でありながら、\n冥界へ踏み入る禁を犯せし物質界の者ども！！:
And you, the beings of the material world, who are alive yet
have broken the taboo by stepping into the Underworld!!
m940002.そっちの、今も迷い続けている\n冥界の騎士さまのほうが、\nよっぽど気が合いそう:
No, I think I'd get along much better with
that knight of the underworld who's still wandering around.
m940002.そのまさか、さ。\nヘカティエによると、冥界は、天界や魔界とは\nその根本が異な:
Exactly so.
According to Hecate, the Underworld is fundamentally different
from the Celestial Realm or the Demon Realm.
m940002.そのヘカティエ様も、今は冥界にいない。\nならば、今日は死ぬには良い日だろう。:
That Lady Hecatie isn't in the Underworld right now.
If that's the case, today is a fine day to die.
m940002.その中でも、公然と皇帝陛下に牙を剥いたのは――: And among them, the ones who openly bared their fangs at His Imperial Majesty were…
m940002.その使い所、もしかして今じゃないですか……？\nすごい数の敵が「城門」に向かって:
That timing... could it be right now?
A massive number of enemies are heading straight for the "city gate"!
m940002.その元凶こそが、ルインですから。\n王子はルインを守るために、\nすべての情報を:
The source of it all is Ruin.
The Prince kept all this information confidential
to protect Ruin.
m940002.その全てが、帝国の臣民だ。\nレオナ、街の防備を固めろ。\n誰ひとりとして、死者:
They are all subjects of the Empire.
Leona, fortify the city's defenses.
Not a single one of them is to be lost.
m940002.その娘であるあなたの言葉は、\n決して、私に届きはしないのよ。:
Words from a daughter of that house
will never reach me.
m940002.その心配はいりませんわ。\n何のために、掘削部隊を連れてきたと？:
There is no need to worry about that.
Why do you think I brought the excavation unit?
m940002.その恩なら、もう返してもらった。: That kindness has already been repaid.
m940002.その意気だ。\nオレより多くの首級を上げれば、\n次代のオークロードになれるかも:
Now that's the spirit.
If you take more heads than I do,
you might just become the next Orc Lord.
m940002.その点は、事前にヘリューズ様と\n打ち合わせ済みらしいですよ？: Apparently, that point was already discussed with Lady Heleus in advance?
m940002.その興奮度、１００００％！\n……って、あっ、あれ？ おや？:
The thrill of that would be 10,000%!
……Wait, wha? Oh?
m940002.その覚悟、その怒り、その悲しみ……。\n亜神として、受け止めてやろうではないか。:
That resolve, that rage, that sorrow…….
As a demigod, I shall be the one to bear it.
m940002.その覚悟、見事なものだ。\nせめて苦しまず、冥界の民となるがいい。:
Your resolve is admirable.
At the very least, let me spare you pain
as you become a citizen of the Netherworld.
m940002.その言葉には、否と応えましょうぞ。\n叛逆軍の軍師レオナ殿。:
I shall answer that with a resounding no.
Leona, the rebel army's strategist.
m940002.その身は既に死したも同然、\n奪い、蹂躙し、莫大な富を築くその覇道は、\n己が命:
Your body is already as good as dead.
Your path of conquest—seizing, trampling, and amassing immense wealth—
is merely the product of you having staked your life on it all along.
m940002.その道を選んだのは王子ですから、仕方ありません。\nそして王子に付いていくと決め:
The Prince chose this path, so there's nothing we can do.
And we are the ones who decided to follow him.
m940002.それから、ここはまだマシな方よ。\n冥界のさらに深くでは、\n定命の者の生命力な:
Besides, this is still the mild part.
Deeper in the underworld,
the life force of those with a fixed lifespan is―
m940002.それから、そっちはセグナンドの娘さん。\n良かった、無事に戻って来られたのですね:
And you, over there, are Segnand's daughter.
I'm glad to see you returned safely.
m940002.それからグラティア、\nアダマス様の神器、拾い集めてくれますか？:
And Gratia,
could you gather up the shards of Adamas's divine artifact?
m940002.それからティルト！ 早くこっちへ！\n――ヘカティエ様のところに、戻りたいんでし:
And Tilt! Come over here, quickly!
—You want to get back to Hecate, don't you?
m940002.それがどうしたというのだ。\n強さとは畏怖と恐怖をもたらすものだ。\nだというの:
And what of that?
Strength is what brings awe and terror.
Yet, what is the state of the Empire now?
m940002.それが悪を討つためか、\n定命の者たちの悲しみを雪ぐためなのかは分からぬ。\nじ:
Whether it was to strike down evil,
or to avenge the sorrow of those bound by fate, I cannot say.
But I suspect our views differ on the matter.
m940002.それが魔法であり、機械である。\n己を、大切なものを守るために、\n鎧となり、剣:
That strength takes the form of magic and machinery.
To protect themselves and those they hold dear, they forged their power into armor, into swords, and into wings.
m940002.それで、我が戦を、貴様はどう捉えた。\n我が配下に加わるというのなら、\n喜んで:
So, how did you view my war?
If you wish to join my ranks,
I would be delighted to welcome you.
m940002.それでも、お前には――いや、\nこの世界には、亜神に抗う戦力が必要だろう。: Even so, you—no, this world—will need the strength to stand against the Demi-Gods.
m940002.それでも、蹂躙された者は忘れないものだ。\n――レオナ、報告は以上か？:
Even so, those who were trampled do not forget.
――Leona, is that all?
m940002.それでもなお、獣人を帝国から解放するためには、\n強大な戦力が必要なのよ。:
Even so, we need overwhelming military strength
to free the Beastmen from the Empire.
m940002.それでもなお、白の帝国は歪に肥大化しすぎた。\nそろそろ、精算しなければなります:
Even so, the White Empire has grown too distorted, too bloated.
It is high time we settled the accounts.
m940002.それでもなお、進もうとする、なんて。\nどうか、おやめなさい。\nあなたの歩む道:
And still, you try to move ahead.
Please, stop.
The path you walk only brings you pain.
m940002.それでよく渡り合っているものだ……。\nだが、おかげで亜神の注意を逸らせた。\n:
It is impressive that they are matching each other so well…
However, we have managed to distract the demi-god's attention.
――We will begin our retreat as soon as the scout cavalry returns.
m940002.それで帝国がなにかを言ってくるならッ！\n我が無冠のチャンピオンとして立ち塞がる:
If the Empire says anything about it!
I will stand in their way as their uncrowned Champion!
m940002.それなら、どうして戦おうと思ったんだろうね。\n考えてみれば、サザンカが\nこち:
Then why did you decide to fight?
Come to think of it, it's strange enough that you're
fighting on our side in the first place.
m940002.それに、誰も彼もが忘れています。\n上が争えば、そのしわ寄せをくらうのは民なので:
Besides, everyone forgets.
When the upper echelons fight, it's the common people who suffer the consequences.
So, what can be done now is――
m940002.それにしても、酷すぎるよ。\n……ッ、あれは、あの姿は――:
Still, it's too much.
……That, that form—
m940002.それにアタシの打った武具に、\nみんな命を預けて戦ってんだ。\n見届ける責任って:
Besides, everyone is fighting with the weapons I forged.
I have a responsibility to see them through, don't I?
m940002.それは、お前たちの実力次第だ。\n亜神ラビリスよ、まさか皇帝同士の戦いに、\n水:
That depends on your capabilities.
Sub-god Labrys, you wouldn't have the audacity to interfere
in a battle between emperors, would you?
m940002.それは、どういう――: What do you mean by that—
m940002.それは妙な話だ。\n現状、冥界軍の各戦力は帝都周辺に分散している。\nどれかひと:
That is strange.
Currently, the Netherworld forces are scattered around the Imperial Capital.
If they can take just one of them, they'll have a path to victory.
m940002.それは敵も同じこと。\n戦術教官殿も、それを狙っての後退指示でしょう。\nただ…:
The enemy is in the same boat.
I assume the Tactical Instructor's order to retreat was aimed at that.
However……there is one thing that concerns me…….
m940002.それは鍛冶職人が考えること！\nさぁトゥーダ、陛下を運びますよ！:
That's a problem for the blacksmiths to figure out!
Now, Tuda, let's get Your Majesty moved!
m940002.それもあの子は、自分の命だけじゃなくて、\n部族すべての命を救うために、\nここ:
???: Apparently, she didn't come here just to save her own life.

She's here to “negotiate” for the survival of her entire tribe.
m940002.それもありますけど……。\n王国軍は、こういう事態に関してはエキスパートですから:
That's part of it, but…….
The Royal Army is an expert in these kinds of situations.
No one surpasses the Prince when it comes to counterattacking from a desperate position.
m940002.それよりあんた！ クロコだっけ？\nさっき、この街を滅ぼすって言ったよね！？:
And you! Croco, was it?
You just said you were going to destroy this town, right!?
m940002.それより女ァ！ てめぇ気に入ったぜ。\nこのオレに口答えしておいて、\nのうのう:
But you, girl! I like you.
You're the first one since Hecatie to talk back to this me
and still manage to survive!
m940002.それを教えてしまえば、お前を安心させてしまうだろう。\nせいぜい不安を抱えて日々:
If I told you, it would only put your mind at ease.
Suffer in uncertainty, invader.
m940002.そろそろ、件のダークエルフドルイドを出してくるはずだ。\n連中は茨を振るい、戦士:
They should be deploying one of those Dark Elf Druids soon.
They will scatter thorns and poison your warriors.
Be careful with your unit placement when giving orders.
m940002.そろそろ交代の時間です。\n仮眠をとってきてください、カテリナさん。:
It's about time for the shift change.
Please get some rest, Katerina.
m940002.そんな、でも……うぅぅぅっ！\nよくないです！ こういうのは！:
I know, but…… ughhh!
This is wrong! This kind of thing is!
m940002.そんなことをしたら、\nまた自分が、悲哀と嘆きの音色で苦しむことになるのに。\n:
Doing that would only
make you suffer again in the tones of sorrow and lamentation.
You really are a kind-hearted, self-sacrificing, reclusive Demigod.
m940002.そんなに急いでどうしたのですか？\n陛下でしたら、王国の王子殿下と会談を……。:
What is the urgency?
His Majesty is in conference with the Prince of the Kingdom……
m940002.そんなに急ぐと転びますよ？\nただでさえ冥界に縁のない者は体力を削られるのに、\:
If you rush like that, you'll trip, you know?
Those with no affinity for the Underworld are already drained of stamina,
and the frozen river is slippery to boot.
m940002.そんなの、王失格じゃないの！\n誰かのために戦う王なんて、\n民を放り出して、誰:
That's no way for a king to act!
A king who fights for others,
a king who abandons his people to fight for others...!
m940002.そんな存在のために、命を賭してでも\n勝利への礎となることを決めた者。\nそれこ:
Those who, for such an existence, are willing to stake their lives
to become the foundation of victory.
They are the mightiest warriors on the field.
m940002.そんな彼女が、死の蔓延する戦場に飛び込めば、\nきっと正気を保ってはいられないで:
If someone like that throws herself into a battlefield
where death is rampant,
she certainly won't be able to keep her sanity.
m940002.そんな泣き顔で何が誇りか。\n何が獣人の尊厳か。:
With a face like that, what pride is there?
What dignity is there in being a Beastman?
m940002.そんな状況で……いや、だからこそ、か？\n獣人とオーク以外の戦力を伏せている、\:
In a situation like that... or perhaps, precisely because of it?
It's entirely possible they're holding back their forces other than the Beastmen and Orcs.
m940002.そんな王子が、自分から\nこの砦の防衛を担当するって言ったんだっけ？\nここって:
I remember the Prince volunteering
to take charge of defending this fortress.
Is this place that important a stronghold?
m940002.ただ、その先は街だ。\n正直、事態はまったく好転していないぞ。:
That said, there's a town beyond that.
Honestly, the situation isn't improving at all.
m940002.ただ、良き父として、\n未来を子らに残す族長として、\n俺はここに、命をかけて剣:
I am simply here, risking my life and taking up my sword,
as a good father,
as a chieftain leaving the future to his children.
m940002.たぶん、見張りに気付かれないように、\n超低空を飛ばしてきたんだ。\nこのままじ:
They probably flew at ultra-low altitude
to avoid our scouts.
If we don't act now, they'll attack before we're ready!
m940002.だからこその、強固な城門と、\n強固……だった城壁なんだよね。:
That's why we have such sturdy city gates,
and sturdy... well, they *were* sturdy walls.
m940002.だが……オレは、ここで死ぬ……。\n冥界には……戦士たちだけ、連れて行ってやって:
But… I'm going to die here…
Take only the warriors… to the underworld…
m940002.だが、それでも……。\nこの命、祖国に捧げるのであれば惜しくはない。:
But, even so…….
If I can dedicate this life to my homeland, I have no regrets.
m940002.だが、それでも立ち上がらんとするならば、\nリンクスよ、そしてその兵たちよ、\n:
But if you still choose to rise,
Lynx, and your soldiers,
you shall become my finest kin.
m940002.だが、まだだ。\nオークの戦士たちよ、散開せよ！\nここで、オレたちが白の帝国を:
But not yet.
Orc warriors, scatter!
Here is where we strike down the White Empire!!
m940002.だが、ハイドース様が動けぬその隙をつき、\n奴が現れ、私の家族たちを虐殺し始めた:
But while Lord Haidos was unable to move,

that creature appeared and began massacring my family.
m940002.だが、一度の砲撃ごとに魔導機関の冷却が必要となる。\n連射はできないから、使い所:
However, the magic mechanism requires a cooldown after each shot.
You won't be able to fire in rapid succession, so choose your timing carefully.
m940002.だが、今代の皇帝は約束したぞ？\n民と共に歩いていく、それが未来の帝国の姿だと。:
But the current Emperor made a promise, didn't he?
That he would walk alongside his people. That is the shape of the empire's future.
m940002.だが、奴を仕留めれば陣地を取り戻すことができる。\n焦ればセグナンドの術中に嵌め:
But if we can take him down, we can reclaim the ground.
Don't rush, or you'll fall right into his trap.
m940002.だが、指揮官が前線に並び立つことの心強さは、\n俺たちも十分に理解していることだ:
But we understand well enough the reassurance that comes
from a commander standing shoulder to shoulder with his troops.
m940002.だが、死ぬために戦うな。\n……親父殿に誇れるような死に方をしろ。:
??? : But don't fight in order to die.
……Die in a way that would make your father proud.
m940002.だが、限りがあると分かれば戦いようもある。\n手の内の分からない敵ではないのだか:
But if there is a limit, there is a way to fight.
They are not an enemy with hidden cards,
so we can just trample them as we always have.
m940002.だが、願いのために犠牲は必要なのだ。\nその願いを阻まんとする者がいる限り。\n:
But sacrifice is the price of our desires.
So long as there are those who would stand in their way,
we have no choice but to fight.
m940002.だが獣人と冥界人の部隊だけで、\n帝国を攻め滅ぼすつもりでもあるまい。\n後に控:
But surely they don't intend to conquer and destroy the Empire
with just Beastkin and Netherworld troops.
What could possibly be waiting in the wings?
m940002.ちっ……さすがは魔神副団長、気付かれたか！\n攻撃を仕掛ける！ 俺に続けェ！！:
Tch… I knew it.
The Demon God's Vice Commander isn't easy to fool!
Attack! Follow me!!
m940002.ちっ……どうしたもんかね、こいつは……。: Tch… what are we supposed to do about this…
m940002.ちっ……調子が狂う……。\nこいつ、オレが誰か知ってて言ってんのか？: Tch… This is throwing me off. Does she know who I am?
m940002.ちっ……面倒なヤツだなこいつ……。\n騎士の名誉、亜神の名誉を、\nくだらねぇ感: Tch… What a pain. Ignoring the honor of a knight and a demi-god over some trivial emotion…
m940002.って、おい！ アタシに何ができるって――\nあぁ、もうっ！！:
Hey, wait! What am I supposed to do――
Argh, fine!!
m940002.つまり、父祖が生きた地を、返してくれるということか……？: So, you're returning the land where our ancestors lived……?
m940002.てめぇは物質界で、\n迷子の魂を誑かすのがお似合いなんだよ。\nなぁティルト？: You're better off in the Material World, luring lost souls. Right, Tilt? Say "I'm sorry."
m940002.で、でも、どうやってここから離れるんですかー！？\n結構入り口から歩きましたよね:
B-but how are we supposed to get out of here!?
We've walked quite a ways from the entrance, right!?
m940002.で、でも敵にはハーピーもいるみたいだよ？\nこんな広い戦場で空を飛ぶ相手なんて、:
B-but it looks like the enemy has Harpies too?
Can we really handle opponents flying around in such an open battlefield?
m940002.ですから、まずはこの戦争を止める手段を、\n模索してみようと思っただけです。:
So, I simply thought I would first
seek a way to stop this war.
m940002.ですが、こちらには私がいます。\n旗印の使い方くらい、心得ていますわね？:
However, I am here.
I know how to use a banner, don't I?
m940002.ですが、その情報は王国において\n秘匿されたと聞いております。:
However, I have heard that this information
was kept secret by the Kingdom.
m940002.ですが、それは彼の領地が力を持っていたから。\n力なき貴族は領地を奪われ、\n白:
However, that was only because his territory held power.
It is also a fact that powerless nobles had their lands seized
and were absorbed into the White Empire.
m940002.ですが、ふもとが見えてきました。\nあの丘に陣取れば、反転攻勢にはうってつけです:
However, we can see the foot of the mountain.
If we hold that hill, it would be the perfect position for a counterattack.
m940002.では、ベラート伯爵を捕らえに行きましょう。\nこの戦い、すでに趨勢は決まって――:
Then, let's go capture Count Belart.
The outcome of this battle is already decided――
m940002.では、迅速に後退しましょう。\nこちらの作戦が失敗した以上、\n装備の潤沢な敵に:
Then let us retreat swiftly.
Since our plan has failed, there is no need to stay and face an enemy with superior equipment.
m940002.ではひとつ、ヒントをあげよう。\n冥界と物質界が繋がる、\nそんな噂を、お嬢さん:
Then allow me to offer a hint.
You must have already heard the rumor about where the Underworld
and the Material World connect.
m940002.でも、あの飛空戦艦はまだまだ試作段階。\n飛行時間はごく限られているはずよ。:
However, those flying warships are still in the prototype stage.
Their flight time should be very limited.
m940002.でも、そのおかげで砦に侵入した敵はいないわ。\nさすがはガオレオンの血を引く戦士:
But thanks to that, no enemies have managed to enter the fortress.
I suppose that's what you'd call a warrior of the Gaoleon bloodline.
m940002.でも、今回は王子がいますから。: But this time, the Prince is with us.
m940002.でも、冥界に行けるような秘術や\n秘密の抜け穴なんて、聞いたことがない。: But I've never heard of any secret art or hidden passage that leads there.
m940002.でも、百獣の王者たるガオレオンは！\n自分のために戦ったことなんて一度もないんだ:
But the Gaoleon, the King of a Hundred Beasts!
Has never once fought for himself!!
m940002.でも、負傷者も増え始めている。\nこのまま戦いが進めば、\nいずれこちらの戦力で:
But our casualties are starting to pile up.
If this fight keeps going,
we should eventually be able to grind them down with our numbers.
m940002.でもね、そんなものは最前線じゃ消し飛ぶのが戦争さ。\nあいつらの本心を、信ずるモ:
But in the heat of battle, all that gets blown away. That's just how war works.
The only ones who can truly understand their true feelings,
and accept what they believe in, are the warriors standing on the front line with them.
m940002.でも敵の本隊は残ったままよ？: But the enemy's main force is still out there, isn't it?
m940002.でも！ でも……っ！\nあたしだけ後方なんて！:
But! But……
I can't just stay in the rear!
m940002.ともあれ、信じて待つしかないでしょう。\nマルゴット、前線に出ます。各戦線の情報:
In any case, we have no choice but to trust and wait.
Margot, I'm heading to the front lines. Send me reports from each sector—
m940002.どうした、貴様にも覚えがあるような口ぶりだが。: What is it? You speak as if you know that feeling.
m940002.どうしたも何も、東の山脈を超えて、\nベラート伯爵の飛空艦隊が迫ってるんだよ！:
There's no time for conferences!
Count Belato's flying fleet has crossed the eastern mountain range and is closing in!
m940002.どうしたんですか急に。\nそうですね……私なら、\n多方面からの揺さぶりをかけま:
Why do you ask all of a sudden?
Well…… I'd probably
apply pressure from multiple directions.
m940002.どうしたウルスラ、何が来たというのだ。: What is it, Ursula? What's coming?
m940002.どうした王子。\n王国軍は下げておけ。\nここでお前の軍を消耗させたくはない。:
What's wrong, Prince?
Withdraw the Kingdom's army.
I don't want to drain your forces here.
m940002.どうしてって……それはあんたが――\nうぅん、ほら、えっと……。\nあっ、この先:
Why? Well, it's because you――
Hmm, um, well…….
Oh! It's because once we cross the mountains, we'll be in our town…….
m940002.どうやら、新型兵器の\n出撃を防ぐことができたようですね。: It seems we've managed to prevent the new weapons from entering the fray.
m940002.どうやら間に合ったみたいね。\n冥界軍は動き始めたばかりみたいよ。:
Looks like we made it in time.
The Netherworld Army has just started moving.
m940002.どれだけの悲しみを背負ってきたのですか。\nどれだけの嘆きを、その胸に抱いてきた:
How much grief have you borne?
How much anguish have you held in your heart?
m940002.な、な、な、なにぃぃぃぃっ！？\n我が飛空戦艦が！ くっ……脱出だ！ 脱出せよ！:
W-What?!
My flying battleship! Curses……Evacuate! Evacuate now!!
m940002.なぁティルト、ヘカティエ、\n法を破った罪は重いぜ……？: Now, Tilt, Hecatie. The crime of breaking the law is a heavy one, isn't it…?
m940002.なかなかやるな、懐かしいぜこの感覚！\n物質界の匂いってやつだ！:
Not bad, not bad! This feeling is a welcome one!
It's that scent of the material world!
m940002.なぜ、こんなことをする。\nダークエルフの居留地を焼き、\n戦士でない者まで殺し:
Why are you doing this?
Burning the Dark Elves' settlement,
killing even the non-combatants, and now this sealed layer……
m940002.なぜそこまでして、ダークエルフを匿ったのでしょう。\nひとりでいたいなら、そんな:
Why did she go to such trouble to hide the Dark Elves?
If she wants to be alone, there was no need to…
m940002.なっ……あなた方は帝国軍本隊の……。\nまさか帝都から……！？:
Wha… You're from the Imperial main force…
From the Imperial Capital…!?
m940002.なっ……あれは……本当に冥界の黒炎！？: Wha…… that is…… really the Underworld's black flame!?
m940002.なっ……しかし！\n仇は目前に……！！:
W-What! But...
Our vengeance is within reach...!!
m940002.なっ……まさか貴様、城門を破壊するつもりで……！？: W-What? You're planning to destroy the castle gate……!?
m940002.なっ……アタシは別に、レーネがいなくても……。\nいなくても……うーん……いない:
W-What? I'm not like I can't do anything without Lehne…….
Without you……hmm……I guess,
yeah, I probably can't do it after all.
m940002.なっ……クロコさまっ！？\nどうしてここに……！？:
Wha…… Lord Croco!?
What are you doing here……!?
m940002.なに、むしろ素早く滑って移動できるというものだ！\n早く皆のところへ――んっ……:
What? It's actually easier to slide along quickly!
I just need to get to everyone—Hah… What is that…?
m940002.なにこれっ、地面に大穴が――\nきゃああぁああっ！？:
Wha— a huge hole in the ground—
Kyaaaaaah!?
m940002.ならば、それまで付き合うとしようか。\n我が友サザンカよ。: Then I shall keep you company until then. My friend, Sasanqua.
m940002.ならば、帝都につながる道は、\n盟友たる王国軍が守り抜くと、そう言っていましたか:
So he said that the royal army, our allies,
would protect the roads leading to the imperial capital.
m940002.ならば、白の帝国が危機にある今、\n私がなすべきことはひとつだけ……。:
Therefore, now that the White Empire is in crisis,
there is only one thing I must do…….
m940002.ならば、白の王国貴族に恥をかかせるな。\n正面から打ち破り、\n民を守護すべきは:
Then, do not disgrace the nobles of the White Kingdom.
Break them head-on
and show them who is the true guardian of the people.
m940002.ならば、誘いに乗ってやろう。\nこうして前線で相対するのは初めてだったか。:
Then I shall accept your invitation.
I believe this is the first time we've faced each other on the front lines.
m940002.ならばマルゴット、\n死者を戦力として扱える冥界軍が、\n幾度も攻勢をかけては撤:
If that is the case, Margot,
how do you explain the fact that the Netherworld Army,
which can treat the dead as troops, has attacked and retreated so many times?
m940002.なるほど……友が敵に……。\nそれは辛かろう、お嬢さん。:
I see…… a friend on the enemy side……
That must be painful, young lady.
m940002.なるほど、そこは同意しておこう。\nさぁ、一気に山を下るぞ！\n全員逸れないよう:
I see, I can agree with that much.
Now, let's descend the mountain in one go!
Everyone, be careful not to get left behind!
m940002.なるほど、竜に騎乗した竜人……。\nあの走破能力なら、悪路も簡単に突破しそうです:
I see. Dragonkin riding dragons…
With their speed, they'll easily cut through rough terrain.
m940002.なれば、我ガ望みヲ叶える時マデ、\nその威、存分ニ利用させテもらうとしヨウ！:
Then, until the time comes for my own wish to be granted,
I shall make full use of that power!
m940002.なんだか私、宝物みたいな扱いされてませんか？: I feel like I'm being treated like a treasure.
m940002.なんだか身体も重いし……。\n気温のせい？ それとも空気かな……。:
My body feels heavy too…
Is it the temperature? Or maybe the air…
m940002.なんですの、それ。\nせっかく死んだ後にも自我を保っているなら、\n楽しく仲良く:
What a strange thing to say.
If they managed to retain their self-awareness even after death,
they could have chosen to live happily and harmoniously.
m940002.ねぇ、これが終わったらさ、一緒に軍で働かない？\nアタシの部屋、ちょっと広すぎて: Hey, once this is over, how about working together in the army? My room is a little too big, and I've been having trouble with it.
m940002.はぁ……さっきの会話、聞いていただろう？\nそういう顔をする小娘は――こうだっ！:
Haa…… You were listening to that conversation, weren't you?
A girl making that face——like this! You little brat!
m940002.はぁ……しかしあまり前線に出ないように。\nこれは帝国の存亡をかけた戦いです。な:
Haa… just try not to push yourself too far forward.
This battle is for the survival of the Empire. It is the Imperial Knights, the army, and the Divine Warriors who must stake their lives here.
m940002.はぁ……はぁ……。\nどうにか、今回もしのいだかな……？:
Haa…… haa……
Did we…… manage to survive this time?
m940002.はぁ……はぁ……お断りね……。\nあなたみたいな粗暴な亜神とか、\n石頭で強情な:
Haa… haa… No, thank you….
A crude demi-god like you is far less my type than
that stubborn, thick-headed soul administrator—
m940002.はぁ……勝ちは勝ちだよ。\nなに痛み分けみたいな顔してるのさ。:
Haa…… We won, though.
Why are you making that face, like it was a draw?
m940002.はぁ……参ったな……。\nどうにか部下は逃したけど、\n完全に囲まれてしまったよ:
Haa…… this is bad……
I managed to get my subordinates away,
but it looks like I'm completely surrounded.
m940002.はぁ……国がどうとか、種族がどうとか、\nほんとよくやるよね、みんな。:
Haa……whether it's about the country or the race,
you guys really do it, huh.
m940002.はぁ……始まっちまったか。\n怪我人はこっちへ！\n重傷者はアウローラ様のところ:
???: Haa… so it has begun.
Injured, come this way!
Send the seriously wounded to Lady Aurora!
m940002.はぁっ、はぁ……っ！\nラウラ！ 陛下はどこに！？:
Haa, haa……!
Laura! Where is His Majesty?!
m940002.はい……でも、少しだけ心が震えました。\nきっと、物質界のオークはそれ以上に。:
Yes… but I felt a chill run down my spine.
The orcs of the Material World must be even more formidable.
m940002.はい、ヘリューズ様。\n家族は――私の部族の皆は無事だろうか！？:
Yes, Lady Heleus.
My family— is my tribe safe?!
m940002.はい、引きつった顔をしない。\n人がこの地にどれくらい耐えられるのか、\nそれを:
Yes, try not to look so grim.
Asking how long a person can last in this place is also part of our current objective.
m940002.はいっ！ グラティア、ここは任せましたよ！: Yes! Gratia, I'll leave this to you!
m940002.はいはい、ここで寝ないでくださいね。\nいつダークエルフの襲撃が\nあるか分から:
Yes, yes, please don't sleep right here.
We never know when the Dark Elves might launch an attack.
m940002.はい詰めて詰めてー！\nこっちの大型掘削機にも乗っちゃってください！:
Yes, pack in, pack in!
Get on this large excavator too!
m940002.はっ……なにゆえですか？\nこうして肩を並べて戦えるというのに！:
Hah... why is that?
We are standing side by side in battle!
m940002.はっ、えっ、えぇ……？\nトンネルに……飛空戦艦飛ばしたの……？:
Huh? W-what……?
We're flying a battleship through a tunnel……?
m940002.はっ、えっと、はい。\nでもアウローラ、いったい何を……？:
Y-Yes, um, right away.
But Aurora, what exactly did you……?
m940002.はっ、そうだ！\nまさにその情報を伝えようと思っていたのだった！:
Hah, that's right!
I was just about to share that very information!
m940002.はっ。前線拠点の守備を厳となせ！\n広域戦闘となるぞ！:
Yes sir. Tighten the defense of the forward base!
This will be a wide-area engagement!
--- scene: Sixth Formation: Fortress of the Land of the Dead (battle, end) ---
m940002.はっ！ ――総員、戦闘配置につけ！\n全軍での激突となるぞ！！:
Yes, sir! —All units, take your battle positions!
We are about to clash with their entire force!!
m940002.はっ！ セグナンド様！\n部隊ごとに撤退しろ！ 隊列を乱すな！:
Hah! Lord Segnand!
Retreat by unit! Don't break formation!
m940002.はっ！ ディアナ様！\n――それでは、ベラート伯爵の兵を迎え撃つとしましょうか。:
Yes ma'am! Lady Diana!
――Then, let us intercept Count Belato's soldiers.
m940002.はっ！ 総員、戦闘に備えろ！\nこれを海岸防衛、最後の戦いとするぞ！:
Yes, sir! All units, prepare for battle!
Let this coastal defense be our final stand!
m940002.はっ！ 総員、陣形を整えよ！\n敵は……もう、兵たちにも隠す必要もないだろう。\:
Hah! All units, form up!
The enemy is… well, there's no need to hide it from the troops anymore.
It is the army of the Skeleton Emperor, the symbol of our blood-soaked past!!
m940002.はっ？ あんた突然何を言い出して――: Huh? What are you suddenly talking about――
m940002.ははっ、何とも重い使命だ。\n――なれば、今宵は世界に杯を捧げるとしよう。:
Hah, what a heavy burden.
――Then, let us raise a toast to the world this evening.
m940002.ははっ、心配無用。\nシャディアは私の茶飲み友だちです。\n恨むどころか、先代の:
Haha, don't worry about it.
Shadia is just my tea-time friend.
Far from resenting her, the Predecessor's death is a joke to us.
m940002.ははっ、皮肉が分かる知能は残っていたか。\n――何、心配するな。\n私はこちら側: Haha, so your wit is still intact. ——Don't worry about it. I intend to fight on our side.
m940002.ははっ！ 随分と王子に影響されたみたいだねぇ。\nこんな常識人になっちまってさ。:
Haha! You've been quite influenced by the Prince, haven't you?
You've turned into such a common-sense person.
m940002.ははは、何をいまさら。我が祖国とは\n白の王国であって、白の帝国ではないのですぞ:
Hahaha, what a silly question. My homeland
is the White Kingdom, not the White Empire.
……Besides, they are standing on that side with their resolve set.
m940002.ひっ……。\nそれって、ここにずっといると死んじゃうってこと？:
H-hey…
Does that mean if I stay here too long, I'll die?
m940002.ひっ……ご、ごめんなひゃい……。\nでも……絶対あいつ許さないから……！:
H-hey…… s-sorry……
But…… I'm never going to forgive him……!
m940002.ひとりで突っ込むからです！\n王子様、困った姉をお願いしますね……？:
That's because you charge in alone!
Your Highness, please look after my troublesome sister...?
m940002.ふぁ……あふ……。\nうぅぅ、睡眠不足だぁ……。:
Faa… ah-fu…
Ugh, I'm so sleep-deprived…
m940002.ふぅ……初戦はこちらの勝利、だな。\n皆、よくやってくれた！:
Phew…… we've won the first engagement.
Well done, everyone!
m940002.ふぅ……背中に帝国の民を背負ってると思うと、\nほんとに責任重大ね。:
Phew... Thinking about the Imperial people on our backs...
It really is a heavy burden.
m940002.ふたりとも、準備はできた？\nあっちは大変なことになってるらしいし、\n全力全開:
Are you two ready?
Things are getting pretty chaotic over there,
so I'm counting on you to give it your all!
m940002.ふっふっふ、もし辛かったら、\nわたくしが変わりにガツンとやってやりますわよ？:
Heh heh, if it gets too difficult,
I can always step in and give them a proper thrashing, you know?
m940002.ふふ、そうね。\nこれはまだ、こちらの作戦の範疇。:
Heh, I suppose so.
This is still within the scope of our strategy.
m940002.ふふ、大いに悩み給え、若人よ。\nどれだけ悩もうと、私たちが今できるのは、\nこ:
Heh, ponder well, young one.
No matter how long you agonize, all we can do right now
is keep watch over the sea.
m940002.ふふっ、ディアナ様ったら御冗談を。\nもう私の家に、かつての力はありませんから。:
Fufu, Lady Diana, what a joke.
My family no longer possesses the power it once had.
m940002.ふふっ、ノンノン♪ 何でもないよ！\nやっぱりマルレーンは、\nボクがいないとダ:
Hehe, no, no♪ It's nothing!
I was just thinking that Marleen really can't do anything without me, can she♪
m940002.ふふっ。\n確かに、王子にも似たところがありますよね。:
Heh.
Indeed, there are similarities to the Prince.
m940002.ふふふ、穴掘りと同時に補強もしちゃう、\n帝国式隧道掘削術のお披露目いかがで――:
Hehehe, drilling and reinforcing in one go,
how about a debut of Imperial-style tunnel excavation――
m940002.ふん、同族との戦いっていうなら、\n人間の方が得意分野だろう？:
Hmph, if it's fighting your own kind,
that's more your specialty, isn't it?
m940002.へ、陛下ぁっ！？\nいや、アタシはそんな器じゃないから……。:
H-His Majesty?!
N-No, I'm not cut out for that sort of thing…….
m940002.へ、陛下ッ！\nあいつは、化け物です……！:
Y-Your Majesty!
That thing is a monster…!
m940002.ほう……それが、お前の本当の顔か。\n皇帝ではない、戦士としての顔をしている。:
Hm…… So that is your true face.
Not the Emperor, but a warrior.
m940002.ほう……我が同胞の娘が来ていると聞いたがッ！\n見てみれば卑屈でみすぼらしい有様:
Hmph…… I heard one of my kin had come!
And look at you! Pathetic and wretched!
m940002.ほう、クロコ殿の口からそんな言葉が出るとはな。: Hm. To hear such words from you, Croco, is quite unexpected.
m940002.ほざけ、負け犬ごときに国家の何が分かる。\n人質を取られた程度で動けなくなる貴様:
Nonsense. What does a losing dog like you know of statecraft?
You, who can't even move because you've been held hostage—
m940002.ほほう、それはどうしてかな？: Ho ho, how intriguing. And why is that?
m940002.まぁ、そういう態度は嫌いではないけれど……。\nディアナ、兵たちに伝えておくとい:
Well, I don't mind that attitude, but…….
Diana, you should let the soldiers know.
The Netherworld Army seems to have unleashed monsters from the Netherworld.
m940002.まぁ、不安がっていても仕方がない。\n今は背後の街を守ることに集中しよう。\n美:
Well, worrying won't solve anything.
Let's focus on defending the town behind us.
For the sake of protecting the friendship of beautiful maidens!
m940002.まぁいいわ。私が直接戦場に出て、\n王子とやらを叩き潰せばいいだけよ。:
Well, it doesn't matter. I'll go out to the battlefield myself
and crush this so-called Prince.
m940002.まぁね、これは帝国が受け止めなければならない、\n帝国がなしてきた事の終着点なん:
Perhaps. This is the destination the Empire must face,
the culmination of everything the Empire has done.
The price for it all seems rather steep, though.
m940002.まぁまぁ、冥界にずっといたら大変なことになりますし、\n大規模兵員輸送の実現手段:
Well, well, staying in the Underworld forever would cause major issues,
and a means to achieve large-scale troop transport
is absolutely necessary.
m940002.ましてや、神のために数多の生贄を――: Especially not when it comes to offering countless sacrifices for a god――
m940002.まずいわね……。\nこちらの航空戦力は分散しているわ。\n一点突破で戦力を投入さ:
This is troublesome….
Our air forces are currently dispersed.
If they concentrate their forces for a single-point breakthrough—
m940002.まだ喚び出すの……！？\nはぁ、やるしかないわね……！:
Summoning more……!?
Haa, I suppose I have no choice……!
m940002.まだ遠方だからこそ少数に見えますが、\n実際にはあの集団ひとつひとつが、\n冥界:
They look few from this distance,
but in reality, each of those clusters is
an elite unit of the Netherworld Army……
m940002.まったく、あの男は……。\n為政者というものは、\nこういう時、責任を取るために:
Honestly, that man…
Rulers are supposed to be there
to take responsibility in times like this.
m940002.まったく、そのとおりです。\n亜神如きに遅れを取っているようでは、\n革命のし甲:
Quite right.
If we're falling behind lesser beings,
there's no point in even trying to stage a revolution.
m940002.まったく、そんなことだろうと思ったよ。\nマルレーンったら、軍に入ってから\n一:
Just as I thought.
Marleen hasn't come home once since she joined the army, you know.
m940002.まったく、戦う理由が分からないと言いながら、\n真っ先に敵陣に突っ込んでいくんだ:
I can't believe it. You say you don't understand why you fight,
yet you're the first one charging into the enemy lines.
m940002.まったくです。\nとはいえ、あの背中を見ているからこそ、\n兵たちが奮い立つとい:
Absolutely.
Even so, the fact that the soldiers are roused by seeing his back is also true.
m940002.む……おぉ、騎士殿か。\nなに、帝国軍に一泡吹かせてやろうかと思ってな。:
Hm…… Ah, the Knight.
I was just thinking of giving the Imperial Army a run for its money.
m940002.むしろ、実力主義などというその詭弁が、\n我ら白の王国貴族の誇りをどれほど貶めた:
On the contrary, that sophistry of "meritocracy"
has only served to demean the pride of the White Kingdom's nobility!
m940002.むしろあいつこそ、\n白の帝国のやり方にふさわしい人材だろう。: If anything, he is the kind of man who would be perfectly suited to the White Empire's methods.
m940002.むっ……あれは闇水晶かな……？\nリンクス嬢から感じる力が、\n急速に増大してい:
Hmph…… is that a Dark Crystal?……
The power radiating from Miss Lynx is
surging rapidly.
m940002.むっ……ハリンヘイムほどじゃ……。\nこほんっ。ともあれ、ここを野戦陣地としよう:
Hmph… Not as bad as Harinheim, though…
Ahem. In any case, let's set up a field base here.
It'll be difficult to fight a deranged demigod without a fortification.
m940002.むっ……童顔って言いたいのかー！？: Pff… Are you calling me baby-faced!?
m940002.むっ、それはそれで違うと思――いひゃいっ！？: Hmph, that's not the same thing at all, I th-think, eeeek!
m940002.むむ……ごまかされませんよ？\n――ともあれ、これでこの砦は大丈夫そうですね。:
Mmph… Don't think you can brush me off like that.
――In any case, this fortress should be safe now.
m940002.もう一発行くか？\nそれともすり潰されるのが好みか？\n可愛い顔にお化粧してやる: Want another one? Or do you prefer being crushed? I'll give your pretty face a little makeover. There!
m940002.もう一箇所の襲撃地点……。\nあちらも無事だと良いんだけど……。:
The other attack site…
I hope everyone over there is safe…
m940002.もっちろん、分かってるって。\nそれよりあの艦隊、沈められないかな？\n上陸前に:
Of course, I get it.
But more importantly, can't we sink that fleet?
If we take them out before they land, we can wipe them all out in one go.
m940002.もっと素直に言いな。\n「城門」を破壊されたら、戦士がなだれ込んでくるから、\n:
Just say it plainly.
If the "Main Gate" is destroyed, the warriors will pour in,
so please protect it.
m940002.もとより戦闘の発生を踏まえた部隊編成だ。\n王子の指揮があれば、突破も難しくはあ:
Our unit was originally formed with combat in mind.
With the Prince commanding, breaking through shouldn't be too difficult.
m940002.もはや、反乱軍に勝機はない。\n投降すれば極刑は免れるかもしれないぞ。:
The rebellion has no chance of victory now.
If you surrender, you might be spared the death penalty.
m940002.やっ、やめっ、いだだだだっ！？\n頬をひっぱるにゃっ！:
S-stop, stop, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts!
Stop pinching my cheeks, nya!
m940002.やはり来たか……。\nだが、展開が予想より早すぎる。\n敵の指揮官は分かるか？:
So they've come……
But this is moving faster than we anticipated.
Do we know who is leading them?
m940002.やめなさいッ！！\n女の子の顔を、何だと思ってるの！！: Stop it!! What do you think you're doing, hitting a girl in the face?!
m940002.やらしくありません！\n……あっ、さらに万全を期すなら、\n空からの戦力も考慮に:
It's not sneaky!
……Ah, and to be absolutely safe,
I'd also factor in air support.
m940002.やれやれ、しつこいな。\nさすがはベラート伯爵の兵か。:
Tsk, tsk, they're persistent.
I suppose that's what you'd expect from Count Belato's soldiers.
m940002.やれやれ、そういう気質は獣人ならではか。\nだが、決して引き際を見誤るな。\nま:
Oh well, that temperament is unique to the Beastkin, I suppose.
But never misjudge when to retreat.
First and foremost, prioritize learning the enemy in this initial engagement.
m940002.ようやく姿を見せたか……。\nいや、待て……なんだ、その姿は。:
So you finally show yourself….
No, wait… What is that form?
m940002.ようやく白の帝国と戦えるってのに、\nそこに水を差すなんざ、\n騎士とは名ばかり: Just when I was finally getting a chance to fight the White Empire, she had to ruin it. A knight? More like a bandit.
m940002.よかろう……。\n失う悲しみならば、我もよく理解できる。:
Very well…….
I understand all too well the grief of loss.
m940002.よかろう。\nダークエルフ、竜人の連合をもってなお、\n帝国の防備は万全であった:
Very well.
Even with the alliance of Dark Elves and Dragonkin,
the Empire's defenses were impenetrable.
m940002.よく吠えるッ！！\n貴様こそ、力に頼り、力に溺れた俗物だ！:
You bark loudly!!
You're the one who relies on and is drowned in power, you commoner!
m940002.よく耐えている。\nしかし、誰が守るための戦いなど言い伝えたのか……。:
You've held out well.
But who told you that war is something fought to protect others?
m940002.よく言うわ。\n陛下を殺すなら、今こそ好機だというのに。:
Easy for you to say.
This is the perfect opportunity to kill Her Majesty.
m940002.よし、ダークエルフたちの救出は完了した。\nミュレとフォーラの部隊に連絡しろ。\:
Good. The rescue of the Dark Elves is complete.
Notify Muret and Fora's units.
We'll blast open the passage behind us and fall back.
m940002.よし、陛下に知らせるぞ。\n悩むのは、全部終わらせてからにしよう！:
Very well, I'll alert His Highness.
We can worry about everything else once this is over!
m940002.よろしい。――でも、視野を狭くしないようにね。\nクロコはサンダードレイクを率い:
Very well. ――But do not narrow your focus.
Croco is leading the Thunder Drakes.
You must not underestimate the lightning strikes from the sky.
m940002.わざと、じゃないの？\nアスガルドに災禍をもたらすほどの魔力を、\n暴走させてで:
Was it on purpose?
You tried to defeat the Skeleton Emperor,
even at the cost of unleashing magic that could bring disaster to Asgard.
m940002.ん……だって身体が勝手に……。\nなんだか、戦わないといけない気がしたんだよね。:
Mm…… well, my body just……
I felt like I had to fight, you know.
m940002.ん……判断が早いのは大事なこと。\n戦略を練った上で、状況次第で\nそれをすぐに:
Mm… Quick judgment is important.
The ability to formulate a strategy,
and then discard it immediately depending on the situation, is the talent of a commander.
m940002.アスガルドに災禍をもたらすという予言。\nそれは、彼女という存在が、\nあまりに:
The prophecy of a calamity befalling Asgard…
It was born from the fact that she is
so close to death that it defines her very existence.
m940002.アダマス！ 貴様、肉体はどうした！\n何なのだ、その今にもかき消えそうな魔力は！:
Adamas! Where is your body!
What is that magic power that seems on the verge of vanishing?!
m940002.アンジェリーネ様、不用意なお言葉は……！: Your Ladyship, please refrain from such careless words…!
m940002.アンジェリーネ様があちらについた以上、\n白の王国を取り戻すのは、\nあなたの背:
Now that Lady Angéline has sided with the enemy,
reclaiming the White Kingdom
is a mission that rests on your shoulders……!
m940002.エレオノーラ様。\nということは、ハイドースは\n未だ全力を出すことができない、:
Your Highness.
Does that mean Hyades
is still unable to give his full power?
m940002.オリュンポスに座すあやつのように、\n兵を使い捨てる戦いは、長のするべきことでは:
Like that one who sits on Olympus,
a war where soldiers are treated as disposable
is not what a commander should do.
m940002.オレたちに、迷いはない。\n誓いも、後悔もない。\nさぁ、誉れ高き戦いに向かうぞ:
We have no hesitation.
No oaths, no regrets.
Now, let's head toward a glorious battle!!
m940002.オークが戦士としてあるために。: To stand as true warriors, the Orcs.
m940002.カッカッカ！\n良かろう、この老体の生命の輝き、\n腑抜けた地上の竜人に見せてや:
Ka ha ha ha!
Very well. Let me show these hollow-eyed Dragonkin on the surface
the radiance of this old body's life!
m940002.カテリナさん、これだけの広域に渡る戦闘です。\n普段とは射程の感覚が違うと思いま:
Katerina, this battle covers a wide area.
Your sense of range will likely differ from usual,
so please make sure to assess the situation carefully before acting.
m940002.ガオォォォォッ！\n時代のチャンピオン、王子に言付けを受けてなッ！:
Gaaooooo!
The Champion of the Age, the Prince, sent word!
m940002.クク……感情に振り回されぬその意志、気に入ったわ。\n此度の蘇りへの感謝として、:
Heh… I like your resolve, unswayed by emotion.
As thanks for this resurrection,
I shall refrain from prying into your true purpose.
m940002.クク……楽しいなァ。\nそうだろう、セグナンド。\n楽しめ、笑え、笑いながら死に:
Kuk… How delightful.
Isn't it, Segnand?
Enjoy it. Laugh. Die with a smile on your face.
m940002.ククッ……ハハハハハッ！！\n良い、最上級の答えだ、我が後継者よ。:
Kuk…… Hahahaha!!
Good. The finest answer, my successor.
m940002.グラティア！？ どうしてこんなところに！\nここは最前線ですよ！！\n非戦闘員は:
???: Gratia! What are you doing here?
This is the front line!
Non-combatants need to get behind the city walls—
m940002.コノ身も武を志し、大願を成就サセンとスル者。\n今は助力スルのみの立場ダガ、\n:
This one, too, aspires to martial prowess and the fulfillment of a great wish.
Though I can only offer my aid for now,
I believe I understand what drives you.
m940002.サザンカ、君は帝国に恭順した鬼の一族だろう？\nしかも今や、その族長という立場だ:
Sasanqua, you're from a clan of Oni who pledged allegiance to the Empire, right?
And on top of that, you're currently their chieftain.
m940002.サザンカ！ 下がれ！\nあぁもう、怪我してるんだから突っ込むな！:
Sasanqua! Fall back!
Oh, for heaven's sake, you're injured! Don't charge in there!
m940002.ジェニー、お前がそう分析したのなら、\nそこに嘘はなさそうだな。\n良いだろう、:
Jenny, if that's your analysis,

then I don't think she's lying.

Very well. Let's sit down at this negotiation table.
m940002.セグナンド……最後まで、戦士として生きたのですね。: Segnand…… you lived to the very end as a warrior.
m940002.セグナンド、オークロードを倒さねば、\n各地の解放は難しいかと……。:
Unless we defeat Segnand and the Orc Lord,
liberating the occupied territories will be difficult…….
m940002.セグナンドの戦法に振り回されるな。\n奴は神出鬼没に戦場を駆け、\nこちらの陣地:
Don't let Segundo's tactics throw you off.
He will likely strike like a ghost, racing across the battlefield
to seize our positions.
m940002.セグナンド様、それはいったいどういう……。: My Lord Segnand, what do you mean by…….
m940002.ダークエルフの誇りを、取り戻すために。: To reclaim the pride of the Dark Elves.
m940002.ティルトも素直になるまで、\nすごーく時間がかかったけどね。:
It took Tilt quite a long time
to learn to be straightforward, too.
m940002.ディアナ様、敵の采配が分かるのですか？: Lady Diana, you can read the enemy's strategy?
m940002.ハイドースの築いたこの封鎖結界を破るのは、\n冥神たるハイドースそのものに反旗を:
Breaking this sealing barrier that Haidos constructed
would be the same as raising a banner of rebellion against Haidos, the God of the Underworld, himself.
Even the Skeleton Emperor cannot do such a thing.
m940002.ハイドースめ、さすがは冥界の亜神か。\n戦士の心を滾らせる方法を熟知しているよう:
Hydos, you truly are a demigod of the underworld.
You know exactly how to stoke a warrior's spirit.
m940002.ハイドース様、冥界の力をお借りします。: Lord Hydos, I will borrow the power of the Netherworld.
m940002.ハイドース様に、\nオレを連れ戻すよう、言われたのだろう……？:
You were told by Haedus…
to bring me back, weren't you…?
m940002.ハイドース様に反逆するつもりか？\nまさか、冥界軍を乗っ取るつもりで――:
Do you intend to rebel against Lord Haidos?
Could it be that you plan to seize control of the Underworld army――
m940002.ハイドース様の力のひとかけらくらい、\n授かっていると考えた方がいいわね。\n例:
It's best to assume they have been granted
a fraction of Lord Hydros's power.
For instance……yes, black flames, perhaps?
m940002.ハイドース様の反魂の術……？\nいえ、そんな魔力は感じなかった。\nそれなのに、:
Lord Haidos's soul-summoning technique…?
No, I didn't sense any such magic.
And yet, this… this pressure from a soul—
m940002.ハイドース様の宿願、虐げられし友の悲願、\nそして我らが父祖の怒り！\nそれらを:
Lord Haidos's lifelong wish, the desperate hope of our oppressed allies,
and the fury of our ancestors!
To fulfill these, we must retreat for now!
m940002.ハイドース様の無念、宿怨も、\n此度の戦にて晴らすことができるでしょう。:
Your resentment, Hydos, and the grudge you've carried,
can surely be settled in this battle.
m940002.ハイドース様は、全軍に冥界への撤退を命じた。\n……命を捨てる必要はない。\nこ:
??? : Lord Hydos has ordered a full retreat to the Underworld.
……There is no need to throw your life away.
This is a battle to reclaim your pride, isn't it?
m940002.ハイドース様は今、ある儀式を進めている。\nそれゆえに、冥界の勢力はそれぞれが、:
Lord Haidos is currently performing a certain ritual.

Because of that, the Underworld factions were each

preparing their forces.
m940002.ハイドース殿、貴殿は貴殿なりの、\n正義の為に剣を取ったのじゃろう？: Lord Hydos, you took up your sword for your own brand of justice, I presume?
m940002.ハッ……ハハッ、笑えッ！\n貴様ら、王の命令だ！ 笑えッ！！:
Hah… Hahaha! Laugh, you fools!
It's the King's command! Laugh!!
m940002.ハッ、別れが台無しだぞ、親父。\nそういう冗談は、オレが死んだ時、冥界で聞かせて:
Hah, you're ruining the farewell, Dad.
Save jokes like that for when I die, in the underworld.
m940002.ハハッ、亜神の戯言だ。\nあの男といい、リンクスといい、どうにも、\n我の言葉を:
Haha. The ramblings of a Sub-God, then.
Whether it is that man or you, Lynx,
it seems few are willing to take my words at face value.
m940002.ハハハッ、分かっていても、\n兵の前では同意しない程度の気概はあるか。:
Hahaha, even if you know the truth,
you at least have the spirit to refuse to acknowledge it before your troops.
m940002.ハハハッ！ 白の王国兵は大したものだな。\n次から次へと、この戦いに馳せ参じたい:
Hahaha! The soldiers of the White Kingdom are something else.
One after another, they rush to join this battle.
m940002.ハリンヘイムは、本音を隠すのが下手。: Harinheim, you're terrible at hiding what you really think.
m940002.ハルモニア、しっかりして。\n――あぁ、もう！\nほら、全然会話する気ないの分か:
Harmonia, pull yourself together.
――Ah, forget it!
See, it's obvious he has no intention of talking, right!
m940002.ハーピーとの戦いには、遠隔攻撃が必要でしょう。\n山頂を確保できれば、\n広い射:
Fighting Harpies will require ranged attacks.
If we can secure the mountaintop,
we might be able to gain a long range of fire.
m940002.バチバチ光ってる、竜人……？ も、\n飛空船と同時に接近中です！:
It's crackling with energy… a Dragonkin? I…
It's closing in at the same time as the flying ship!
m940002.パラベルは鼻がいい。\nさっきの斥候たちを見れば分かるよ。\nこの先に待っている:
Paravel has a good nose.
Just look at those scouts from earlier.
Whatever is waiting ahead is something humans shouldn't encounter.
m940002.フッ……たわ言を。\nまだ勝負はついてはおりませんからな。:
Hmph… Nonsense.
The battle is far from over.
m940002.フッ……名誉より、友か。\nしかしまさか、王国軍本隊を出すとはな。\n……恩に着:
Huff…… Friendship over honor, I see.
But I never imagined you'd send the Kingdom's main force.
……I owe you one, comrade in arms.
m940002.フフッ、戦争とは数と配置でするものさ。\n数だけ多くても、\nそれを配する場所が:
Heh, war is a matter of numbers and positioning.
Having more troops is meaningless
if you don't have a place to deploy them.
m940002.フフッ、陛下を斬り殺そうとした女傑は言うことが違う。\nさて、それじゃあ戦闘準備:
Heh, the woman who tried to behead the Emperor says that.
Now then, let us begin our battle preparations.
m940002.ヘカティエ……？\nああ、また暴走してしまったのですね……。:
Hecatie……?
Ah, I lost control again, didn't I……
m940002.ヘカティエ様に捨てられたと思っているのだろう？\nその腹いせに戦争に出るとは、\:
You think you've been cast aside by Lady Hecatie, don't you?
Going to war to vent that frustration is
the very definition of self-destruction.
m940002.ヘカティエ！ あんたも怒りなさい！\nあなたの騎士なんでしょ！？: Hecatie! Get angry! She's your knight, isn't she?!
m940002.ヘリューズ、ようやく正気に戻ったようね。\n守る者がいるとはいえ、\n死の蔓延す:
Heleus, it seems you've finally come to your senses.
Even with someone to protect you,
going out to the frontline where death spreads is reckless.
m940002.ヘリューズが築いたものかもしれないわね。\nひとりぼっちの居場所を守ろうとしたの:
It might have been built by Helyus.
Was she trying to protect a place where she could be alone,
or did she have some other purpose…?
