m940002.ヘリューズって、\nあの昔話の、反逆者ヘリューズですか！？:
Helyus?
That's the Helyus from the old tales, the rebel!
m940002.ヘリューズ様！ 私だ！\nセグナンドが娘、イルヴィだ！:
Heleus-sama! It's me!
I'm Irvit, Segnand's daughter!
m940002.ベラート伯爵、見れば分かるぞ。\nこの攻勢のために、領地の戦力の殆どを割いたな。:
Count Belart, it's obvious.
You've committed nearly all of your territory's forces to this offensive.
m940002.ベラート伯爵は、\nもとより手段を選ばない方でしたからね。\nこれより先は……。:
Count Belart has never been one to limit his methods.
From here on…….
m940002.ベラート伯爵は、この地で皇帝陛下と王子殿下を、\n一度に仕留めるつもりでいるので:
Count Belato intends to take out His Majesty the Emperor and Your Highness in one stroke.
That would explain why he brought such a massive force.
m940002.マルゴット、兵たちに交代で休息を。\nそれからあなたも、しばらく休んでおきなさい:
Margot, have the troops take rotating rest.
And you, get some rest as well.
m940002.マルゴット、彼らの戦い方を見ておきなさい。\nきっといつか、あなたの剣に役立つは:
Margot, observe how they fight.
It will surely be useful for your sword one day.
m940002.マルゴットはこういう状況慣れてるだろうけど、\n私は最前線向きじゃな――んっ？\:
I know Margot is used to situations like this,
but I'm not really cut out for the front line— Huh?
Ah! Oh no!! Just as I was thinking about it!!
m940002.マルゴットー！\nやった！ やっと睡眠時間だー！\nカテリナさんの頭脳は睡眠を求:
Margot!
Yes! Finally, sleep time!
Katerina's brain is demanding sleep… zzz…
m940002.マルレーン、工兵隊への伝令を任せる。\n戦場は広域だ。\n攻撃の届く範囲は限られ:
Marleen, you are in charge of signaling the engineers.
The battlefield is wide.
Our range of fire is limited. Do not misjudge your effective range.
m940002.マルレーンはどっちかっていうと、\n美しいっていうより、かわいいの方じゃない？:
Marleen is more on the cute side,
rather than beautiful, don't you think?
m940002.マルレーンは落ち着き過ぎだよ！\n街の外には伯爵の軍勢がいるのに！:
You're way too calm, Marleen!
The Earl's army is right outside the city!
m940002.マレブランケ副団長ですね？\nお怪我はありませんかー？:
You must be Vice-Commander Malebranche?
Are you hurt?
m940002.ミュレ！ 重機どけて！！\n飛空戦艦突入するから！！:
Muret! Move the heavy machinery!
The flying battleship is coming in!!
m940002.メリュジアナよ……忘れたというのか……？\n虐げられ、地下に追いやられた竜人の嘆:
Meliusiana… have you forgotten?
The Dragonkin's anguish, their rage, as they were oppressed and driven underground!
m940002.ラビリス……？\n人の王でありながら、\n亜神となったというあのラビリスですか！: Labrys…? The one who was the King of Men and became a demi-god?
m940002.リンクス、また無茶を……。\n王子様、どうかあの子を止めるために、\n力を貸して:
Lynx, don't be reckless…….
Prince, please lend me your strength
to stop her!
m940002.リンクスよ、お前もまた、\n我が手を差し伸べるべきちびっこであったか……。:
Lynx, you too were
one of the little ones I should have reached out to……
m940002.リンクスよ、これは我が高慢である。\n我が民すべてに強くあれという、我儘ですらあ:
Lynx, this is my arrogance.
It is even a selfish demand that all my people be strong.
m940002.リンクス！\n……どうして、あなたも、分かっているはずなのに。:
Lynx!
…Why do you… when you know the truth, too.
m940002.ルインは自動人形ですから、いつでも健康です。\n――儀式の方は順調ですか？:
I am an automaton, so I am always in perfect health.
—Is the ritual proceeding smoothly?
m940002.ルーテ、あなたの家もそのひとつでしたね。\n……あちらに付きますか？:
Rute, your family was one of them, wasn't it?
……Are you siding with them?
m940002.レオナ、前線に出るぞ。\n敵の策に乗るのは気に入らないが。:
Leona, we're heading to the front.
I loathe falling for their tricks, but there's no choice.
m940002.レオナ、部隊長を集めろ。\n王国軍との連携を踏まえた軍議を開く。:
Leona, gather the unit commanders.
We need to hold a war council
to coordinate with the Kingdom's army.
m940002.レオナちゃん、あんまり顔色、良くないわよ？: Leona-chan, you look a bit pale.
m940002.レーネったら、自分の故郷を僻地とか言わない！\nそれに視察じゃなくて、\n対冥界:
???: Lehne would never call her own hometown a backwater!
Besides, it's not an inspection,
it's a joint exercise assuming a Netherworld army attack.
m940002.レーネ！？ 逃げてって言ったのに……！: Lehne!? I told you to run!
m940002.ワシだけではないぞ。\nもう一度戦えると聞いてな、\n居ても立っても居られぬ馬鹿:
It's not just me.
Hearing that we could fight once more,
I brought along some fools who couldn't sit still.
m940002.一度は帝国に服従し、\nされど怒りを忘れぬ暗がりの民よ、\n種族の誇り、父祖の名:
People of the dark, who once bowed to the Empire
but never forgot their fury,
it is time to take up your swords for the pride of your race
and the honor of your ancestors.
m940002.三代目、白の皇帝――骸帝か。\nそれでお前たちは、この封鎖階層に逃げ込んだんだな:
The Third Emperor of the White—the Skeleton Emperor, is it?
So that's why you fled into this sealed layer.
m940002.三代目、骸帝と言えば血なまぐさい逸話と共に、\n版図を拡大した帝国の英雄でもあり:
The Third, known as the Skeleton Emperor, is a hero of the Empire
who expanded its borders alongside tales of bloody deeds.
…Especially in the eyes of the Imperial nobility.
m940002.上層部は確信があって進軍しているみたいだけど、\n冥界にそんな簡単に行ける方法が:
The high command seems confident about this march, but if there were an easy way to reach the Underworld,
I'm sure I'd have heard a rumor about it by now.
m940002.上等です。\n竜との絆ならば王国の騎兵とて負けません。\n王子、進行経路に警戒を:
Very well.
When it comes to the bond with dragons, the Kingdom's cavalry is no slouch either.
Prince, watch the advance route! Let's meet them head-on!
m940002.上等！ 乙女の怒り、ぶちかましてやらなくちゃ！: Excellent! I must unleash the fury of a maiden upon him!
m940002.不器用な男め。\n――だが、今は我らがいる。\n手を取り合う、戦友がいるではない:
You clumsy man.
――But for now, we are here.
You have comrades-in-arms to stand beside you.
m940002.不要……だ……。\n我が名は……部族の若き戦士たちが……受け継ぐ……。:
No need… for it…
My name… is meant to be… carried on by… the young warriors of the tribe…
m940002.世界の為に祖国を犠牲とするか、\n故国の為に、世界を危険にさらすのか……。\nそ:
Sacrifice the homeland for the world,
or endanger the world for the homeland……
Even so, we cannot abandon our homeland.
m940002.中々剛毅な名言ですね……。\nですが、確かに何でもできる気がしてきました。:
Quite the stirring words…….
But you're right, I do feel like I can do anything now.
m940002.久しいナ、ハルモニア。\n王国に身ヲ寄せたと聞いテいたガ、達者でなによりダ。:
It has been a long time, Harmonia.
I had heard you had taken refuge in the Kingdom. It is good to see you well.
m940002.事実だろう。\nそれゆえに、こんな人質を取られただけで、\nその剣を振るえなくな:
It is the truth.
That is why you cannot even swing your sword,
now that you have been held hostage like this.
m940002.事実ですわ。\nここにいる幹部は全員、それを受け止めなさい。:
It is a fact.
Every officer present here must accept that reality.
m940002.亜神がその権能を振るうことまで、\n戦闘教義に記されてはいないだろうからな。:
Their combat doctrines surely do not account
for a Sub-God wielding his full authority.
m940002.亜神の身をもってしても、\nこの日を随分と待ちわびたぞ、女神アダマスよ。:
Even with the body of a demigod,
I have waited long for this day, Goddess Adamas.
m940002.亜神の魔力如き、斬り裂いて見せろ！\n女神の神器、その真価を――ッ！！:
Shatter the power of a Lesser God!
Show the true worth of the Goddess's divine artifact――!!
m940002.亜神ヘリューズ、\nダークエルフたちの居場所へ案内してくれ。:
Lesser God Heleus,
guide us to the Dark Elves' dwelling.
m940002.亜神ヘリューズ、言葉は届いているか。: Demigod Heleus, can you hear me?
m940002.亜神ヘリューズと、亜神ハイドースが紡いだ、\n結界をぶち抜くなんて、可能なのかな:
Puncturing the barrier woven by the Sub-God Heleus and the Sub-God Hydos…
Is that even possible…?
m940002.交渉とは、剣を向けあったままでは出来ないものです。\n今はこの戦闘を終わらせ、交:
Negotiations cannot be conducted while swords are drawn.
For now, let us end this battle and consider how to drag them to the negotiating table.
m940002.交渉は言葉と知略で進めるもの。\n私が剣を抜くときは交渉ではなく、\n私の敵を斬:
Negotiations are advanced through words and strategy.
I only draw my sword when it is not a negotiation,
but when I am cutting down my enemies——I have not changed at all.
m940002.人とは、美しくも愚かなものだな。\n短いその生を、誇りと使命、愛と愚行で\n火花:
Humans are beautiful, yet foolish creatures.
You burn through your brief lives like sparks,
consumed by pride, duty, love, and folly.
m940002.人の力とやら、見せてみよ。\n我が黒炎に抗ってみせるがいい！:
Show me this "power of man."
Defy my Black Flame!
m940002.人の子らよ、志を同じくする友たちよ、\n大切な者を失う悲しみは、我もよく分かる。:
Children of man, my friends who share my cause,
I understand well the sorrow of losing those you hold dear.
m940002.人は脆い……どこまでも強くなることはできても、\n脆さだけは克服することができな:
Humans are fragile… no matter how strong they become,
there is a fragility they can never overcome.
m940002.人より強き者がいくらでもいる世界。\nだからこそ、人は己の持つ最大の強みを\nこ:
In a world where beings far stronger than humans exist…
That is precisely why humans have relentlessly honed their greatest strengths, pushing them beyond all limits.
m940002.今こそ、祖国の危機だと、\nそう仰ったのはあなたではありませんか。: It was you who said, just moments ago, that our homeland is in peril!
m940002.今代の帝国軍が我が首を狙いにかけつけるまで、\nここに留まり、待つことを誓おう。:
I swear to stay here and wait
until the current imperial army comes to claim my head.
m940002.今回の合同演習は雪上訓練のためだったけど、\nやっぱり雪道はうまく進めないな。\:
This joint exercise was supposed to be snow training, but
it's still hard to make progress on the snowy roads.
Our marching speed is probably only half of what it usually is, isn't it?
m940002.今回の戦いに限って、ですけどね。\n最終的には、亜神ハイドース本人と\n決着をつ:
At least for this battle.
In the end, there is no choice but to settle things
with the Lesser God Hyades himself.
m940002.今日もお美しいなと言いました！: I said you look beautiful today!
m940002.仕えるべき相手ヲ見誤るナ。\n王子ヨ、ハルモニアたちを任せタぞ。:
Do not mistake who you should be serving.
Prince, I am leaving Harmonia and the others in your care.
m940002.仕方あるまい。\n艦隊は別の襲撃地点に急行中だ。:
There's nothing we can do about it.
The fleet is already rushing to the other attack site.
m940002.他の戦士たちに伝令を。\n帝国軍は山岳地帯を抜けた。\nこの先の古戦場を、白の皇:
Send word to the other warriors.
The Imperial army has broken through the mountain pass.
We will make the old battlefield ahead
the resting place of the White Emperor.
m940002.伝令が無事にたどり着いていれば、\nそろそろ援軍がやってくる頃です。\nもう少し:
If the messenger arrived safely,
reinforcements should be arriving soon.
Let's hold out with our current forces for a little longer.
m940002.伝令ご苦労。\nいいか貴様ら、敵は籠城戦ではなく、\n正面からの戦いを望んでいる:
Well done, messenger.
Listen up, you lot. It seems the enemy doesn't want a siege...
they want a head-on battle!
m940002.伝説上のオーク勇者に、\n完璧なタイミングでのオークロードの出陣……。\nいずれ:
The legendary Orc Hero, and the Orc Lord's timely deployment...
Both are the work of someone who knows war well.
m940002.伯爵、それはなりません。\n国とは治める者がいなければ破綻するのです。:
My Lord, you must not do that.
A nation collapses if it has no one to rule it.
m940002.何か悪いものでも食べたんだろう。\nマレブランケにはよくあることだとも。:
You must have eaten something bad.
It's a common occurrence with Malebranche.
m940002.何か言ったっ！？\n今っ、あたしっ、ちょっと止まれなくて！！:
Did you say something?!
I, I just couldn't stop myself for a second!
m940002.何があった！\n――骸帝と、遭遇したのか？:
What happened!
—Did you encounter the Skeleton Emperor?
m940002.何が民のためだ、何が世界の平定だ。\n貴様が見ているものは、そんなものではないだ:
What "for the people"? What "pacification of the world"?
That's not what you're really after, is it!
m940002.何が言いたいのか、手に取るように分かるぞ、ハリナ。\n白の帝国が、奴と同じ狂犬だ: I know exactly what you're trying to say, Halina. You're saying the White Empire is just as rabid as him.
m940002.何しろ、合同演習の真っ只中だったからな。\nマルレーン、艦影の詳細は？:
We were in the middle of a joint exercise, after all.
Marleen, what are the details on the ships?
m940002.何しろ冥界とは、死した者の魂が行く場所だ。\n死ねば誰でも冥界へ行けるのだよ。:
After all, the Underworld is where the souls of the dead go.
Anyone who dies can reach the Underworld.
m940002.何だ、心当たりがあるのかお嬢さん？: What, do you know something, young lady?
m940002.何よ、まるでこのまま進まないって\n予想してるような言いぶりじゃない。:
What's that? You sound like you're expecting
this to stall out indefinitely.
m940002.何をいまさら！\n退廃の限りをつくし、享楽の夜を味わい、\n祖国の危機には剣を取:
What are you saying!
Indulge in decadence, savor the nights of pleasure,
and draw your sword when your homeland is in crisis! That is what it means to be a noble!
m940002.何をぉ！？ 寝言が激しいのはレーネの方だし！: W-What?! You're the one who talks in your sleep!
m940002.例えばこの港街なら……。\n海上からの強襲と、森からの挟撃でしょうか。:
For example, for this port town……
A naval assault from the sea, and a pincer attack from the forest, perhaps.
m940002.信じよう。\nイルヴィを匿ってくれた、それが十分すぎる証拠だ。:
I'll believe you.
The fact that you sheltered Irvit is proof enough.
m940002.俺たちには、守るべき者がいる。\n新たに、共に歩む道を模索しはじめた、\nダーク:
We have people we must protect.
We cannot allow the Dark Elves, who have just begun
to seek a new path to walk together with us, to be killed.
m940002.俺たちの選んだ道が、今になって、\nようやく牙を剥いてきただけのことだ。:
The path we chose has finally
shown its fangs.
m940002.個ではなく、軍として動くオーク……。\nこれは一筋縄ではいかないようですね。:
Orcs moving as an army, rather than as individuals...
This doesn't look like it's going to be easy.
m940002.傷つくほどに、力が増している……。\nあれが、オークロードの力？:
He's getting stronger with every injury…
Is that the power of the Orc Lord?
m940002.傷を塞ぐことはできても、\n亜神の膨大な魔力を浴びたその魂は、\n大きく傷つき、:
We can close his wounds,
but his soul, which was exposed to the Lesser God's immense magical power,
is deeply wounded and still wanders between life and death.
m940002.先を急ぐとしよう。\nそんな頭の悪いお人好し、\n長く苦しませるのは酷だろう？:
Let's press on.
That foolish, good-hearted fool…
It would be cruel to let her suffer for long.
--- scene: Sixth Formation: Fortress of the Land of the Dead (battle, start) ---
m940002.先日の手合わせで感じた。\n騎士殿の迷いが、剣筋に出ていたからな。:
I felt it in our recent sparring match.
Your hesitation showed in the line of your blade.
m940002.先王の忘れ形見たる、アンジェリーネ様に\n剣を向けることだけが唯一の心残りですと:
The only regret I have is that I must turn my blade
toward you, Lady Angeline, the living memory of the late king.
m940002.先頭にいる獣人の子が、\nリエーフの言っていたリンクス嬢かな？:
The Beastkin at the front——
is that Miss Lynx that Rieuf mentioned?
m940002.全ての者の、死の痛みが分かってしまうから、\nせめて楽に殺してあげようと、\nあ:
Because she understands the pain of death that everyone endures,
she thinks she should make it easier for them.
She's simply too kind.
m940002.全員まとめて冥界送り、\n死後は仲良くオレと喧嘩と行こうぜ？:
I'll send you all to the underworld in one go.
After that, we can have a nice little squabble in the afterlife, eh?
m940002.兵を退け、これだけ時間を稼げば、\n俺たちの目的は達成された。:
Fall back, troops. We've bought enough time.
Our objective has been achieved.
m940002.兵を退け、これ以上の損耗は避けよ。\n此度の戦、我らの敗北だ。:
Fall back. We must avoid further losses.
This battle was our defeat.
m940002.冥界に至った後、お前の話を聞いてみたいものだ。\n守るべきものを守るために、\n:
I look forward to hearing your story once you reach the Netherworld.
Offer up the light of your life
to protect what you hold dear.
m940002.冥界の、魔物ですか？\nなにやら、斬ればすむ相手ではないような口ぶりですが。:
Monsters from the Netherworld?
It sounds like they won't be so easily cut down.
m940002.冥界の亜神、ハイドース……。\nアノ者が信用に足るトハ思えナイガ、\nさりとて、:
The Lesser Deity of the Underworld, Hades…….
I cannot say I place my trust in that being,
but it seems he did fulfill the Great Elder's wish, after all…….
m940002.冥界の亜神、ハイドースと、\n本当に同じ道を歩んでいると思っているのですか……？:
Do you truly believe you are walking the same path
as the Lesser God of the Underworld, Hyades?
Don't you think you're just being used?
m940002.冥界の管理者は、その領分を侵してはならない。\n冥界とは、秩序によって成り立たね:
The administrator of the Underworld must not overstep their authority.
The Underworld must stand on the foundation of order.
And that order does not include the peace of the dead, you know?
m940002.冥界の門とは言えど、\n門の形を取っているわけではなく、\n一種の座標のようなも:
I mean, the Gate of the Underworld
is not actually shaped like a gate,
but is merely a kind of coordinate, is it not?
m940002.冥界の魔物は、その身に黒炎を宿しているの。\n倒したとしても、黒炎が戦場全体を焼:
Netherworld monsters harbor black flames within their bodies.
Even if you defeat them, the black flames will continue to burn across the entire battlefield.
m940002.冥界第二層、通称ヘルヘイムは、\n天界を追放された亜神、ヘリューズのために、\n:
The Second Layer of the Underworld, known as Harinheim,
was a small territory ceded to Helyus,
a demigod exiled from the Heavens.
m940002.冥界軍、撤退していきます。\n陛下、我々の勝利です。:
The Netherworld army is retreating.
Your Majesty, this is our victory.
m940002.分かってはいたけれど、\n内通者がいる、ということねぇ。:
I suspected it, but
so there really is a traitor among us.
m940002.分かりきったことを……。\n貴様は、あの腑抜けきった当代の皇帝を見たか？:
Such an obvious fact…….
Have you seen the current, spineless Emperor?
m940002.初めて剣を交えたが……。\nなるほど、これが英雄王の系譜……。:
To cross swords with you for the first time……
I see. So this is the lineage of the Hero King……
m940002.別れの時を邪魔するつもりはない。\n大切な者に、最期の言葉を告げてくるがいい。:
I have no intention of interrupting your farewell.
Go and speak your last words to those you cherish.
m940002.利権を取り戻すためなら、の間違いじゃないかしらぁ？: I think you mean "to reclaim your corrupt privileges," don't you?
m940002.利権を求めて何が悪いッ！\n民は耕し、作り、貴族は貪り、領土を守るために戦う！\:
What's wrong with seeking privileges?!
The commoners till the soil and build, while the nobles consume and fight to defend the territory!
What's the problem with that?!
m940002.前例もありますし？\n帝国製の掘削機械は、冥界の大地すら\nゴリッゴリのギュルル:
There is precedent, isn't there?
Empire-made excavation machinery can grind through the Underworld's earth
with a solid *grrr-grrr-grrr*!
m940002.前線に伝達！\n敵は飛空船から降下してくるわ！\nその前に飛空船の護衛と、本体を:
Transmit to the front lines!
The enemy will descend from the flying ship!
Before that happens, strike down the escorts and the main vessel!
m940002.剣を取れ、ダークエルフたちよ！\n父祖の誇りを！ 我らの怒りを！\n帝国に突き立:
Take up your swords, Dark Elves!
For the pride of our ancestors! For our rage!
Drive it deep into the Empire!!
m940002.剣を取れ！ 守るべき者を思え！\n故郷は貴公らの背後にあるのだから！:
Take up your swords! Think of those you must protect!
For your homeland lies behind you!
m940002.割譲……？\nいや待て、そう簡単に国土を切り分けていいのか？:
Ceded……?
Wait, can we just carve up our own land so easily?
m940002.力で抑えつけるべき者どもに反逆され、\n一国ではそれを鎮圧することもできず、\n:
Betrayed by those who should be crushed by force,
unable to quell the rebellion even within a single nation,
and now cozying up to the descendants of the Hero King.
m940002.力は増しているけど、\n少しずつ、生命力が失われていっているわ。:
Their strength is growing,
but they are slowly losing their life force.
m940002.勝利は掴みましたが……。\n状況はむしろ悪化しているのではないでしょうか。:
We have secured a victory, but…….
Doesn't the situation seem to be worsening instead?
m940002.匿って……？\nいったいどういうことだ。\nまさか冥界の勢力同士で内乱でも起きた:
Sheltered…?

What does that mean?

Has a civil war broken out among the Underworld factions?
m940002.卑怯だぞ！ 戻ってこいクロコー！！: You coward! Come back here, Croco!!
m940002.原因は分かりませんが、そう考えれば納得できます。\n同時に、この戦いにも光明が見:
I do not know the cause, but that explanation makes sense.
At the same time, it gives us a glimmer of hope in this battle.
m940002.反撃の時は来た。\nこの戦いこそ、最初に灯される正義の炎だ。:
The time for counterattack has come.
This battle is the first flame of justice to be lit.
m940002.取りこぼしてきたもの、諦めていたものを、\nもう一度取り戻すため――我らに勝利を:
To reclaim what we have lost, and what we had given up on—
grant us victory.
m940002.古い構えです。\n今では誰も使わない、基礎教練で学ぶだけの。:
It's an ancient stance.
One that no one uses anymore, taught only in basic training.
m940002.古代龍とて然り、おぬしらの祖たる竜神とてまた然り。\n敵として会うてしまったなら:
The Ancient Dragon is no exception, nor is the Dragon God who is your ancestor.
If you meet them as enemies,
then simply guide them to their end.
m940002.古代龍は我ラの怒りヲ受け入れなかっタ。\n黄金竜ナド、タダの飾りに過ぎヌ。:
The Ancient Dragon refused to accept our rage.
The Golden Dragon is nothing but a mere ornament.
m940002.可愛いメリュジアナよ、\nわしを殺した娘のこと、恨むでないぞ……。\nあの場は戦:
My dear Meliusiana,
do not harbor resentment toward the daughter who killed me……
It was a battlefield, and I am the one at fault
for forgetting that.
m940002.各地の占拠、わざと即応させる配置……。\n……って、陛下、もしかして！\n危ない:
Occupying various locations, forcing us to respond rapidly…….
……Wait, Your Majesty, could it be!
The real danger isn't the front lines, but rather――
m940002.名が残る限り……我が名誉と武勲は……くっ……。\n未来を生きる、戦士が、受け継…:
As long as the name endures… my honor and my deeds… khh…
will be inherited by the warriors… who live in the future…
m940002.否、リンクスよ、我は己の為に戦うのではない。\n確かに個人的な恨みはあれど、\n:
No, Lynx. I do not fight for myself.
I may hold a personal grudge,
but if I let such emotions sway me, victory is impossible.
m940002.否、国家とは皇帝の所有物である。\n――違うというのならば、\n次に相まみえる時:
No. A nation is the property of its emperor.
—if you disagree,
prove it with your strength the next time we meet.
m940002.否定はしねぇよ！\n亜神ってのはなァ、そう簡単に己を変えられねぇんだ！:
I won't deny it!
You see, a demi-god isn't so easily changed!
m940002.吸収される前に黒炎を散らせばいい話だ。\n亜神に後れを取るな！\n白の帝国、その:
We just need to scatter the Black Flame before it gets absorbed.
Don't let the demigod get the upper hand!
White Empire, show them your true strength!
m940002.吼えよ黒炎、穢れし者どもを焼き尽くせッ！！: Roar, black flame! Burn these defiled wretches to ashes!!
m940002.味方になれと誘われはしましたが、\n兵を捨てる思想は、どうにも気に入らず。:
???: I was invited to join their side,
but I could never stomach the idea of abandoning one's troops.
m940002.命がけで冥界を抜けて、助けを求めに来た後なんだ。\n家族との再会も、一層嬉しくな:
Well, after risking your life to cross the Underworld for help,
it's only natural that reuniting with family feels even sweeter.
m940002.命令です、教導隊長。\nあれだけの艦隊を惜しみなく出してきた以上、\n敵の攻勢も:
It is an order, Drill Sergeant.
Given that they spared no expense with that fleet,
the enemy's offensive will likely culminate in the next wave.
m940002.問題ない。\nこういう時のために、わざわざ準備をさせたんだ。:
No problem.
I had preparations made specifically for a situation like this.
m940002.問題なしっ！！\n城壁がないなら立ち塞がればいいんだよ！\nアタシオンステージだ:
No problem!!
If there's no wall, we just stand in their way!
It's my stage, baby!!
m940002.国のために？ 種族のために？\nあるいは鬼らしく名誉のためかな？:
For your country? For your race?
Or perhaps for honor, as befits an Oni?
m940002.国の歴史とはそういったものでしょうとも。\n悩むより、まずは目の前の獣人と、\n:
That is the nature of a nation's history.
Rather than worrying, we must first strike down
the Beastkin and Netherworld units before us.
m940002.国民も黙っていないだろう！\nその地に住まうものだって――:
The people won't stand for it!
And those who live there――
m940002.土産話のひとつやふたつ、持っていかないと、\n胸を張って凱旋はできないだろうな。:
If I don't bring back a story or two,
I won't be able to return in triumph with my head held high.
m940002.地下坑道、貫通！ 地上ダ！\n地上ニ出るゾ！ 総員戦闘用意ッ！！:
Tunnel breached! We're on the surface!
Breaking through! All units, prepare for combat!!
m940002.地面の下って、まさか……。\n皆、足元に注意して！:
Underground? No way…
Everyone, watch your footing!
m940002.城壁が……一撃で砕け散っただと……？\nまずい、敵が来るぞ！ 守りを固めろ！！:
The wall... shattered in a single blow...?
This is bad, the enemy is here! Reinforce the defenses!!
m940002.城門なんざワシらの敵じゃないぞ。\nここはひとつ、城壁に穴あけてやらァッ！！:
A castle gate is no match for us.
Now then, we'll punch a hole right through the wall!!
m940002.報告は事実だけを、端的に。\nともあれ、状況は把握しましたわ。:
Report the facts only, concisely.
In any case, I've grasped the situation.
m940002.大長老よ、我らの意見があうことは、決してあるまい。\nしかし、この戦においてのみ:
Grand Elder, our opinions will never align.
However, in this battle alone,
we may share the same destination.
m940002.失敗したって死にはしない、\n成功すれば一生誇れる！\nそう思えばなんだって頑張:
Failing won't kill me,
and if I succeed, I'll have something to be proud of for the rest of my life!
Once you think of it that way, you can push through anything!
m940002.失礼ねぇ。\n現陛下は亜神とすら斬り結ぶお人よ？:
How rude.
The current Emperor is one who can duel even a Sub-God, you know?
m940002.奇襲を受けたから負けた、卑怯な手段で負けた、\nそんな言い訳も出来ぬよう、\n万:
He intends to crush a fully prepared Imperial army,
so they cannot claim they lost to an ambush
or to any underhanded tactics.
m940002.奪ったのは我々の先祖だ。\nつまりこれは、帝国が解決すべき問題といえる。:
It was our ancestors who took it.
So this is a problem the Empire must resolve.
m940002.女神アイギスの加護か、あるいは――\nいや、考えるのは後にしよう。:
Is it the blessing of the Goddess Aigis, or perhaps—
No, I'll think about that later.
m940002.女神ケラウノスの――否、\n神であっタ頃の、ディアスの雷カ。:
The thunder of the goddess Keraunos――no,
the thunder of Zeus, when he was still a god.
m940002.如何に亜神と言えど、自由に蘇らせられるはずがない。\n無尽蔵に召喚できるなら、\:
Even for a demigod, they can't just resurrect anyone they please.
If they could summon them endlessly,
the material world would be overflowing with the dead by now.
m940002.姉も父も、深く物事を考えられる頭と、\nあまり考えないで\n直感で突撃する精神性:
Both my sister and my father have heads capable of deep thought,
but also a mentality that ignores all thought
and charges on pure instinct…
m940002.嬉しいんだろうね。\n身内だからと遠慮することなく、\n全力で殺しにかかってくれ:
They're probably pleased.
That the current Imperial Army, without holding back
out of familial ties, attacks them with full force.
m940002.子孫のために、助太刀しにきてくれた、\n……って雰囲気じゃなさそうだね。:
Coming to lend a hand to your descendants…
…doesn't seem to be the vibe here, does it?
m940002.安寧ってのはな、法に従わせることで生まれるんだよ。\n魂の管理を投げ出した亜神ヘ:
Peace is born from obedience to the law.
Hecatie, the demi-god who abandoned the management of souls,
and Tilt, the knight who committed blasphemy in my domain!
m940002.実に良い戦士だ。\n我が配下に出来ぬことを悔しく思う。:
You are truly a fine warrior.
I regret that you cannot be one of my subordinates.
m940002.実際、貴重な存在よ。\n――あなたが味方についてくれて、心強いわ。:
You are a precious existence.
――It's reassuring to have you on our side.
m940002.宿敵の妹だからと毛嫌いする必要はない。\nいや、毛嫌いするフリ、か？:
There's no need to dislike her just because she's your archenemy's sister.
Or rather, "pretend to dislike her," right?
m940002.封鎖階層？\n冥界にも、天界のオリュンポスのように、\n複数の階層があるというこ:
A sealed layer?
You mean the Underworld has multiple layers,
like Olympus in the Heavens?
m940002.山岳地帯から伏兵が出てきたか……。\n連中は街道を行く部隊より足が遅い。\n接近:
Ambushers have emerged from the mountainous terrain……
They move slower than the units on the roads.
Prepare to intercept them before they close in.
m940002.帝国――いや、王国か？\nそっちにも良い戦士がいるじゃないか……。:
The Empire—no, was it the Kingdom?
You've got some fine warriors over there, I see……
m940002.帝国とは決して止まれぬものだ。\n侵略を始めたなら、全てを喰らい尽くすか、\n内:
An empire never stops.
Once it begins its conquest, it must devour everything,
or be devoured from within.
m940002.帝国に、内通者がいると……？\n馬鹿な、軍内に裏切り者がいるはずが――:
A traitor in the Empire…?
Nonsense, there's no way there's a traitor in the army—
m940002.帝国に住まう、鬼の部族が長よ。\n――貴様に、頼みたいことがある。\n街への侵入:
Head of the oni tribe that dwells in the Empire.
……I have a request of you.
When the enemy breaches the city's defenses, I will need the power of that golden staff.
m940002.帝国に棲家を奪われた獣人が、\n帝国を恨んでることだって分かってる。:
I know that Beastmen who lost their homes to the Empire
harbor resentment against it.
m940002.帝国の士気が下がっている今こそ好機。\n冥界の勇士たちよ、\nこの砦を押さえ、北:
With the Empire's morale low, this is our chance.
Warriors of the Netherworld,
seize this fortress and make it our foothold in the north!!
m940002.帝国の戦いに、口出しはしない。\nでも、帝国の民は必ず守る……。\n本当に、どこ:
We won't interfere in the Empire's wars.
But we will protect the Imperial people, no matter what...
Truly, the Prince is always the Prince.
m940002.帝国の飛空艦隊はここにはいないはずだけど。\n……あっ、見えた。あの艦影は帝国艦:
The Empire's fleet shouldn't be here.
……Ah, I can see it. That silhouette is an Imperial ship.
The flag they're flying is――
m940002.帝国艦隊の砲撃だけでも厄介だというのに……。\n王子殿、クロコを全力で叩くぞ！:
The Imperial fleet's bombardment is troublesome enough……
Your Highness, we will strike Croco with everything we have!
m940002.帝国軍の練度は極めて高いわ。\nだからこそ、こちらが兵を割けば、\nそこへ迅速に:
The Imperial forces are highly disciplined.
That is precisely why, whenever we deploy troops,
they swiftly reinforce the threatened sector.
m940002.帝国軍も王国軍も、雪山の方に向かったのかな。\n……ふふん、これでボクは安全に逃:
I wonder if both the Imperial and Kingdom armies are heading toward the snowy mountains.
……Heh, so I can escape safely now—
m940002.帝国軍兵士たちよ、剣をとれ。\n死者どもには、冥界へお帰り願おう。:
Soldiers of the Imperial Army, take up your swords.
We shall escort the dead back to the Netherworld.
m940002.帝都周辺を確保できたとしても、\nこの戦は長引きそうだな……。:
Even if we secure the area around the Imperial Capital,
this war is going to drag on…….
m940002.平和のために、争う者をすべて排除する……。\nそれ以外の手段を、ルインは手にする:
To bring peace, eliminate all who would fight…
Ruin needs to possess means other than that.
m940002.幼馴染のボクを置いて、\n都会に出て行っちゃうんだから薄情者だと思うなぁ？:
You left your childhood friend behind
and ran off to the big city. That's what I call heartless.
m940002.弱き皇帝に、民は従わぬ。\n冥界対帝国の、反逆ごっこがまさにそれを示している。\:
The people do not follow a weak emperor.
The so-called rebellion of the Underworld against the Empire is proof of that.
If the Emperor is not great, the people grow arrogant and overstep their bounds.
m940002.強がらず休め馬鹿者。\nお前が立っていたら兵が休息をとれぬだろう。:
Stop putting on a brave face and rest, you fool.
As long as you are standing, the soldiers cannot take a break.
m940002.強大な魔力と、\n結界を抜けることによる苦痛に耐えられる精神があれば。\n……い:
If one possesses immense magical power and the mental fortitude to endure the agony of piercing a barrier.
……No, that can't be. There's no way anyone like that exists.
m940002.当たり前だ、伝説の存在に焚き付けられたんだぞ。\nだからこそタチが悪いんだがな…:
Of course. They've been fired up by the presence of a legend.
That's what makes them so dangerous……
m940002.当然！\n砲兵、全弾ぶち込めェ！！\n地下まで追手を出されたら終わりだからね！！:
Naturally!
Artillery, fire everything you've got!!
If they follow us underground, it's over!!
m940002.彼……？ あぁ、なるほど。\n開戦前に、彼が陛下と密談を\nしていたのはそういう:
His? Ah, I see.
So that is why he was having a private meeting with His Majesty
before the war began.
m940002.彼は言葉巧みに、穏やかに眠るべき死者の魂を惑わした。\n未だ死すべき運命にない定:
He used his silver tongue to mislead the souls of the dead who should be resting peacefully.
He drove mortals who had not yet reached their destined end into battle,
for the sake of a fame built on deception and falsehood.
m940002.待って、あの旗ってベラート伯爵の……。: Wait, that flag is Count Belato's……
m940002.後悔したくなければ、この砦へ来いと。\n――そして、なるほど、確かにこれは我が後:
If you don't want to regret it, come to this fortress.
――And I see. Indeed, this is the residue of my regret.
m940002.心得た。\n騎士殿も、悔いなき選択をするがいい。:
Understood.
You, too, Knight, make a choice you will have no regrets about.
m940002.心得ておくよ。\nはぁ……花の似合う麗しの神官さまが、\n今や最前線に咲く屈強な:
I'll keep that in mind.
Haa… from a beautiful priestess suited to flowers,
to a rugged Divine Warrior blooming on the front line.
m940002.心配しなくても大丈夫だって。\n王子がさ、いくつの戦場を\n勝ち抜いてきたと思っ:
Don't worry, it'll be fine.
How many battlefields do you think
the Prince has conquered?
m940002.必要な、しかし忘れてはならぬ尊い犠牲、\nそう心に刻んでおけばそれでよいだろうと:
A necessary, yet precious sacrifice that must not be forgotten.
If you can engrave that in your heart, then that will suffice.
m940002.応ッ！\nそして白の皇帝よ、貴様もここで死ぬのだ。\n戦士として最後の戦いを、始:
I do!
And you, White Emperor, you will die here too.
Let us begin our final battle as warriors.
m940002.思っています。\nあなたは、私の一番の親友ですから。:
I do.
You are my dearest friend.
m940002.急ぎ補給を済ませろ！\n決戦まで、あまり時間はないぞ！:
Get the resupply done quickly!
We don't have much time before the decisive battle!
m940002.怪我人は安静にしてください。\n無理やり安静にしますよ？:
Please, the injured need to rest.
I will force you to rest if necessary.
m940002.恩に着る。\nこれで、父上も……報われる……。:
I accept your kindness.
With this, Father……will finally be at peace…….
m940002.悪い噂も多々あってな。\n帝国の民は、怖がって近付かない場所でもある。:
There are plenty of bad rumors about it.
It's a place the Imperial citizens fear and avoid.
m940002.悪くない……戦士たちの怨嗟の声が、\n殺せと、砕けと、オレに求めてくる。:
Not a bad place… The voices of the warriors' resentment
are calling to me, begging me to kill, to crush.
m940002.憧れの存在ってのは、毒にも薬にもなるってことだ。\nユージェン、お前も気をつけて:
An idol can be both poison and medicine.
Yuugen, you'd better be careful too.
m940002.我が上に立つ者など、最初からいるはずがなかろう。\n皇帝こそ世界の全て、あらゆる:
There has never been anyone who stands above me.
The Emperor is the entirety of the world, the one who stands above all life.
m940002.我が剣はあなたの神罰を代行するものであり、\n我が手は死者の魂を冥界へ導き、\n:
My sword was meant to carry out your divine punishment,
and my hands were meant to guide the souls of the dead to the Underworld,
leading them to your cradle.
m940002.我が古の帝国軍も、その数を大きく減らした。\n首ひとつで戦況を変えるとは、大した:
My ancient imperial army has been greatly diminished.
To turn the tide of battle with a single head…… what a feat.
m940002.我が国を受け継いだ男が、\n英雄王の子孫如きに絆され、\n牙を抜かれ、まるで子犬:
The man who inherited my nation
was so bound by the descendants of the Hero King
that his fangs were pulled out, leaving him like a tamed puppy.
m940002.我が復讐を……悲願を愚弄するつもりか……ッ！！: Do you intend to mock my vengeance… my wish…?!
m940002.我が王、こちらの戦力は各個撃破されています。\nしかし同時に、確実に\n帝国軍の:
My King, our forces here are being picked off one by one.
But at the same time,
the Imperial army's advance is certainly slowing down.
m940002.我が願いニハ、数多の生贄が必要ナノダ。\n真なる雷を、コノ身に宿すにはナ……。:
My wish requires many sacrifices.
To house the true thunder within this body…….
m940002.我らの誇りをかけた戦いを、ごっこ遊びだと……！？: You call a battle fought for our pride a mere game?!
m940002.我らは誉れある戦いを重んずる。だがこの戦いは、\n志を同じくする友のための戦いで:
We hold honorable combat in high regard. But this war is also
a fight for friends who share our cause.
m940002.我ら王政の時代より国を支えてきた貴族……。\n何処の馬の骨とも知れぬあの男が長と:
Nobles who have supported the nation since the era of the monarchy…
Ever since that man of unknown origin took command,
my homeland has been consumed by war, twisting and warping…
m940002.我ら白の王国貴族、先王への忠義は誓えども、\n生まれも知れぬ傭兵などに\n仕えた:
We, the nobles of the White Kingdom, swear our loyalty to the late king.
But serving a mercenary of unknown origin?
Not a shred of that has ever been in us.
m940002.戦いの中に身を置いたあの子は、\n死の亜神というより、半ば戦神に近い存在になるの:
A child who has lived within the clutches of war
becomes less like a Demigod of Death and more like a War Goddess.
m940002.戦い慣れた相手といえど、ここは敵地だ。\n兵に油断するなと伝えろ。:
Even if they are familiar foes, we are in enemy territory.
Tell the troops to stay vigilant.
m940002.戦え、剣を取れ、殺し続けよ。\n我が帝国は血河の上に建つ城なのだから。:
Fight. Take up your swords. Keep killing.
My empire is a fortress built upon a river of blood.
m940002.戦争など、強がりで参戦するものではない。\n誇りと虚勢を取り違えたままでは、\n:
One does not enter a war on the strength of bravado alone.
Confusing pride with arrogance
will inevitably lead to a day of no return.
m940002.戦争に正義なんざないさ。\nこっちの利益とあっちの利益、それが激突して、\n話し:
There's no such thing as justice in war.
It's what you do when your interests and theirs collide,
and talking it out isn't enough.
m940002.戦力の分散にも気をつけて。\nはぐれたら帰れない可能性もあるから。\n――それじ:
Be careful not to spread your forces too thin.
If you get separated, you might not be able to find your way back.
—Well then, let's go.
m940002.手強い相手だよ、兵の心を掴んでる。\n――そう、それこそ連中にとっての王子みたい:
He's a tough opponent. He has his soldiers' hearts.
—Right, he's like a prince to them.
m940002.承知の上、よ。\nハイドース様が本心を語らず、\n何かを企んでいることは、私も知:
I am fully aware.
I know that Lord Hyades hides his true intentions
and is plotting something.
m940002.指揮官は後方に控える、\nということを覚えたのかもしれません。: Perhaps he has learned that commanders should stay in the rear.
m940002.捌くんじゃないの。\n思いやって、慈しむのよ。:
It's not about dealing with them.
It's about showing them compassion and mercy.
m940002.捕まれサザンカ！！\n……まったく、連中の時間稼ぎはこのためか！！:
Got you, Sasanqua!!
…Tch. So that's what the enemy's stalling was for!!
m940002.援軍到着まで保たせただけで勲章ものだ。\n後は我々にまかせておけ。:
You did well to hold out until the reinforcements arrived.
Leave the rest to us.
m940002.支援が欲しいのは全部の前線かなぁ。\nロミルダ、ちょっと休んでいってください！\:
Every front line is requesting support.
Romilda, please take a break for a moment!
If you run out of mana, you won't be able to fight!
m940002.故に、貴様らは贄となってもらう。\n死ぬ気であの小童を殺しに行け。\n見事首を刈:
Therefore, you will serve as sacrifices.
Go kill that brat with the intent to die.
I hope you can behead him cleanly.
m940002.故郷に残してきた友に、\n言いたいことはしっかり伝えておくべきだったなぁ。\nあ:
I should have properly conveyed my feelings to the friends I left behind in my hometown.
Ah, what a regret. Such a great regret.
m940002.故郷を奪われた貴殿には、我らと同じく、\nその怒りをもって皇帝を断罪する権利があ:
Since your homeland was taken from you, you have the right
to condemn the Emperor with the same fury as we do.
And yet, what troubles you?
m940002.敵が強くて助かった、と言ったところか。\n何とも滑稽な話だが、人の身からすれば天:
I suppose I should be grateful for such a formidable foe.
A rather absurd situation, but from a human perspective, it is no different from a natural disaster.
m940002.敵が飛空艦隊を持ち出した以上、\nこちらは常に後手に回ることになります。\nこち:
Now that the enemy has deployed their air fleet,
we're always going to be one step behind.
If only we had our own air force…
m940002.敵の増援、かもしれません。\nあれだけの艦隊ならば、\n上陸部隊もかなりの数でし:
They may be enemy reinforcements.
With a fleet that large,
the landing force must be considerable.
m940002.敵の将は戦争を知っているらしい。\nだが、こちらも全ての手の内を明かしたわけでは:
The enemy commander seems to know a thing or two about war.
But we haven't revealed all our cards either.
m940002.敵の戦術、布陣も分かってきた。\n次は毒茨のドルイドたちを出せ。: We have grown accustomed to the enemy's tactics and formations. Send out the druids of the Poisoned Thorns next.
m940002.敵の総指揮官はハイドース様なのよ？\n冥界の門を開く権限を持っている亜神なのよ？:
The enemy's supreme commander is Hyades, isn't it?
A demigod with the authority to open the gates of the Netherworld?
m940002.敵は街道も押さえているようです。\n舗装された道を使ってくるとなれば、\n敵の行:
The enemy seems to be holding the roads as well.
If they use the paved routes,
their marching speed will be quite rapid.
m940002.敵は飛空戦艦と車両部隊を主力としています。\nならば、背後の雪山に逃れ、\n高所:
The enemy is relying on flying warships and vehicle units.
Therefore, we should withdraw to the snowy mountains behind us
and secure the high ground.
m940002.敵を褒めている場合じゃないよ、団長。\n――王子、もうあまり時間がない、\nオー:
We can't afford to praise the enemy, Commander.
—Prince, we're running out of time.
Prepare to withstand the orc's massive assault!!
m940002.敵軍は冥界人と思しき連中だけではない。\n遠方より、獣人の部隊が接近しているのだ:
The enemy isn't just those who appear to be from the Underworld.
A unit of beastfolk is approaching from afar.
m940002.敵部隊に近付かれる前に、\n遠距離からできるだけ戦力を削っておきたいですね……。:
Before the enemy units get close,
we should wear down their strength from a distance as much as possible……
m940002.時が経てば、黒炎も\n物質界の法則に飲まれて消えていくけれど……。\n手早く炎を:
Given enough time, the black flames will be consumed by the laws of the material world and fade away…….
But it might be safer to extinguish them quickly.
m940002.暗殺ではなく、戦争を選ぶ以上、\n白の帝国自体に恨みを持つ者なのでしょうか……。:
Since they chose war over assassination,
do they hold a grudge against the White Empire itself……?
m940002.書物にはほとんど、その記録が残されていません。\nですがある地方の口伝によれば、: There are hardly any written records left. But according to local oral traditions, Queen Labrys became a judge of the Underworld after her death.
m940002.最初から想定済みだ。\n……悪い想定の方ばかりが当たっているが。:
We anticipated this scenario from the start.
…Unfortunately, it's always the worst-case scenarios that come true.
m940002.最初のダークエルフの襲撃で、\n警備部隊長が負傷してしまいましたので……。:
The captain of the guard was injured
during the first assault by the Dark Elves…….
m940002.最強の鬼が、これからも手を貸してあげるよ。\nだから皇帝も王子も、\n絶対に、だ:
The strongest Oni will lend you a hand from now on, too.
So you, Emperor, and you, Prince,
absolutely must not lose to anyone!
m940002.最新鋭の兵器なんだろ、帝国式魔導何とかってのは。\n――それがこの砦にあるって、:
The cutting-edge weapon, the Imperial-style magic… whatever it was.
—The fact that it was here means
someone leaked the intel, don't you think?
m940002.望みを叶えよう、かつての強者たちよ。\n冥界と物質界の壁を超えるがよい。:
Let us fulfill their wishes, you former champions.
Cross the barrier between the afterlife and the material world.
m940002.未来の子らを任せられる、\nその事実を喜んでいるのだろう。\n己の死は、そのまま:
They are likely rejoicing in the fact that they can entrust
the future's children to them.
Their own death serves as proof of the power to protect their descendants.
m940002.本来ならば付き合ってやる必要はないが、\nこちらもこの砦を失うわけにはいかない。:
Normally, I wouldn't bother playing along,
but we can't afford to lose this fortress either.
Give them everything you've got!!
m940002.本気、だと思うわよ？\nただその本気は、本気で今の帝国軍を潰し、\n再び自分が統:
I think he's serious.
It's just that his seriousness lies in his intent to crush the current Imperial Army
and rule it again himself.
m940002.来いッ！\n獣人の誇りがあるのなら！\n言葉で語るな、牙と咆哮で語るが良いッ！！:
Come on!
If you have any Beastman pride left in you!
Stop talking! Show me with your fangs and your roar!!
m940002.来るが良い、今代の帝国軍よ。\n戦乱の世にて磨かれし我が剣、\nその錆となりたい:
Come forth, then, soldiers of the current Imperial army.
My sword, honed in an age of endless war,
lets the one who wishes to become its rust step forward.
m940002.格納庫は空っぽにしてある。\n全員乗れるから慌てず、奥まで詰めて！:
The hangar is completely empty.
There's room for everyone, so don't panic and move to the back!
m940002.案ずるな、別働隊も制したと報告があった。\nまだ帝国は、戦い続けられる。:
Do not worry. I have received a report that the detachment has been dealt with.
The Empire can still fight on.
m940002.正面から蹴散らせ。\n彼らもそれを望んでいるはずだ。:
Crush them head-on.
That is what they want, too.
m940002.此度の戦場、貴様の勝ちだ。\n死の淵より帰還するとは、\nそれほどまでに、この世:
This battlefield is yours.
To return from the brink of death……
Is this world truly that important to you?
m940002.武技も、器も優れた男、か。\nそれだけに惜しいな……。:
A man of such skill and talent.
It is all the more regrettable……
m940002.歩む速度が落ちるのなら、\n堂々と胸を張って進めばいい。\nそれが我ら、勇者に連:
If our pace slows,
then we march forward with our chests out and heads held high.
That is what we are, Orc warriors descended from heroes!
m940002.歪んで、傾いて、反旗を翻されてもなお、\nその異形のままに走り続けることしか、\:
Twisted, tilted, and faced with rebellion,
the Empire can do nothing but keep running
in its current, monstrous state.
m940002.歴代の勇者たちが……この地に……！\n勝てる、おぉぉ、勝てるぞ、この戦……！！:
The Heroes of past generations... are here...!
We can win, oh, we can win this battle...!!
m940002.死の覚悟ある者こそ良い王の器だというのなら、\nそんなものは願い下げだ。:
If that is what it takes to be a vessel for a good king,
then I have no interest in it.
m940002.死を背負い、嘆きを背負い、\nされどその音色はどれも、\nあなたを後押ししている:
You carry death upon your back, and sorrow.
Yet every note you play
sounds as if it's urging you forward.
m940002.死んでしまっては誇りもなにもない、と？\nはははっ、騎士殿、それは順序が逆だ。:
If you die, you have no pride, is that it?
Hahaha, Knight, that is the wrong order of things.
m940002.死んで楽になんて、させませんから。\n自分の始めたことなら、\n最後まで責任を取:
I'm not going to let you die and get it over with.
If you started this,
you'll have to see it through to the end.
m940002.死兵……捨て駒となることを決めた者こそ、\n最も強い戦士である、と……？:
So… those who have resolved to become sacrificial pawns
are the strongest warriors of all?
m940002.死後の世界、ですからね。\nその兵力とは、物質界の死の総量に等しいものかと。:
It is the afterlife, after all.
Their strength is likely equal to the total amount of death in the material world.
m940002.死者が、この世に現れる。\n悪霊怨霊、地縛霊に、夢枕に立つご先祖さま。\nまさか:
The dead appearing in this world.
Evil spirits, vengeful ghosts, earthbound souls, ancestors visiting in dreams.
Surely you can't say you've never heard of those?
m940002.殊勝な心がけだな。\nでは、この礼は別の形でするとしよう。\n帝国――いや、白の:
A noble sentiment.
Then let us offer this gratitude in another form.
Belart, noble of the White Kingdom—
m940002.殺された当人が許すと言っているのだ。\n胸を張って、私が殺したと自慢しておけ！:
The person who was killed has forgiven you.
Hold your head high and boast that you killed her!
m940002.殺すなって言われてないから、殺すってこと……？\nふっざけるなッ！\n殺せるから:
So because you weren't told not to kill, you're just going to kill……?
Don't be ridiculous!
Just because you can kill doesn't mean you have to, you idiot!?
m940002.民を守る、強き力を持つ者が皇帝となる。\nこちらの流儀に、あちらもあわせてくれて:
The one who possesses the strength to protect the people becomes Emperor.
They are matching our way of doing things.
m940002.民を守るのが、俺の役目だ。\nあいつなら、同じ選択をするだろう。:
Protecting the people is my duty.
He would make the same choice.
m940002.気にするでない。\n竜とは、気まぐれに世界を愛し、世界を壊す存在じゃ。:
Do not worry about it.
Dragons are creatures that love the world on a whim, and destroy it on a whim.
m940002.気にする必要はありません。\nルインは、自分からこの作戦を提案しました。:
There is no need to worry about that.
Ruin proposed this operation on her own.
m940002.永遠を生きる神仙なんて、\n時の停滞した死者と同じようなものじゃない？\n居心地:
An immortal deity living forever…
isn't that just like a dead person stuck in time?
You feel at home because you've been summoned here.
m940002.決まっているでしょう。\n陛下が動けぬ今、\n帝国軍の全権を握るのは誰だと思って:
It should be obvious.
Now that Your Majesty is unable to act,
who do you think holds full authority over the Imperial Army?
m940002.決着はついた。\n帝国の未来を決めるのは、今を生きる者だ。\n過去の亡霊などでは:
It is settled.
Those who live in the present decide the Empire's future.
Not the ghosts of the past.
m940002.治療するに決まってるでしょう。\nトゥーダ、ここにいる癒し手だけで、\n陛下の命:
Of course we're going to heal him.
Tuda, with the healers we have on hand,
keep Your Majesty alive.
m940002.法の守護者が聞いて呆れる！\n中身はただのバトルジャンキーじゃない！:
The Guardian of the Law is listening in disbelief!
You're nothing but a battle junkie at heart!
m940002.海岸線の向こうに、軍艦が！\n――いえ、それにしては妙な……。:
There are warships beyond the coastline!
—No, that's not quite right…
m940002.減らず口を……。\nまぁいい、無理強いはしない。:
??? : Don't be cheeky…….
Very well, I won't force you.
m940002.然り。\n冥界の亜神トノ契約ハ、冥界軍の戦力とナルことのみ。\nソノ手段について:
Indeed.
My contract with the Lesser Deity of the Underworld only requires me to serve as a combat force for the Underworld army.
There are no restrictions on the means I use.
m940002.然り。\n我が名は冥界の審判者、亜神ラビリス。\n法と秩序、そして名誉の番人なり: Indeed. I am the Judge of the Underworld, the demi-god Labrys. Guardian of law, order, and honor.
m940002.然り。これなる黒炎は、盟友ハイドースとの同盟の証。\n周囲一帯を焼き払う、我らが:
Indeed. This black flame is the proof of our alliance with our ally, Hydros.
It is the flame of our fury, burning everything in its path.
m940002.父上……良かった……。\nそうだ、皆は……？:
Father… I'm so glad…
Wait, what about everyone else…?
m940002.父上、どうか、見守っていてくれ。\nきっと未来は、良いものになるはずだから。:
Father, please watch over us.
The future is sure to be a better one.
m940002.父上！ いったい何が……皆は――: Father! What is going on…? Where is everyone—
m940002.物質界で生きていても、いずれは死ぬでしょう？\n生命とは、いつか必ず\n死ぬよう:
Even living in the material world, everyone dies eventually, right?
It would be strange if life wasn't built to end in death.
m940002.獣人……？\n冥界軍で、獣人……まさか……。:
Beastfolk……?
Beastfolk in the Underworld army…… could it be……
m940002.獣人たちが、妥協と諦観を捨て去るために。: So that the Beastfolk may cast aside compromise and resignation.
m940002.獣人の長、百獣の王者、無冠のチャンピオン……。\n私の信じた最高の勇者……。:
The Beastman Chieftain, the King of a Hundred Beasts, the Uncrowned Champion...
The greatest hero I ever believed in...
m940002.王よ、そんな……！\n俺たちもここでお供します！！:
My King, please…!
We'll accompany you here!!
m940002.王国の王子よ、私も戦うぞ！\n共にこの戦線を突破し、帝国軍と合流しよう！:
Prince of the Kingdom, I shall fight alongside you!
Let us break through this line together and link up with the Imperial forces!
m940002.王子、あたしは裏門を押さえに行く。\nこの正門はあんたの指揮に任せたよ！:
Prince, I'll hold the back gate.
I leave this main gate to your command!
m940002.王子、お前なら、\nあの亜神の目を覚ましてやれるか。:
Prince, can you
wake that Demigod up?
m940002.王子、ハイドースとの戦いはまだ続きます。\n気を抜かず、警戒を続けていきましょう:
Prince, our battle with Hydos is far from over.
Let us stay vigilant and keep our guard up.
m940002.王子、亜神ヘリューズの軍勢が来ます。\n前線拠点の防衛指揮、お願いします！:
Prince, the Demigod Heleus's forces are approaching.
Please take command of the frontline base's defense!
--- scene: The Sixth Formation: The One Who Bears Death (battle, end) ---
m940002.王子、兵の治療を開始しました。\nシノビと弓手で連携し、周辺の索敵も進めています:
Prince, I've begun treating the wounded.
The ninjas and archers are coordinating
to scout the surrounding area.
m940002.王子、敵が動き始めたようだ。\nどうやらこちらの先手を取りたいようだね。:
Prince, the enemy has begun to move.
It seems they want to seize the initiative.
m940002.王子、敵の増援部隊だ。\nさすがに後詰を用意していたか、冥界軍。:
Prince, the enemy's reinforcements have arrived.
So the Netherworld army did have a backup plan, I see.
m940002.王子、敵の攻勢が続いています。\n引き続き指揮をお願いします！:
Prince, the enemy's assault is still ongoing.
Please continue to command the troops!
m940002.王子、敵は帝都の周辺に陣を張っている。\n旗持ちのミノタウロスがここからでも見え:
Prince, the enemy has set up camp around the Imperial Capital.
Can you see the Minotaur carrying the flag from here?
m940002.王子、気をつけろ。\n敵軍の士気はより高くなるぞ。:
Prince, be careful.
The enemy's morale is going to be higher than ever.
m940002.王子、港町の防衛部隊も出ているようです。\n協力して戦闘を進めましょう。:
Prince, the port town's defense units are deploying as well.
Let's coordinate our forces and proceed with the battle.
m940002.王子、王国軍も傷の手当が必要だろう。\n得られた時間は長くはないが、\n可能な限:
Prince, the Kingdom's army will need tending to as well.
The time we have is limited, but
make sure all preparations are in order.
m940002.王子さま！ 気をつけて！！\nクロコのハルバードがまとっているのは、\n古代の雷:
Prince! Be careful!!
The energy surrounding Croco's halberd
is identical to the dragon breath of an ancient thunder dragon!
m940002.生きて帰るつもりがないのなら、\n戦士はその、本当の実力というものを発揮する。\:
If you have no intention of returning alive,
a warrior can unleash their true, full power.
Even a rookie can slay an enemy general.
m940002.生命が死んでいく様を余さず感じ取ってしまうから、\n彼女はその嘆きから目を背ける:
She feels the pain of life fading away with such clarity
that, to escape that grief,
she chose to be alone.
m940002.生命とは、想いを持つもの。\nその安寧なくして、死者の国を\n清浄に保つことがで:
Life is that which holds feelings.
Do you truly believe you can keep the realm of the dead pure
without granting that peace?
m940002.生者が冥界を訪れたのだから、当然の現象よ。\nこの地は死に満ちているの。\nただ:
Since a living being has entered the underworld, it's only natural.
This place is filled with death.
Just being here should cause your life force to drain away.
m940002.申し遅れた、メフィスト団長の部下、マレブランケだ。\n……本当に助かった、この礼:
Pardon the late introduction. I am Malebranche, a subordinate of Commander Mephisto.
……I truly am grateful for the rescue. I will surely repay this kindness.
m940002.異種族が口を挟むことじゃなかったわね。\n人の国家のことは、人が決めていくべきだ:
I suppose it wasn't my place to interject.
Matters of human nations should be decided by humans.
m940002.白の帝国――いや、白の王国というべきか。\n王政時代に領海を守護した、貴族たちの:
The White Empire――or rather, the White Kingdom.
It is a fleet led by the nobles who once guarded the territorial waters
during the monarchy.
m940002.白の帝国がその精算を終わらせる、\nその長くも短い時間を、\n物質界を狙う亜神た:
The demi-gods who covet the Material Plane
will not wait for the White Empire to finish its reckoning,
however long or short that time may be.
m940002.白の帝国が限界に達していることなど、\n俺も既に、理解している。:
I, too, already understand
that the White Empire has reached its limit.
m940002.白の帝国と王国は、かつて敵対していたはず。\n今からでも付け入る余地はあるのでは:
The White Empire and the Kingdom were once enemies.
Isn't there an opening we can exploit now?
m940002.白の帝国に奪われし、父祖の地を取り戻す時が来た！\n狼の民よ、牛の民よ、今こそ先:
The time has come to reclaim the land of our forefathers, stolen by the White Empire!
People of the Wolves, People of the Cattle, tell our ancestors this!
That we have come to take back our homeland with our own hands!
m940002.白の帝国は、もはや名ばかり……。\nならば、その首すげ替えてしまおうか。:
The White Empire is nothing but a name now…
Then, let us replace its head.
m940002.白の帝国は戦力と領土を必要としていた。\nあいつらはその地を守りたかった。\n―:
The White Empire needed military strength and territory.
They wanted to defend their land.
――And we're here as reinforcements for the Empire.
m940002.白の帝国建国の折、あるいはそれ以前の、\n国を守るための戦いで散っていった、\n:
The soldiers of the White Kingdom who fell in battle to defend the nation,
at the founding of the White Empire, or even before that,
are calling out from the afterlife.
m940002.白の王国を取り戻す、そのためならば、\nこのベラート、己を犠牲にすることすら厭わ:
To reclaim the White Kingdom, I, Belart,
would sacrifice myself without hesitation!
m940002.白の王国貴族たちの\n無念を代表してここにあるのは確かですが、\nさりとて皇帝の:
It is true that I stand here
representing the resentment of the White Kingdom's nobility,
but if you ask whether I desire the Emperor's head…….
m940002.白の皇帝、貴様の命を貰い受ける！\nこれは我が部族、我が父祖の血、\nそして我が:
White Emperor, I claim your life!
This is a duel for the pride of my tribe, the blood of my ancestors,
and the honor of my sword!!
m940002.白の皇帝は今、生死の狭間にある！\nされど、彼に国を預けた王家の血は、\n今もな:
The White Emperor is now on the brink of death!
Yet, the royal blood that entrusted the nation to him
still stands with you, on this battlefield!
m940002.皆さん、敵は城門で足止めされています。\n形勢は逆転しました。\nどうか、ご武運:
Everyone, the enemy is being held up at the city gates.
The tide has turned.
Good luck!
m940002.皇帝――いや、陛下、そして王子。\n未来の子ら、イルヴィを頼むぞ。\n未来の恩は:
Emperor――no, Your Majesty, and Prince.
Leave the children of the future, Irvit, to you.
We'll repay the future's debt right here, right now!
m940002.皇帝に騎士団長、王国軍まで北方へ向かわせ、\nあえて作り出した弱点にて、\n敵を:
A malicious scheme designed to lure the Emperor, the Knight Commander, and the Kingdom's army north,
creating a deliberate weakness
to crush the enemy.
m940002.目的……カ……。\nそれヲ知ってどうスル。\nコレヨリ、この地の生命は息絶えルと:
My purpose…….
What would you do with that knowledge.
From this moment on, all life in this land shall cease to exist.
m940002.眠りについたまま、か……。\nでも、最初から三女神を頼るつもりはないでしょう？:
Still asleep, I see….
But surely he doesn't intend to rely on the Three Goddesses from the very beginning?
m940002.知りたくば、次こそ我が命を刈り取るがいい。\nさらばだ、白の皇帝。\n次に見える:
If you wish to know, come take my life next time.
Farewell, White Emperor.
I look forward to the day we meet again.
m940002.知るか、そんなこと。\nだが親父殿や、先祖代々の勇者たちが待っている。:
I have no idea.
But Father and the heroes of our ancestors are waiting for us.
m940002.砲を収められよ！\nこちらに敵意はありませぬ。:
Put away your cannons!
I harbor no ill will toward you.
m940002.硬きウロコもナク、強大な体躯モ持たぬがユエか。\nソレガ、空をユクことと何の関係:
No hard scales, no massive bodies, and yet.
What does that have to do with the ability to fly?
m940002.確かに……。\nあの伯爵であれば、\n真っ先に名乗りをあげそうなものですよね。:
Indeed…….
If it were that Count,
he would surely be the first to make his presence known.
m940002.確かに……。\nでも無理はしないように！\n援軍がきっと来てくれるはずですから！:
That's certainly…….
But don't push yourself too hard!
Reinforcements are sure to arrive!
m940002.確かに、そう伝え聞いていた。\n帝国は我が父祖の大地を踏みにじる巨悪だと。:
Indeed, that is what I was told.
That the empire is a great evil trampling on the lands of my ancestors.
m940002.神像では何度も見ている。\n亜神ハイドース、ここで決着をつけるとしよう。:
I've seen you many times through the statues.
Hydos, Lesser God. Let us settle this here.
m940002.神器を、人の手で新たに打ち直したのも――: The fact that the divine weapon was reforged by human hands――
m940002.神話以前の物語に謳われる、\n冥界のハイドースが操るという炎……ですか！？:
The flames said to be wielded by Hydros of the Underworld,
sung of in tales from before the myths……!?
m940002.私が紡いだ創造物たるあなたたちを、\n見捨てるわけ、ないじゃない。:
I'm not about to abandon you,
the beings I wove into existence.
m940002.私が預かっておくわ。\n――預かった後、どこに貸し出すかは決めていいわよね？:
I'll take her in.
――After taking her in, I can decide where to lend her out, right?
m940002.私たちの間に入ってくるような兵がいるなら、\nきっと将来有望なことでしょう。\n:
If any soldier were to eavesdrop,
I suppose that would be a sign of great promise.
――Now then, let us begin the counteroffensive.
m940002.私だって驚いてるとこだって……！\n怖くて仕方ないのに、\n私が言わなきゃってな: I'm just as shocked as you are! I'm terrified, but I just felt like I had to say something!
m940002.私には、どちらが正しいのか分かりませんが……。\nどうかご武運を！:
I don't know which side is truly right……
But good luck to you!
m940002.私の可愛い子どもたち、\nどうか泣かないで、死とはただ怖ろしいものだけれど、\n:
My dear children,
please don't cry. Death is a terrible thing,
but let us at least push that moment a little further away.
m940002.私の館が……燃えて、いる……？\nそれに、あの砦にいるのは――:
My mansion is… on fire…?
And the ones in that fortress are—
m940002.私の館は……燃え尽きてしまいましたけどねー……。: Though my mansion is… completely burned to the ground, I'm afraid…
m940002.私は……私たちは……あなたに助けてほしかった。\nでもそれ以上に……故郷のために:
I…… we…… wanted you to save us.
But more than that…… we wanted you to acknowledge us
as warriors fighting for our homeland……
m940002.私は、守らなければ。\n行き場もなく、ただ悲しみを抱いたあの子らを。\n死を抱く:
I must protect them.
Those children who have nowhere to go, who carry only sorrow.
I want the children who embrace death to at least find peace in their passing.
m940002.私はただ、魔力を与えただけ。\n白の皇帝が命を繋いだのも――:
I merely granted the magic power.
The fact that the White Emperor sustained his life――
m940002.私は善き女王を目指していますから。\n正々堂々、正義に則った戦いでなくては。:
I am striving to be a good queen.
I intend to fight with honor and justice.
m940002.私兵を持つ貴族が、王政の頃からの連中が、\n今の白の帝国にどれだけいると思ってい: How many nobles do you think still keep private armies? Men who've been around since the days of the monarchy.
m940002.空が、我らオークの味方をしています。\n吹雪が近付いてきました。\n敵の弓矢は狙:
The sky is on our side, O Orcs.
A blizzard is approaching.
It will make it hard for the enemy archers to aim.
m940002.空を行く、竜人……？\n竜将クロコか！！:
A Dragonkin in the air…?
Dragon General Croco!!
m940002.第三代、白の皇帝……骸帝……！: The Third Generation, the White Emperor… the Skeleton Emperor…!
m940002.細かな調整は必要となるが、\nこれは未来に向けた実験的措置でもあって――:
Fine-tuning will be necessary, but
this is also an experimental measure for the future――
m940002.結構だ。\nマレブランケ、王子を呼んできてくれ。\n次の戦闘に備えるぞ！:
Never mind.
Malebranche, fetch the Prince.
We need to prepare for the next battle!
m940002.総員、剣を構えよ！\n今より反撃の始まりだ！:
All units, draw your swords!
The counterattack begins now!
m940002.総員、後退せよ！ 次の作戦に移るぞ！\n伯爵殿に花道をあけてやれ！:
All units, fall back!
We move to the next phase of the operation!
Clear a path for the Earl!
m940002.総員、撤退準備！\n負傷者の回収急げ！！:
All units, prepare to retreat!
Get the wounded to safety, quickly!!
m940002.聞け！ 白の帝国が兵たちよ！\nこの地に集いし、白の王国を受け継ぐ者たちよ！:
Listen! Soldiers of the White Empire!
You who have gathered in this land, inheritors of the White Kingdom!
m940002.脱出経路は？\n冥界の門までの間にも、\n敵軍は兵を配置しているはずだろう。:
What's the escape route?
Even before we reach the Gate of the Underworld,
the enemy must have troops deployed along the way.
m940002.臣下が、まだ死ぬなとうるさくてな……。: My subjects were still making a fuss about me dying…
m940002.自分と同じ境遇の者がいたときに、\n守ってあげるため、とかですの？:
Perhaps she wanted to protect someone
who shared her fate?
m940002.航空艦隊の移動力が必要な地点への同時攻撃。\n今回は完全に、冥界軍の手のひらの上:
A simultaneous strike on a location that requires the air fleet's mobility.
This time, we're completely on the Netherworld Army's terms.
m940002.艦隊を陽動に、ダークエルフがさらに時間を……。\nまさか、次の手があるというのか:
Using the fleet as a diversion, and the Dark Elves to buy more time……
Could it be…… they have another move up their sleeve?
m940002.良いだろう、そろそろ本気を見せてやる。\nう、お、お、おおお、おおおおおおおォオ:
Very well. It's about time I showed you my true power.
U, u, u, uuuu, uuuuuuUOOOOH!!
m940002.英雄王の系譜、その力を借りねば\n帝国の維持も出来ないとは……。\n何が力ある者:
The lineage of the Hero King……we must borrow their strength,
or the Empire cannot be maintained…….
What manner of power is that, and what manner of emperor.
m940002.落ち着いてレーネ。\n慌てるとろくなことないんだから。:
Calm down, Lehne.
Panic never leads to good outcomes.
m940002.蘇っタ……蘇っタノダ……。\n我ラが族長が……大長老が……ッ！！:
He's back… he's back…
Our clan leader… the Grand Elder…!!
m940002.蘇生の術により、我が身は徐々に崩れつつはあるが――\nこの魂砕け散るより前に、帝:
The art of resurrection is slowly unraveling my body, but——
before this soul shatters to pieces,
I will crush the Empire and all who have sided with the Kingdom!
m940002.血統の正統性で言うのなら、\n陛下よりも、よほど帝国に相応しい存在ですものね。:
If we speak of the legitimacy of the bloodline,
she is far more befitting of the Empire than His Majesty.
m940002.行くぞ諸君！ 祖国のために剣を取れ！\nかの傭兵より、国を取り戻すのだ！！:
Let's go, my men! Take up your swords for our homeland!
We will take the country back from that mercenary!!
m940002.街の皆は、誰も死んでない！\n全員守ったんだよ、誇れよ皇帝！:
Nobody in the city died!
We protected every single one of them. Be proud, Emperor!
m940002.街を包囲する地下道を、\n竜人族が作るまでの時間稼ぎだったんだよ、この戦いは。\:
This entire battle was just to buy the Dragonkin time to dig the tunnels that now surround the town.
At this rate… we'll be encircled on all sides and destroyed!
m940002.裏切ったのではなく、最初から仲間ではなかったと？\nだが貴様を崇める国など、この:
You didn't betray us; you were never one of us to begin with?
But there is no nation in this age that worships you!
What is an emperor without a state trying to do now, of all times?!
m940002.西の砦……ふふっ、ならば問題ありませんわ。\n帝国の大動脈たるあの砦は、\n彼の:
The western fortress… Heh, then there's no problem.
That fortress, which is the empire's great artery,
is being defended by his unit.
m940002.西の砦に敵獣人の部隊が進軍！\nこちらの増援が間に合わない距離です！:
Enemy beastmen units are advancing on the western fortress!
They're too far away for our reinforcements to arrive in time!
m940002.見くびってもらっては困る。\n城門なんざワシらの敵じゃないぞ。\nここはひとつ、:
Don't underestimate us.
A castle gate is no match for us.
Let's punch a hole right through the wall!!
m940002.見たか！ 若ぇの！！\nワシらの子孫の土地を奪った\n白の帝国の土手っ腹に風穴あ:
Did you see that, you kids!
We've opened a gash in the belly of the White Empire
that stole the land of our descendants!!
m940002.見事耐えきるのならば、\nこちらも手段を講じる必要があるだろう。:
If you manage to hold out,
we will need to take further measures.
m940002.規模は？ 亜神らしき者はいるかしら？:
What's the scale?
Is there anyone who looks like a demigod?
m940002.覚えているとも！\nだが、それを押してなお、\n我らは未来の子らの為に、平和を願:
I remember all too well!
But despite that, we still wished for peace,
for the sake of the children of the future!
m940002.親友置いて逃げるわけないじゃん！\nそれより、急いで戦闘準備を！\n雪上兵はすぐ:
I can't just leave my best friend behind!
Besides, hurry up and get ready for combat!
The snow troops will catch up in no time!
m940002.詭弁は聞き飽きた。\n貴様の本心を引きずり出すには、\nどうやら、敗北を味わわせ:
I am sick of your sophistry.
It seems I must taste defeat
before I can drag the truth out of you.
m940002.誇りのために、命を捨てることだってある。\nオークとは戦いに生きる種族。\n戦場:
There are times when one must throw away their life for the sake of pride.
Orcs are a race that lives for battle.
To fall on the battlefield is an honor, you know?
m940002.誘い込んで叩く、というわけね。\n……勝てると思う？:
So, we lure them in and then strike them down.
…Do you think we can win?
m940002.誰かに助けてもらえるなんて思うなッ！！\n気高き獣人の誇りと、\n卑屈な負けライ:
Don't think you can just rely on someone else to save you!!
Don't you dare confuse the noble pride of a Beastman
with that pathetic, defeatist lion mentality!
m940002.諦めるな！\nここで耐えなければ、援軍は来ないぞ！！:
Don't give up!
If we don't hold out here, the reinforcements won't come!!
m940002.謝れ！ まずはその子に謝りなさい！\nヘカティエも！ 置いていってごめんなさいっ: Apologize! First, apologize to her! And you, Hecatie! Say you're sorry for leaving her behind!
m940002.負傷兵はこちらへ。\nみなさん、彼らの護衛もお願いします。:
Wounded soldiers, come this way.
Everyone, please help escort them.
m940002.貴様、良い王の器となったな。\n惜しい、本当に惜しいものだ……。:
You have become a vessel worthy of a good king.
What a pity. Truly a pity……
m940002.貴様か……。\nどうした、ディアスのところにいると思っていたが。:
So it is you…….
I thought you were with Dias.
m940002.貴様がまっさきに裏切ると思っていたのだがな……。\nいったいどんな心境の変化だ？: I thought you would be the first to betray us…… What has changed your mind?
m940002.貴様は……どうしてそちら側に立っている。\n子爵よ、帝国騎士の誇りを忘れたか！:
You… why are you standing on their side?
Viscount, have you forgotten the pride of an Imperial Knight?
m940002.貴様ら、いったい誰に刃を向けたのか分かっているのか！\n古代龍様、黄金竜の姫様は:
Do you even realize who you're raising your blades against?!
The Ancient Dragon and the Golden Dragon Princess
are walking hand in hand with the Kingdom!!
m940002.軍の仕事が忙しくてね。\nなかなか里帰りもできない……って、\nアタシを薄情者み:
I've just been busy with military work.
I haven't had a chance to go back……
Hey, don't talk about me like I'm heartless!
m940002.連中が退いたのは、壊滅したからではない。\nこれ以上の被害拡大を防ぐために退いた:
They didn't retreat because they were annihilated.
They withdrew to prevent further losses.
m940002.連中の目的は時間稼ぎだ。\nその命をかけてまで、仲間のために\nわずかな時間を稼:
Their goal is to buy time.
They are risking their lives to steal a few precious moments for their comrades.
m940002.違う……あれはもっと異質な……。\nあたしたちより、古い竜の雷……？:
No…… it's something different. Something more alien……
The thunder of a dragon older than us……?
m940002.遥かな未来、アスガルドに災禍をもたらすと予言され、\n冷たき世界へと追放されたと:
The one prophesied to bring disaster to Asgard
in the far future, and exiled to the Cold World—
the sister of the demigod Icol.
m940002.避難しろって言われても――あぁもう！\nマルレーンのバカ！\nすぐ危険な場所に飛:
Evacuate? I can't just――Ugh, forget it!
You idiot, Marleen!
You always rush straight into danger!!
m940002.部隊として進軍してくる者は、\n散兵よりも耐久力が高くなると予想されます。\n各:
Units advancing in formation are expected to have
higher durability than scattered troops.
Everyone, don't forget you're facing an army!
m940002.部隊を撤退させよ、威力偵察は十分だ。\n皆に小休止を取らせ、陣形を整え直すのだ。:
Order the units to withdraw. We've done enough
as a demonstration of force.
Let everyone take a short break and re-form their ranks.
m940002.野営地の城壁を活用しろ！\n敵を身内だと思うな、あれは我らの、\n忘れてはならな:
Utilize the camp's walls!
Don't think of them as kin; they are ghosts of our cursed past,
something we must not forget, but must exorcise!
--- scene: Sixth Formation: The Ancient Imperial Knights (battle, end) ---
m940002.野営地を解放するぞ。\nそうすれば、あの男も戦う理由がなくなるだろう。:
We'll liberate the camp.
If we do, that man will have no reason to keep fighting.
m940002.銀の髪に、黒き外套……。\nおそらくは、ダークエルフを率いる首魁、\nセグナンド:
Silver hair and a black cloak……
It is likely Segundo, the chieftain commanding the Dark Elves!
m940002.陛下、こちらも同意見です。\nあえてあちらが有利な、\n平地で迎え撃つ必要もない:
Your Majesty, I concur.
There is no need to fight them on the open plains,
where they hold the advantage.
m940002.陛下、しゃべらないでください！\n早くヒーラーを……っ。\nトゥーダ！ 神官戦士:
Your Majesty, don't speak!
We need a healer, quickly……!
Tuuda! Summon the priest-warriors!
m940002.陛下、ハイドースは戦場の黒炎を吸収してるんだ！\nめちゃくちゃな魔力をかき集めて:
Your Highness, Hydos is absorbing the Black Flame from the battlefield!
He's gathering up an insane amount of magical power!
m940002.陛下、冥界軍が撤退していきます。\n……おそらくは、今の襲撃は威力偵察だったので:
Your Majesty, the Netherworld Army is retreating.
……That attack was likely just a demonstration of force.
m940002.陛下、各前線より伝令が。\nダークエルフ、オークの部隊により、\n各重要地点が占:
Your Majesty, messengers from the various front lines.
Dark Elf and Orc units have seized
all key strategic points.
m940002.陛下、王子殿下、お気をつけを。\n子爵は帝国屈指の武人の家系。\n当主たるあの方:
Your Majesty, Your Highness, please be careful.
The Viscount hails from one of the Empire's finest martial families.
Even the head of the house possesses exceptional skill.
m940002.陛下！ 敵の増援です！\n飛空戦艦がさらに出現！:
Your Majesty! Enemy reinforcements!
More flying warships are appearing!
m940002.陛下！ 東の方角より、飛空船が接近中です！\nそれから、な、なんというのか……。:
??? : Your Highness! A flying ship is approaching from the east!
Also, I… I don't know how to put this…
m940002.陛下！ 王子！\n警戒すべきは地面の下だよー！！:
Your Highness! Prince!
Watch out below! It's coming from underground!!
m940002.雪上装備の兵が迫ってるんだ！\n雪の上でも関係なく、高速で突っ込んでくるよ！！:
There are snow-equipped troops closing in!
They're charging at high speed, and the snow isn't slowing them down at all!!
m940002.領民や、伯爵領の兵にとって見れば、\n私たちこそ悪役だ、ということか……。\nそ:
I see. To the common folk and the soldiers of his domain, we must appear to be the villains.
Very well. Let us cool our heads for a moment.
m940002.顔に書いてあるじゃない。\nヘカティエ様大好き、置いていかないでってさ。:
It's written all over your face.
“I love Lady Hecatie, please don't leave me behind.”
m940002.飛空戦艦も雪山を超えてきます。\nここからは総力戦ですよ！:
The flying warships are crossing the snowy mountains too.
This is going to be an all-out battle!
m940002.馬鹿な……！！\nやめろ、死にに行くようなものだぞ！？:
What are you doing……!!
Stop! You're just going to your death!?
m940002.馬鹿な、どこから兵を――否、将を増員したというのだ。\nまさか本当に、冥界から喚:
Ridiculous. Where are they getting more troops... no, generals?
Could they really be summoning them from the Netherworld?
m940002.馬鹿者が、ワシらがいつまでも戦っていたら、\nお前たちの戦果を奪ってしまうだろう:
You fool. If we keep fighting forever,
we'll end up stealing your glory!
m940002.騎士団長のディアナ？ 神官戦士団長のトゥーダ？\nまさか王国の王子？ ……違うで:
Knight Commander Diana? Priest-Warrior Commander Tuda?
Or perhaps the Kingdom's Prince? ……No, that's not it, is it?
m940002.騎士殿、死ぬために戦うな。\n己の迷いを断ち切るために、戦え。:
Knight, don't fight in order to die.
Fight to cut through your own doubts.
m940002.骸帝と激突する前に、\nまさか亜神との決戦が待っているとは……。:
I never expected a decisive battle with a Demigod
to be waiting for us before we even clash with the Skeleton Emperor.
m940002.鬼が最強なのは事実だから。\nそういう揺るぎない事実と違ってさ、\n今やってるの:
It's a fact that Oni are the strongest.
Unlike that unshakable truth,
this fight we're in is one we could have avoided, isn't it?
m940002.鬼の一族たるあたしが、\n帝国を裏切らないか近くで見ておけ、とかさ？: Something like, "Make sure the chieftain of the Oni clan doesn't turn on the Empire," right?
m940002.魔女……？\nまさか、ヘリューズ様が……？\nいや、でも私が出発するときにはまだ:
A witch…?
Could it be… Lady Helyus?
But no, she was still in her right mind when I left…
m940002.魔王決戦の時のものにしては古い……。\n千年戦争当時のものかな？:
It's older than the site of the Demon King's final battle…
Could it be from the Millennium War?
m940002.魔界と物質界ではない、\n物質界の者同士による古戦場が、オレの死に場所か。:
A battlefield of old, not between the Demon World and the Material World,
but between beings of the Material World…
Is this where I am to die?
m940002.魔界に住まうオークとは別に、\nかつての千年戦争以降、\n物質界に定住していたオ:
Separate from the Orcs dwelling in the Netherworld,
I've heard there were Orcs who settled in the Material World
after the Millennium War.
m940002.魔界の同族とも、物質界の同族とも相容れない、\nセグナンドたちの部族に、\n何か:
Perhaps she had some feelings for the Segnand tribe,
who fit in neither with their kin in the Demon Realm
nor with those in the Material World.
m940002.魔神副団長殿……。\nすみません、つい不安になってしまって。:
Vice Commander Malebranche...
I'm sorry, I just got a little anxious.
m940002.黒き竜人、闇色の鱗持つ、竜神が子孫よ。\n汝の後悔、悲しみ、この戦にて晴らすがよ:
Black Dragonkin, bearer of dark scales, descendant of the Dragon God.
Let your regret and sorrow be laid to rest in this battle.
m940002.黒き竜人の一族は、今は王国と共に歩んでいる。\n貴様の行為は、その同盟に泥を塗る:
The Black Dragonkin now walk alongside the Kingdom.
Your actions are a despicable betrayal that stains that alliance.
m940002.黙れよ、こうして晴れ姿を見せてやったんだ。\nお前の息子は、今や物質界のオークを:
Shut up. I showed you my true form, didn't I?
Your son is now the king who leads the orcs of the material world.
—A defeated king, to be sure. He lost to the White Empire.
m940002.黙れアダマスッ！！\n力を失ったあの日、長き眠りより覚めた絶望の日、\nその片時:
Silence, Adamas!!
From the day I lost my power, the day I woke from a long sleep in despair,
I have never once forgotten my hatred for you!
m940002.（――すまない、イルヴィ。\n我が娘よ、どうかお前だけでも、生き延びてくれ）:
(—I'm sorry, Irvit.
My daughter, please… just you, survive.)
m940002.（――魔界へ逃げることもできず、\nさりとて、物質界で賊のように生きることもでき:
(I can't flee to the Demon Realm,
and yet I can't live like a bandit in the Material Realm either.)
m940002.（……おや？ 人の子よ、\nもしや、私の声が、聴こえているのですか？）:
(……Oh? Child of man,
can you hear my voice, perhaps?)
m940002.（……こんな戦いは、間違っています。\n民を巻き込むような反乱が、正しいはずがあ:
(……This war is wrong.
A rebellion that drags civilians into the crossfire cannot be right.)
m940002.（……でも、あの子はリエーフの友だちでしょ。\nどうにかして、仲直りさせてあげな:
(……But she is your friend, isn't she?
We must find a way to help them make up.)
m940002.（……はい、姉さん。\n今回の襲撃に関わっているかどうかは不明ですが、\n確実に:
(……Yes, sister.
It's unclear if she's involved in this raid,
but she is definitely with the lesser god Hyades.)
m940002.（……リエーフ、その友人って、\nもしかしてリンクスのこと？\nあの子の部族が冥:
(……Lev, that friend of yours,
could it be Lynx?
Is her tribe with the Underworld army?)
m940002.（あはは、分かった分かった。\nそれじゃあ、王子たちに報告しておこう。\n敵の獣:
(Ahaha, got it, got it.
Well then, let's report to the Prince.
The enemy beast-folk are——quite formidable opponents.)
m940002.（おっと失敬、転んだ時はよろしく頼むよ）\n――それにしても、いやぁ、心残りだな:
(Oh, excuse me. I'll count on you if I do fall.)
――Still, hmm, I do feel a sense of regret.
m940002.（かの暴虐の骸帝より、\n私が、あの子らを守ってあげなければ）:
(I must protect them
from that tyrannical Skeleton Emperor.)
m940002.（そっか……リンクスは、\nアタシたちの部族のこと嫌ってたもんね。\n獣人の誇り:
(Right…… Lynx hated our tribe, didn't she?
She always went on about the pride of the beast-folk.)
m940002.（それは自分でがんばりますから！\n姉さんが口出しするといつも大変なことになるん:
(I'll handle that myself, please!
Every time you get involved, things always end up in a mess!)
m940002.（アダマス様は、本当に眠っているのか？\nそれとも、あえてこの戦いに目を瞑ってい:
(Is Lord Adamas truly asleep?
Or is he deliberately turning a blind eye to this battle…?)
m940002.（マレブランケ、目ぇ閉じて歩いてると転ぶよ？）: (Malebranche, if you keep walking with your eyes closed, you're going to trip.)
m940002.（亜神であることを捨てられなかった、\n私とどこか似た、ダークエルフの戦士たち…:
(The Dark Elf warriors who, like me,
could not abandon their status as Demigods…)
m940002.（仕方ありません。\n魔王の配下となり、次は人間に与する。\nそんな父の真意を、:
(It is to be expected.
She does not know the true meaning behind her father's actions—
serving the Demon King, and now allying with humanity.)
m940002.（初々しいなぁ……。\nこれが人間の友情、というものか）:
(How innocent…….
So this is what human friendship is like.)
m940002.（変わろうとしている、のでしょうか。\nもしかしたら、王子の影響かもしれませんね:
(Is he trying to change, perhaps?
Maybe it's the Prince's influence.)
m940002.（白の皇帝も、以前と比べて変わりましたね。\nまさか私に意見を求めてくるとは）:
(The White Emperor has changed, compared to before.
I never would have expected him to seek my opinion.)
m940002.（誇り高き戦士でありながら、\n強き者に敗れ、長く苦しい日々を生き続け……）:
(A proud warrior,
defeated by the strong, forced to endure long, painful days…)
m940002.（誰もが己の欲望を、\n見せかけの正しさで覆い隠している……。\n亜神ハイドース:
(Everyone is masking their own desires
behind a veneer of righteousness…….
Hydros, what are you hiding?)
m940002.（門が突破されれば、一気に敵がなだれ込み、\nその利点も消えるのだがな。\nそれ:
(If the gates fall, the enemy will pour in and overwhelm us, wiping out any advantage we have.
Keeping that from the troops… is that part of the Marshal's plan too?)
